AscendingSelfReductionFromPullbackReduct.proof:
by
  intro A P p h hp _hpSurj _hSection hProfile C hh hFibres hReduction f_h
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §4, proof of Theorem 5, pp. 11–12.
  -- Lemma 1 (ProfileRealization) gives a computable surjection, a section
  -- and the prescribed profile when the caller supplies a Pi-2 set P.
  -- Here those data are inputs. The search uses computability and the
  -- profile equation. Surjectivity and the section serve the caller.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=12
  -- This passage has no numbered steps. The article-specific Alphabeta Math
  -- Research Portal and its defect report both returned HTTP 404.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  --
  -- Alphabeta Math's recognizability equivalence, step 1.1, tests the
  -- values of a total enumerator in index order. Here the tests are on
  -- naturals and include the inequality y < h u. On success the search
  -- returns the least admissible index, which we send through h.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
  let test (y u : Nat) : Part Bool :=
    Part.some (decide (p u = y ∧ y < h u))
  have hEq : Computable (fun q : Nat × Nat => decide (p q.2 = q.1)) :=
    Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp.comp (hp.comp Computable.snd) Computable.fst
  have hLt : Computable (fun q : Nat × Nat => decide (q.1 < h q.2)) :=
    Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp Computable.fst (hh.comp Computable.snd)
  have hTest : Computable (fun q : Nat × Nat => decide (p q.2 = q.1 ∧ q.1 < h q.2)) := by
    simpa only [Bool.decide_and] using Primrec.and.to_comp.comp hEq hLt
  have hSearch : Partrec (fun y => Nat.rfind (test y)) :=
    Partrec.rfind hTest.partrec
  refine ⟨Partrec.map (g := fun _ u => h u) hSearch (hh.comp Computable.snd), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y z hz
    change z ∈ Part.map h (Nat.rfind (test y)) at hz
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := (Part.mem_map_iff h).mp hz
    have hPass := (Nat.mem_rfind.mp hu).1
    change true ∈ Part.some (decide (p u = y ∧ y < h u)) at hPass
    obtain ⟨hpu, hyu⟩ := of_decide_eq_true (Part.mem_some_iff.mp hPass).symm
    -- Step 1.1 of Alphabeta Math's many-one interface chains pointwise
    -- membership equivalences. Here the reduction gives the equivalence
    -- in reverse, and p u = y identifies the pullback membership.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface
    refine ⟨hyu, ?_⟩
    have hMem := (hReduction u).symm
    change h u ∈ A ↔ p u ∈ A at hMem
    simpa only [hpu] using hMem
  · intro y hy
    have hInfinite : (p ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Nat)).Infinite := by
      rw [← hProfile] at hy
      exact hy
    -- The finite initial interval has a finite pullback along h. The
    -- infinite fibre of p therefore meets the complement of this pullback.
    have hFinite : (h ⁻¹' Set.Iic y).Finite :=
      (Set.finite_Iic y).preimage' (fun z _ => hFibres z)
    have hNotSubset : ¬ (p ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Nat)) ⊆ h ⁻¹' Set.Iic y :=
      fun hSub => hInfinite (hFinite.subset hSub)
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hOut⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hNotSubset
    have hpu : p u = y := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hu
    have hyu : y < h u := lt_of_not_ge hOut
    change (Nat.rfind (test y)).Dom
    refine Nat.rfind_dom.mpr ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [test, hpu, hyu]
    · intro m _
      exact trivial

external.usage: Apply partial minimization to the total Boolean test for p(u) = y and y < h(u), with y as the search parameter.
An admissible candidate makes the search converge because every earlier Boolean test has a defined value.
Take the pullback along h of the finite interval Set.Iic y using the hypothesis of finite singleton fibres.
Recover the successful Boolean test from a returned index. The specification also ensures that all smaller indices fail, matching the article’s least-witness convention.
Postcompose the partial least-index search with the total computable map h to give exactly f_h.

PriorityRequirements.proof:
by
  intro φ V stage hφ hsurj hV _ hstage hmono hunion K
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §4, pp. 8–10.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8
  -- Use the fixed computable order by pair codes and allow every number as
  -- a marker. The trace is selected before the hypotheses on A are used.
  -- Family coverage is used when applying these requirements to a newly
  -- constructed family. This endpoint verifies each family in the given list.
  let before (q r : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := Nat.pair q.1 q.2 < Nat.pair r.1 r.2
  have horder : IsStrictTotalOrder (ℕ × ℕ) before :=
    Nat.pairEquiv.injective.isStrictTotalOrder_onFun (· < ·)
  have hpairCode : Primrec (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => Nat.pair q.1 q.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd
  have hbefore : ComputablePred (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ) => before p.1 p.2) :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (hpairCode.comp Primrec.fst) (hpairCode.comp Primrec.snd)).computablePred
  have hM : Nat.RecursiveIn
      {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0))}
      (fun m : ℕ => Part.some (@ite ℕ (m ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℕ)) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
    have hconst : Nat.RecursiveIn
        {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0))}
        (fun _ => Part.some 1) :=
      RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp (Computable.const 1).computableIn
    refine hconst.of_eq fun m => ?_
    simp
  obtain ⟨T, hce, hsigma⟩ :=
    PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace φ stage Set.univ before
      hφ hsurj hstage horder hbefore hM
  exact PriorityRequirements.finish φ V stage hφ hV hmono hunion T hce hsigma
PriorityRequirements.support:
namespace PriorityRequirements

def haltingOracle (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {n | (φ n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2).Dom}

theorem pair_mem_haltingOracle (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ) (e x : ℕ) :
    Nat.pair e x ∈ haltingOracle φ ↔ (φ e x).Dom := by
  simp [haltingOracle]

-- Alphabeta Math, thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete, Step 1.1.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete
-- Joint partial recursiveness of φ and computable unpairing give a
-- partial-recursive evaluator on the packed inputs. Its domain is K.
theorem haltingOracle_re (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ) (hφ : Partrec₂ φ) :
    REPred (fun n => n ∈ haltingOracle φ) := by
  exact (hφ.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair)
    (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)).dom_re

/-- One query for the fixed-stage stability test in §4, p. 8. -/
theorem stabilityQuery
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ)
    (surjective : ∀ f : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec f → ∃ e, φ e = f)
    (row : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (hrow : Computable fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ =>
      Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (row p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) :
    ∃ query : ℕ → ℕ, Computable query ∧ ∀ e x t,
      query (Nat.pair e (Nat.pair x t)) ∉ haltingOracle φ ↔
        ∀ r, t ≤ r → row e x r = row e x t := by
  classical
  -- Alphabeta Math, thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete, Step 1.2.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete
  -- Search offsets d at or after t. Comparing the two computable row codes
  -- gives a total computable witness predicate, which suffices for the
  -- minimization in Step 1.2 even without a primitive-recursive matrix.
  let input (p : ℕ × ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ :=
    (p.1.unpair.1, p.1.unpair.2.unpair.1, p.1.unpair.2.unpair.2 + p.2)
  let code (p : ℕ × ℕ) := Finset.equivBitIndices.symm
    (row (input p).1 (input p).2.1 (input p).2.2)
  have outer : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.unpair) :=
    Computable.unpair.comp Computable.fst
  have inner : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.unpair.2.unpair) :=
    Computable.unpair.comp (Computable.snd.comp outer)
  have offset : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => p.1.unpair.2.unpair.2 + p.2) :=
    Primrec.nat_add.to_comp.comp (Computable.snd.comp inner) Computable.snd
  have hcode : Computable code := hrow.comp
    ((Computable.fst.comp outer).pair ((Computable.fst.comp inner).pair offset))
  let changed (p : ℕ × ℕ) := code p ≠ code (p.1, 0)
  have hchanged : ComputablePred changed :=
    ((Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp.comp hcode
      (hcode.comp (Computable.fst.pair (Computable.const 0)))).computablePred).not
  let search (n : ℕ) := Nat.rfind (fun d => Part.some (decide (changed (n, d))))
  have hsearch : Partrec search := Partrec.rfind hchanged.decide.partrec
  have hdom (n : ℕ) : (search n).Dom ↔ ∃ d, changed (n, d) := by
    simpa [search] using (Nat.rfind_dom (p := fun d => Part.some (decide (changed (n, d)))))
  -- Step 2.1 uses an index depending on the parameter and queries it at 0.
  -- Unary surjectivity supplies one index here, and the query input carries
  -- the packed triple. FixedStageRowStability assumes an AcceptableNumbering
  -- and supplies a tape decider. This argument uses unary surjectivity and
  -- gives the computable query with its exact negative-answer condition
  -- required by PriorityCodedVisitTrace.
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := surjective search hsearch
  refine ⟨Nat.pair i, (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.const i) Primrec.id).to_comp, ?_⟩
  intro e x t
  rw [show Nat.pair i (Nat.pair e (Nat.pair x t)) ∉ haltingOracle φ ↔
    ¬ (φ i (Nat.pair e (Nat.pair x t))).Dom from not_congr (pair_mem_haltingOracle ..),
    hi, hdom, not_exists]
  simp only [changed, not_not, code, input, Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.add_zero,
    EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h r hr
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hr] using h (r - t)
  · intro h d
    exact h (t + d) (Nat.le_add_right t d)

theorem finiteRowExhaustion
    {row : ℕ → Finset ℕ} {V : Set ℕ}
    (monotone : Monotone row) (union : ∀ y, y ∈ V ↔ ∃ s, y ∈ row s)
    (finite : V.Finite) :
    ∃ t, (↑(row t) : Set ℕ) = V ∧ ∀ r, t ≤ r → row r = row t := by
  classical
  let witness (y : ℕ) : ℕ := if hy : y ∈ V then ((union y).mp hy).choose else 0
  let t := finite.toFinset.sup witness
  have exhausted : (↑(row t) : Set ℕ) = V := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      exact (union y).mpr ⟨t, hy⟩
    · intro hy
      have hw : y ∈ row (witness y) := by
        rw [show witness y = ((union y).mp hy).choose by simp [witness, hy]]
        exact ((union y).mp hy).choose_spec
      exact monotone (Finset.le_sup (f := witness) (finite.mem_toFinset.mpr hy)) hw
  refine ⟨t, exhausted, fun r hr => Finset.Subset.antisymm ?_ (monotone hr)⟩
  intro y hy
  change y ∈ (↑(row t) : Set ℕ)
  rw [exhausted]
  exact (union y).mpr ⟨r, hy⟩

theorem stabilizedRow
    {row : ℕ → Finset ℕ} {V : Set ℕ} (monotone : Monotone row)
    (union : ∀ y, y ∈ V ↔ ∃ s, y ∈ row s)
    {t : ℕ} (stable : ∀ r, t ≤ r → row r = row t) :
    (↑(row t) : Set ℕ) = V := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    exact (union y).mpr ⟨t, hy⟩
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (union y).mp hy
    have hm := monotone (le_max_left s t) hs
    rwa [stable (max s t) (le_max_right s t)] at hm

theorem rowGraphRE {V : ℕ → ℕ → Set ℕ}
    (graphRE : REPred (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => p.2.2 ∈ V p.1 p.2.1)) (e : ℕ) :
    REPred (fun z : ℕ => z ∈ {z | ∃ x y, y ∈ V e x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}) := by
  have decode : Computable (fun z : ℕ => (e, z.unpair)) :=
    (Computable.const e).pair Computable.unpair
  apply REPred.of_eq (graphRE.comp decode)
  intro z
  change z.unpair.2 ∈ V e z.unpair.1 ↔ ∃ x y, y ∈ V e x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨z.unpair.1, z.unpair.2, hz, (Nat.pair_unpair z).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩
    simpa using h

def UpperCandidate (row : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (s e : ℕ) (Z : Set ℕ) (q : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop :=
  q.1 ≤ s ∧ q.2 ≤ s ∧
    (∀ m ∈ row e q.1 q.2, m ≤ s ∧ m ∉ Z) ∧
    ∀ r, q.2 ≤ r → row e q.1 r = row e q.1 q.2

/-- Laws needed for verification of the concrete bounded-visit construction.
The trace data themselves depend on the enumerations and admissible markers. -/
structure VerificationTrace (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ)
    (row : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) (M : Set ℕ) where
  content : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ
  marker : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ
  chosenPair : ℕ → ℕ → Option (ℕ × ℕ)
  done : ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  contentInitial : content 0 0 = ∅
  markerInitial : ∀ e, marker 0 0 e = none
  doneInitial : ∀ e, ¬ done 0 e
  contentCarry : ∀ s, content (s + 1) 0 = content s s
  contentPersists : ∀ s j k, j ≤ k → k ≤ s → content s j ⊆ content s k
  markerCarry : ∀ s e, marker (s + 1) 0 e = marker s s e
  doneNext : ∀ s e, done (s + 1) e ↔ done s e ∨ (chosenPair s e).isSome
  action : ∀ s e q, chosenPair s e = some q →
    2 * e < s ∧ ¬ done s e ∧
    UpperCandidate row s e {m | ∃ j, 2 * j + 1 < 2 * e ∧ marker s (2 * e) j = some m} q ∧
    row e q.1 q.2 ⊆ content s s
  upperProgress : ∀ s e q, 2 * e < s → ¬ done s e →
    UpperCandidate row s e {m | ∃ j, 2 * j + 1 < 2 * e ∧ marker s (2 * e) j = some m} q →
    (chosenPair s e).isSome
  lowerProgress : ∀ s e m, 2 * e + 1 < s → marker s (2 * e + 1) e = none →
    m ≤ s → m ∈ M → ¬ (φ e m).Dom → m ∉ content s (2 * e + 1) →
    (∀ j, marker s (2 * e + 1) j ≠ some m) → (marker s (2 * e + 2) e).isSome
  enterContent : ∀ s k m, k < s → m ∈ content s (k + 1) → m ∉ content s k →
    ∃ i q, k = 2 * i ∧ chosenPair s i = some q ∧ m ∈ row i q.1 q.2
  enterMarker : ∀ s k e m, k < s → marker s (k + 1) e = some m → marker s k e ≠ some m →
    k = 2 * e + 1 ∧ m ≤ s
  active : ∀ s k e m, k ≤ s → marker s k e = some m →
    m ∈ M ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom ∧ m ∉ content s k
  cancellation : ∀ s k e m, k < s → marker s k e = some m → marker s (k + 1) e = none →
    ∃ i q, k = 2 * i ∧ 2 * i < 2 * e + 1 ∧ chosenPair s i = some q
  noReplacement : ∀ s k e m, k < s → marker s k e = some m →
    marker s (k + 1) e = none ∨ marker s (k + 1) e = some m
  contentBound : ∀ s k m, m ∈ content s k → m ≤ s
  markerBound : ∀ s k e m, marker s k e = some m → m ≤ s

namespace VerificationTrace

variable {φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ} {row : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {M : Set ℕ}

def output (T : VerificationTrace φ row M) : Set ℕ :=
  {m | ∃ s, m ∈ T.content s s}

theorem once (T : VerificationTrace φ row M) (e s t : ℕ)
    (hs : ∃ q, T.chosenPair s e = some q) (ht : ∃ q, T.chosenPair t e = some q) : s = t := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ht
  have persists (u v : ℕ) (huv : u ≤ v) (h : T.done u e) : T.done v e := by
    induction v, huv using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact h
    | succ v _ ih => exact (T.doneNext v e).mpr (.inl ih)
  rcases lt_trichotomy s t with hl | he | hg
  · exact ((T.action t e p hp).2.1
      (persists (s + 1) t hl ((T.doneNext s e).mpr (.inr (by simp [hq]))))).elim
  · exact he
  · exact ((T.action s e q hq).2.1
      (persists (t + 1) s hg ((T.doneNext t e).mpr (.inr (by simp [hp]))))).elim

theorem stabilization (T : VerificationTrace φ row M) :
    (∀ e, ∃ s₀, ∀ s i, s₀ < s → 2 * i < 2 * e + 1 →
      ¬ ∃ q, T.chosenPair s i = some q) ∧
    (∀ e, ∃ s₁ final, ∀ s k, s₁ ≤ s → k ≤ s → T.marker s k e = final) ∧
    (∀ p, ∃ (s₁ : ℕ) (Z : Set ℕ), Z.Finite ∧ ∀ s k, s₁ ≤ s → k ≤ s →
      {m | ∃ e, 2 * e + 1 < p ∧ T.marker s k e = some m} = Z) := by
  -- §4, p. 9 charges each cancellation to a higher upper action.
  -- The trace supplier supplies that attribution and its permanent flags
  -- prove once-only action. The stabilization supplier needs neither the
  -- allocation criterion for markers nor how the searches are computed.
  have h := FiniteInjuryAndStabilization.of_trace
    (fun s e => ∃ q, T.chosenPair s e = some q) T.marker T.markerCarry T.once
    (fun s k e m hk hm hn => by
      obtain ⟨i, q, hki, hei, hq⟩ := T.cancellation s k e m hk hm hn
      exact ⟨i, hki, hei, q, hq⟩)
    T.noReplacement
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨s₀, hquiet, _, _⟩ := h.2.1 e
  exact ⟨s₀, hquiet⟩

theorem upper_met (T : VerificationTrace φ row M) (V : ℕ → ℕ → Set ℕ)
    (monotone : ∀ e x, Monotone (row e x))
    (union : ∀ e x y, y ∈ V e x ↔ ∃ s, y ∈ row e x s)
    (e : ℕ)
    (avoid : ∀ Z : Set ℕ, Z.Finite → Z ⊆ M →
      ∃ x, (V e x).Finite ∧ V e x ∩ Z = ∅) :
    ∃ x, (V e x).Finite ∧ V e x ⊆ T.output := by
  classical
  -- Cintioli, §4, p. 10, upper verification. First reduce to showing
  -- there was an action. The selected row is the full finite row by stability.
  suffices action : ∃ s q, T.chosenPair s e = some q by
    obtain ⟨s, q, hq⟩ := action
    obtain ⟨_, _, hcand, hcontent⟩ := T.action s e q hq
    have eq := stabilizedRow (monotone e q.1) (union e q.1) hcand.2.2.2
    refine ⟨q.1, eq ▸ Finset.finite_toSet _, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    rw [← eq] at hm
    exact ⟨s, hcontent hm⟩
  by_contra absent
  have notDone (s : ℕ) : ¬ T.done s e := by
    induction s with
    | zero => exact T.doneInitial e
    | succ s ih =>
      intro hs
      rcases (T.doneNext s e).mp hs with hd | hq
      · exact ih hd
      · exact absent ⟨s, Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hq⟩
  obtain ⟨S, Z, hfinite, hrestraints⟩ := T.stabilization.2.2 (2 * e)
  have hM : Z ⊆ M := by
    intro m hm
    rw [← hrestraints S 0 le_rfl (Nat.zero_le S)] at hm
    obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := hm
    exact (T.active S 0 j m (Nat.zero_le S) hj).1
  obtain ⟨x, hfin, hdisjoint⟩ := avoid Z hfinite hM
  obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := finiteRowExhaustion (monotone e x) (union e x) hfin
  let s := max (max S (2 * e + 1)) (max (max x t) ((row e x t).sup id))
  have hS : S ≤ s := by dsimp [s]; omega
  have he : 2 * e < s := by dsimp [s]; omega
  have hs : UpperCandidate row s e
      {m | ∃ j, 2 * j + 1 < 2 * e ∧ T.marker s (2 * e) j = some m} (x, t) := by
    refine ⟨by dsimp [s]; omega, by dsimp [s]; omega, ?_, ht⟩
    intro m hm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have bound : m ≤ (row e x t).sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hm
      dsimp [s]
      omega
    · rw [hrestraints s (2 * e) hS he.le]
      intro hz
      have hv : m ∈ V e x := (union e x m).mpr ⟨t, hm⟩
      have hempty : m ∈ V e x ∩ Z := ⟨hv, hz⟩
      simp [hdisjoint] at hempty
  exact absent ⟨s, Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (T.upperProgress s e (x, t) he (notDone s) hs)⟩

theorem lower_met (T : VerificationTrace φ row M) (e : ℕ)
    (unbounded : ∀ b, ∃ m, b < m ∧ m ∈ M ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom) :
    ∃ m, m ∈ M ∧ m ∉ T.output ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom := by
  classical
  -- Cintioli, §4, pp. 9–10, lower verification. Work after all higher
  -- actions, all higher restraints and the chosen lower strategy stabilize.
  -- For restricted M the witness must be unbounded in M outside dom(φ e).
  -- Lemma 4 gives that unboundedness directly for M = Set.univ.
  obtain ⟨S₀, hquiet⟩ := T.stabilization.1 e
  obtain ⟨S₁, final, hfinal⟩ := T.stabilization.2.1 e
  obtain ⟨S₂, Z, hZ, hrestraints⟩ := T.stabilization.2.2 (2 * e + 1)
  let bound := max (max S₀ S₁) (max (max S₂ (2 * e + 1)) (hZ.toFinset.sup id))
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hM, hdom⟩ := unbounded bound
  have large₀ : S₀ < m := by dsimp [bound] at hm; omega
  have large₁ : S₁ ≤ m := by dsimp [bound] at hm; omega
  have large₂ : S₂ ≤ m := by dsimp [bound] at hm; omega
  let k := 2 * e + 1
  have visit : k < m := by dsimp [k, bound] at *; omega
  have freshContent (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) : m ∉ T.content m j := by
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : m ≠ 0)
      rw [T.contentCarry]
      exact fun hc => by have := T.contentBound r r (r + 1) hc; omega
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hc
      obtain ⟨i, q, hi, hq, _⟩ := T.enterContent m j m (by omega) hc (ih (by omega))
      exact hquiet m i large₀ (by dsimp [k] at hj; omega) ⟨q, hq⟩
  have freshMarker (i : ℕ) : T.marker m k i ≠ some m := by
    by_cases higher : 2 * i + 1 < k
    · intro hmi
      have hz : m ∈ Z := by
        rw [← hrestraints m k large₂ visit.le]
        exact ⟨i, higher, hmi⟩
      have leZ : m ≤ hZ.toFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) (hZ.mem_toFinset.mpr hz)
      dsimp [bound] at hm
      omega
    · suffices ∀ j ≤ k, T.marker m j i ≠ some m from this k le_rfl
      intro j hj
      induction j with
      | zero =>
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : m ≠ 0)
        rw [T.markerCarry]
        exact fun hmi => by have := T.markerBound r r i (r + 1) hmi; omega
      | succ j ih =>
        intro hmi
        have := (T.enterMarker m j i m (by omega) hmi (ih (by omega))).1
        omega
  have live : ∃ a, final = some a := by
    cases hmk : T.marker m k e with
    | some a => exact ⟨a, (hfinal m k large₁ visit.le).symm.trans hmk⟩
    | none =>
      have hnew := T.lowerProgress m e m visit hmk le_rfl hM hdom
        (freshContent k le_rfl) freshMarker
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hnew
      exact ⟨a, (hfinal m (2 * e + 2) large₁ (by dsimp [k] at visit; omega)).symm.trans ha⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := live
  have late (s : ℕ) (hs : S₁ ≤ s) := T.active s s e a le_rfl ((hfinal s s hs le_rfl).trans ha)
  refine ⟨a, (late m large₁).1, ?_, (late m large₁).2.1⟩
  rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
  -- A live final marker lies outside every sufficiently late content.
  -- Across-stage monotonicity carries any earlier entry to such a stage.
  have forward (s : ℕ) (hs : a ∈ T.content s s) : a ∈ T.content (s + 1) (s + 1) := by
    have start : a ∈ T.content (s + 1) 0 := by rwa [T.contentCarry]
    exact T.contentPersists (s + 1) 0 (s + 1) (Nat.zero_le _) le_rfl start
  have persisted : ∀ r, s ≤ r → a ∈ T.content r r := by
    intro r hr
    induction r, hr using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact hs
    | succ r _ ih => exact forward r ih
  exact (late (max s S₁) (le_max_right _ _)).2.2 (persisted _ (le_max_left _ _))

end VerificationTrace

/-- A total stage-code computation gives a semidecision by searching its stages. -/
theorem stageDomain {O : Set (ℕ →. ℕ)} (content : ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (hcode : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun s => Part.some (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (content s)))) :
    ∃ f : ℕ →. ℕ, Nat.RecursiveIn O f ∧ ∀ m, (f m).Dom ↔ ∃ s, m ∈ content s := by
  -- Alphabeta Math, thm-sigma-one-sets-are-exactly-ce-sets, Step 1.1.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-sigma-one-sets-are-exactly-ce-sets
  -- Replace the primitive-recursive matrix by the total oracle test from
  -- hcode and the bit test. Relative minimization searches these stage codes.
  let code (s : ℕ) := Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (content s)
  let test (n : ℕ) := bif n.unpair.1.testBit n.unpair.2 then 0 else 1
  have pow : Primrec₂ ((· ^ ·) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) := by
    apply Primrec₂.nat_iff.mpr
    simpa [Nat.unpaired] using Nat.Primrec.succ.comp Nat.Primrec.pow
  have testBit : Primrec₂ Nat.testBit := by
    apply (Primrec.eq.decide.comp
      (Primrec.nat_mod.comp (Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.fst
        (pow.comp (Primrec.const 2) Primrec.snd)) (Primrec.const 2)) (Primrec.const 1)).of_eq
    intro p
    exact Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq.symm
  have htest : Primrec test :=
    Primrec.cond (testBit.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair)
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)) (Primrec.const 0) (Primrec.const 1)
  have testRec : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (test n)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp htest.computableIn
  have readCode : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (code n.unpair.2)) := by
    apply (hcode.comp (Nat.RecursiveIn.right (O := O))).of_eq
    intro n
    change (Part.some n.unpair.2).bind (fun s => Part.some (code s)) = _
    rw [Part.bind_some]
  let f (m : ℕ) := Nat.rfind fun s => Part.some ((code s).testBit m)
  have indicator : Nat.RecursiveIn O
      (fun n => Part.some (test (Nat.pair (code n.unpair.2) n.unpair.1))) := by
    apply (testRec.comp (readCode.pair Nat.RecursiveIn.left)).of_eq
    intro n
    change ((Part.some (Nat.pair (code n.unpair.2)) <*> Part.some n.unpair.1).bind
      (fun p => Part.some (test p))) = _
    rw [show (Part.some (Nat.pair (code n.unpair.2)) <*> Part.some n.unpair.1) =
        Part.some (Nat.pair (code n.unpair.2) n.unpair.1) from (pure_seq ..), Part.bind_some]
  refine ⟨f, indicator.rfind.of_eq ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    dsimp [f]
    congr 1
    funext s
    simp only [Nat.unpair_pair, Part.map_some, test]
    cases (code s).testBit m <;> rfl
  · intro m
    have testMem (s : ℕ) : (code s).testBit m ↔ m ∈ content s := by
      rw [← Nat.mem_bitIndices, ← List.mem_toFinset, ← Finset.equivBitIndices_apply]
      simp [code]
    change (Nat.rfind fun s => Part.some ((code s).testBit m)).Dom ↔ _
    rw [Nat.rfind_dom (p := fun s => Part.some ((code s).testBit m))]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, _⟩
      exact ⟨s, (testMem s).mp (Part.mem_some_iff.mp hs).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
      exact ⟨s, Part.mem_some_iff.mpr ((testMem s).mpr hs).symm, fun _ => Part.some_dom _⟩

/-- Assemble the reviewed endpoint once the concrete trace and its two
effectivity certificates are supplied. -/
theorem finish
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℕ → Set ℕ) (stage : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (hφ : Partrec₂ φ)
    (hV : REPred (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => p.2.2 ∈ V p.1 p.2.1))
    (hmono : ∀ e x, Monotone (stage e x))
    (hunion : ∀ e x y, y ∈ V e x ↔ ∃ s, y ∈ stage e x s)
    (T : VerificationTrace φ stage Set.univ)
    (hce : (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability (haltingOracle φ)).2.1 T.output)
    (hsigma : {xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output} ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1) :
  let levelTwo := _root_.ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (_root_.Nat.le_succ 1)
  let unary (B : _root_.Set _root_.Nat) : _root_.Set (_root_.Fin 1 → _root_.Nat) :=
    {xs | xs 0 ∈ B}
  let encode (n : _root_.Nat) := _root_.List.replicate n _root_.Bool.true
  let decode (w : _root_.List _root_.Bool) : _root_.Option _root_.Nat :=
    if encode (_root_.List.length w) = w then _root_.Option.some (_root_.List.length w)
    else _root_.Option.none
  let ce : _root_.Set _root_.Nat → Prop :=
    _root_.ComputablyEnumerableSet encode decode
      (_root_.List.replicate_left_injective _root_.Bool.true)
      (fun n => by simp [decode, encode])
      (fun w hw => _root_.ite_eq_right (fun h => hw ⟨_root_.List.length w, h⟩))
  ∃ N : _root_.Set _root_.Nat,
    let P : _root_.Set _root_.Nat := Nᶜ
    (_root_.RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability (haltingOracle φ)).2.1 N ∧
    unary N ∈ levelTwo.1 ∧
    unary P ∈ levelTwo.2.1 ∧
    ∀ A : _root_.Set _root_.Nat,
      let cyl : _root_.Set _root_.Nat :=
        {z | ∃ x n : _root_.Nat, x ∈ A ∧ z = _root_.Nat.pair x n}
      ¬ _root_.ComputablePred (fun x : _root_.Nat => x ∈ A) →
      ¬ (_root_.OneOneReducible (fun x : _root_.Nat => x ∈ A) (fun x : _root_.Nat => x ∈ cyl) ∧
         _root_.OneOneReducible (fun x : _root_.Nat => x ∈ cyl) (fun x : _root_.Nat => x ∈ A)) →
      ¬ ce A →
      ¬ ce (Aᶜ) →
      let upper (e : _root_.Nat) : Prop :=
        (∀ x y : _root_.Nat, y ∈ V e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
          ∃ x : _root_.Nat, _root_.Set.Finite (V e x) ∧ V e x ⊆ N
      let lower (e : _root_.Nat) : Prop :=
        (∀ x y : _root_.Nat, y ∈ φ e x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
          ∃ m : _root_.Nat, m ∉ N ∪ {x : _root_.Nat | _root_.Part.Dom (φ e x)}
      ∀ p : _root_.Nat, if p % 2 = 0 then upper (p / 2) else lower (p / 2) := by
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §4, pp. 8–10.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8
  -- The article-specific Alphabeta Math portal and defect report both
  -- returned HTTP 404. The numbered citations refer to the shared library.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  intro levelTwo unary encode decode ce
  refine ⟨T.output, ?_⟩
  intro P
  refine ⟨hce, hsigma, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Post's theorem, Step 3.1, takes the complement to obtain the Π clause.
    -- In the reviewed unary encoding, pulling back along evaluation at 0
    -- commutes with complement, so the Π goal uses the same Σ₂ certificate.
    change ({xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output}ᶜᶜ : Set (Fin 1 → ℕ)) ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1
    simpa using hsigma
  intro A cyl hnonrec hnoncyl hnonCE hncoCE upper lower p
  by_cases even : p % 2 = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left even]
    intro homogeneous
    -- Lemma 2 consumes the c.e. graph with the true-bit encoding.
    -- Alphabeta Math, thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable, Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
    -- Fix e and pull the RE graph back by unpairing. The Nat supplier
    -- nat_rePred_iff handles both the empty graph and the total computable
    -- range for a nonempty graph, encoded by copies of true.
    exact T.upper_met V hmono hunion (p / 2) fun Z hZ _ =>
      FiniteMarkerAvoidance A (V (p / 2)) hnoncyl hnonCE hncoCE
        ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp (rowGraphRE hV _))
        homogeneous Z hZ
  · rw [ite_eq_right even]
    intro ascending
    -- Lemma 4 applies to the partial-recursive e-th section of the
    -- supplied enumeration and gives arbitrarily large omitted inputs.
    have complementInfinite := CofiniteDomainLemma A (φ (p / 2)) hnonrec hnoncyl
      (hφ.comp (Computable.const (p / 2)) Computable.id) ascending
    obtain ⟨m, _, hm, hnotdom⟩ := T.lower_met (p / 2) fun b => by
      obtain ⟨m, hmdom, hmb⟩ := complementInfinite.exists_gt b
      exact ⟨m, hmb, Set.mem_univ m, hmdom⟩
    exact ⟨m, fun h => h.elim hm hnotdom⟩

/-- Read the verification data directly from the decoded visits. The
    construction and its invariants work for any admissible marker set. -/
def VerificationTrace.ofCoded {φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ}
    {row : PriorityCodedTrace.Rows} {M : Set ℕ}
    {U : PriorityCodedTrace.UpperSearch} {L : PriorityCodedTrace.LowerSearch}
    (laws : PriorityCodedTrace.Laws φ row M U L) : VerificationTrace φ row M where
  content := PriorityCodedTrace.content row U L
  marker := PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L
  chosenPair := PriorityCodedTrace.chosenPair row U L
  done := PriorityCodedTrace.done row U L
  contentInitial := laws.contentInitial
  markerInitial := laws.markerInitial
  doneInitial := laws.doneInitial
  contentCarry := laws.contentCarry
  contentPersists := laws.contentPersists
  markerCarry := laws.markerCarry
  doneNext := laws.doneNext
  action := fun s e q hq => by
    -- The concrete upper search holds the higher markers in a bit mask.
    -- Its membership statement gives the set restraint used in §4, p. 10.
    obtain ⟨hvisit, hdone, hcand, hcontent⟩ := laws.action s e q hq
    exact ⟨hvisit, hdone,
      by simpa only [UpperCandidate, PriorityCodedTrace.UpperCandidate,
        PriorityCodedTrace.restraints, PriorityCodedTrace.memMarkerSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        using hcand,
      hcontent⟩
  upperProgress := fun s e q hvisit hdone hcand =>
    laws.upperProgress s e q hvisit hdone (by
      simpa only [UpperCandidate, PriorityCodedTrace.UpperCandidate,
        PriorityCodedTrace.restraints, PriorityCodedTrace.memMarkerSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        using hcand)
  lowerProgress := laws.lowerProgress
  enterContent := laws.enterContent
  enterMarker := laws.enterMarker
  active := fun s k e m _ hm => laws.active s k e m hm
  cancellation := fun s k e m hk hm hn => by
    obtain ⟨i, q, hi, hpriority, hq, _⟩ := laws.cancellation s k e m hk hm hn
    exact ⟨i, q, hi, hpriority, hq⟩
  noReplacement := laws.noReplacement
  contentBound := laws.contentBound
  markerBound := laws.markerBound

/-- Relative enumeration and the unary hierarchy bound for a trace with
    a recursive final-content code in the paired halting oracle. -/
theorem VerificationTrace.output_effective
    {φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ} {row : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {M : Set ℕ}
    (T : VerificationTrace φ row M) (hφ : Partrec₂ φ)
    (hcode : Nat.RecursiveIn
      {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0))}
      (fun s => Part.some (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (T.content s s)))) :
    (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability (haltingOracle φ)).2.1 T.output ∧
      {xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output} ∈
        (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1 := by
  -- Article §4, p. 10 passes from finite stage actions to an oracle
  -- enumeration. The total recursive-in-K code is for the finite content
  -- at a specified stage. Searching over stages produces a partial
  -- semidecision for their union. SingletonOracleTapeCompilation turns
  -- precisely this domain into the acceptance set of a tape program.
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hdom⟩ := stageDomain (fun s => T.content s s) hcode
  have heq : {m | (f m).Dom} = T.output := Set.ext hdom
  have hce : (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability (haltingOracle φ)).2.1 T.output := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact (SingletonOracleTapeCompilation (haltingOracle φ)).1 f hf
  -- Alphabeta Math, Post's theorem, Step 2.1, at n = 0.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-posts-theorem
  -- The accepting-run supplier formalizes the transcript direction at
  -- the required level for any c.e. oracle. haltingOracle_re supplies
  -- the oracle's c.e. hypothesis from joint partial recursiveness of φ.
  exact ⟨hce, CETapeOracleSigmaTwo (haltingOracle φ) T.output (haltingOracle_re φ hφ) hce⟩

/-- Build and certify a trace with the given computable pair order and
    halting-oracle-computable admissibility test for lower markers. -/
theorem existsEffectiveTrace
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ) (row : PriorityCodedTrace.Rows)
    (M : Set ℕ) (pairBefore : (ℕ × ℕ) → (ℕ × ℕ) → Prop)
    (hφ : Partrec₂ φ)
    (hsurj : ∀ f : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec f → ∃ e, φ e = f)
    (hrow : Computable fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ =>
      Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (row p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2))
    (horder : IsStrictTotalOrder (ℕ × ℕ) pairBefore)
    (hbefore : ComputablePred (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ) => pairBefore p.1 p.2))
    (hM : Nat.RecursiveIn
      {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0))}
      (by classical exact fun m => Part.some (if m ∈ M then 1 else 0))) :
    ∃ T : VerificationTrace φ row M,
      (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability (haltingOracle φ)).2.1 T.output ∧
      {xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output} ∈
        (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1 := by
  obtain ⟨query, hquery, hstable⟩ := stabilityQuery φ hsurj row hrow
  -- Keep the content code and visit laws from the same supplier witness.
  -- Its U and L already implement PriorityBoundedOracleSearches. The
  -- adapter retains the pre-visit restraints and uses the final content
  -- from those same searches when obtaining the hierarchy certificate.
  obtain ⟨U, L, _, _, _, _, _, hcontent, _, laws⟩ :=
    PriorityCodedVisitTrace φ row pairBefore query M hrow horder hbefore hquery hstable hM
  exact ⟨VerificationTrace.ofCoded laws,
    (VerificationTrace.ofCoded laws).output_effective hφ hcontent⟩

end PriorityRequirements

external.usage: Used directly in PriorityRequirements.stageDomain to search successive content codes relative to the same oracle. Its paired-input natural output predicate is zero exactly when the given input belongs to the tested stage.
PriorityRequirements.stabilityQuery applies the total stage-code inequality predicate to a packed triple and uses partial-recursive minimization to index the search for a change.
PriorityRequirements.stabilityQuery and PriorityRequirements.stageDomain use the domain criterion. Their witness tests are total, so the smaller-input domain premises follow.

PriorityRequirements.finish applies this to the infinite complement of the partial ascending self-reduction's domain supplied by CofiniteDomainLemma. The resulting unbounded witness condition lets lower_met choose an input above the final higher markers and stage bounds.
The inverse finite-set equivalence codes the stage rows and final contents. Injectivity reflects equality when testing stability, and decoding reflects membership.
In stageDomain, converts the m-th bit of the final-content code to membership in its decoded finite set.
Steps 1.1, 1.2 and 2.1 inspire the paired domain and witness search. The Lean proof uses a single index for a program on packed triples, using unary surjectivity and a computable Boolean test.
Step 1.1 inspires semidecision by a stage witness. The Lean test is total relative to K, using the final-content code and a bit read.
Step 2.1 inspires the accepting-transcript argument implemented by CETapeOracleSigmaTwo for a c.e. oracle. The proof applies the complement argument of Step 3.1 to unary sets.
Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1 inspire the recognizable-to-enumerable bridge. The Lean proof uses the installed Nat range bridge for the fixed row graph with the true-bit encoding.

CETapeOracleSigmaTwo.proof:
by
  intro X N hX hN
  -- The supplier's Program, step and haltsWith unfold to the reviewed tape
  -- semantics, including undelimited input and acceptance specifically at 1.
  change ∃ (s b : Nat) (p : OracleNegativePullback.Program s b), ∀ n,
    OracleNegativePullback.haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1) ↔ n ∈ N at hN
  obtain ⟨s, b, p, hp⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨code, hcode⟩ := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff_exists_code X).mp hX
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, p. 10, uses “Since N is c.e. in 0′, we
  -- have N ∈ Σ⁰₂.” This bridge supplies that implication with an arbitrary
  -- c.e. oracle. Post's theorem, Alphabeta Math step 2.1, supplies the
  -- existential transcript and positive witnesses. One universally quantified
  -- fuel tests all the negative answers because each edge is checked at every
  -- fuel. The hierarchy matrix reads the packed transcript and fuel as its
  -- two bound coordinates. Primrec.fin_app reads those coordinates directly
  -- because the hierarchy already supplies the Fin 1 and Fin 2 tuples.
  -- The article-specific Research Portal and defect report returned HTTP 404.
  -- The numbered proof steps above come from the verified Shared Math Library
  -- sources in the support comments.
  change ∃ R : (Fin 1 → Nat) → (Fin 2 → Nat) → Prop,
    PrimrecRel R ∧ ∀ xs, xs 0 ∈ N ↔
      ∃ witness, ∀ u, R xs (Fin.cons witness (Fin.cons u Fin.elim0))
  refine ⟨fun xs ys => CETapeSigmaTwo.check p code (xs 0) (ys 0) (ys 1) = true, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hfree : Primrec (fun a : (Fin 1 → Nat) × (Fin 2 → Nat) => a.1 0) :=
      Primrec.fin_app.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const 0)
    have hwitness : Primrec (fun a : (Fin 1 → Nat) × (Fin 2 → Nat) => a.2 0) :=
      Primrec.fin_app.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 0)
    have hfuel : Primrec (fun a : (Fin 1 → Nat) × (Fin 2 → Nat) => a.2 1) :=
      Primrec.fin_app.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 1)
    exact Primrec.eq.comp
      ((CETapeSigmaTwo.primCheck p code).comp (hfree.pair (hwitness.pair hfuel)))
      (Primrec.const true)
  · intro xs
    change xs 0 ∈ N ↔ ∃ witness, ∀ u, CETapeSigmaTwo.check p code (xs 0) witness u = true
    exact (hp (xs 0)).symm.trans (CETapeSigmaTwo.check_correct (p := p) hcode (xs 0))
CETapeOracleSigmaTwo.support:
namespace CETapeSigmaTwo

open OracleNegativePullback (Program Cfg numeral readNumeral halting write step haltsWith)
open Nat.Partrec (Code)

variable {s b : Nat}

/- Alphabeta Math's Post's theorem, step 2.1, uses the finite transcript
   of a halting jump-oracle computation. The same argument applies to any
   c.e. oracle by taking a code for its semidecider. Each transcript entry
   records a reviewed configuration and its positive-query fuel witness.
   See https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-posts-theorem and
   https://alphabetamath.cc/item/lem-oracle-computation-has-a-finite-query-witness
   (steps 1.1 and 2.1). -/

private theorem primNumeral (b : Nat) : Primrec (numeral b) := by
  exact (Primrec.list_map OracleNegativePullback.prim_bits
    ((Primrec.dom_finite (OracleNegativePullback.letterCode (b := b))).comp Primrec.snd).to₂).of_eq
    (OracleNegativePullback.numeral_code b)

-- The supplier's read_output theorem certifies a prepared output at cell
-- zero. Queries start at the current head and may be malformed. Prove
-- primitive recursiveness of the reviewed parser on every tape suffix
-- using the delimiter test, numeral reconstruction and full word equality.
private theorem primRead (b : Nat) : Primrec₂ (readNumeral b) := by
  let tail (p : List (Fin (b + 4)) × Nat) := p.1.drop p.2
  let word (p : List (Fin (b + 4)) × Nat) := (tail p).takeWhile (· != 3)
  let value (p : List (Fin (b + 4)) × Nat) :=
    (word p).foldl (fun acc digit => 2 * acc + digit.val) 0
  have ht : Primrec tail := Primrec.list_drop.comp Primrec.snd Primrec.fst
  have hw : Primrec word :=
    (Primrec.list_takeWhile (Primrec.dom_finite (fun d : Fin (b + 4) => d != 3))).comp ht
  have hfold : Primrec (fun p : Nat × Fin (b + 4) => 2 * p.1 + p.2.val) :=
    Primrec.nat_add.comp (Primrec.nat_double.comp Primrec.fst)
      (Primrec.fin_val.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hv : Primrec value :=
    Primrec.list_foldl hw (Primrec.const 0) (hfold.comp Primrec.snd).to₂
  have hd := Primrec.eq.comp
    ((Primrec.list_getD (2 : Fin (b + 4))).comp ht (Primrec.list_length.comp hw))
    (Primrec.const (3 : Fin (b + 4)))
  exact Primrec.ite (hd.and (Primrec.eq.comp hw ((primNumeral b).comp hv)))
    (Primrec.option_some.comp hv) (Primrec.const none)

private theorem primReplicate {α : Type} [Primcodable α] (a : α) :
    Primrec (fun n : Nat => List.replicate n a) := by
  have hstep : Primrec₂ (fun (_ : Nat) (xs : List α) => a :: xs) :=
    (Primrec.list_cons.comp (Primrec.const a) Primrec.snd).to₂
  refine (Primrec.nat_rec₁ [] hstep).of_eq ?_
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => exact congrArg (List.cons a) ih

private def ordinaryNext (c : Cfg s b) (action : Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) :
    Cfg s b :=
  (action.1, if action.2.2 then c.2.1 + 1 else c.2.1 - 1,
    write 2 c.2.2 c.2.1 action.2.1)

private theorem primOrdinaryNext :
    Primrec₂ (ordinaryNext (s := s) (b := b)) := by
  let head : Cfg s b × (Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) → Nat := fun a => a.1.2.1
  let tape : Cfg s b × (Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) → List (Fin (b + 4)) :=
    fun a => a.1.2.2
  have hh : Primrec head := Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)
  have ht : Primrec tape := Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)
  have hr : Primrec (fun a : Cfg s b × (Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) => a.2.2.2) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hsym : Primrec (fun a : Cfg s b × (Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) => a.2.2.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hlen := Primrec.nat_sub.comp (Primrec.succ.comp hh) (Primrec.list_length.comp ht)
  have hpadded := Primrec.list_append.comp ht ((primReplicate (2 : Fin (b + 4))).comp hlen)
  simpa only [Primrec₂, ordinaryNext, write, Bool.cond_eq_ite] using
    (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd).pair
    ((Primrec.cond hr (Primrec.succ.comp hh) (Primrec.nat_sub.comp hh (Primrec.const 1))).pair
      (Primrec.list_set.comp hpadded (hh.pair hsym)))

private def answers (code : Code) (fuel query : Nat) : Bool :=
  (Code.evaln fuel code query).isSome

private theorem primAnswers (code : Code) : Primrec₂ (answers code) :=
  Primrec.option_isSome.comp (Code.primrec_evaln.comp
    ((Primrec.fst.pair (Primrec.const code)).pair Primrec.snd))

private theorem mem_iff_answers {X : Set Nat} {code : Code}
    (hc : ∀ q, (code.eval q).Dom ↔ q ∈ X) (q : Nat) :
    q ∈ X ↔ ∃ fuel, answers code fuel q = true := by
  rw [← hc, Part.dom_iff_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨out, hout⟩
    obtain ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩ := Code.evaln_complete.mp hout
    exact ⟨fuel, Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨out, hfuel⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨fuel, hfuel⟩
    obtain ⟨out, hout⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hfuel
    exact ⟨out, Code.evaln_sound hout⟩

private abbrev Outcome (s b : Nat) := Cfg s b ⊕ (Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3))

private def inspect (p : Program s b) (c : Cfg s b) : Outcome s b :=
  Sum.casesOn (p c.1)
    (fun ordinary => .inl (ordinaryNext c (ordinary (c.2.2.getD c.2.1 2))))
    (fun branches => Option.casesOn (readNumeral b c.2.2 c.2.1)
      (.inl (branches.2, c.2)) (fun q => .inr (q, branches)))

private theorem primInspect (p : Program s b) : Primrec (inspect p) := by
  let Ordinary := Fin (b + 4) → Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool
  let Query := Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)
  have ordinary : Primrec₂ (fun (c : Cfg s b) (f : Ordinary) =>
      (Sum.inl (ordinaryNext c (f (c.2.2.getD c.2.1 2))) : Outcome s b)) := by
    have hread : Primrec (fun c : Cfg s b => c.2.2.getD c.2.1 2) :=
      (Primrec.list_getD (2 : Fin (b + 4))).comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
        (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
    exact (Primrec.sumInl.comp
      (primOrdinaryNext.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fin_app.comp Primrec.snd
        (hread.comp Primrec.fst)))).to₂
  have query : Primrec₂ (fun (c : Cfg s b) (branches : Query) =>
      (Option.casesOn (readNumeral b c.2.2 c.2.1)
        (.inl (branches.2, c.2)) (fun q => .inr (q, branches)) : Outcome s b)) := by
    have hread : Primrec (fun a : Cfg s b × Query =>
        readNumeral b a.1.2.2 a.1.2.1) :=
      (primRead b).comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
        (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))
    exact (Primrec.option_casesOn hread
      (Primrec.sumInl.comp ((Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd).pair
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)))
      (Primrec.sumInr.comp (Primrec.snd.pair
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst))).to₂).to₂
  exact Primrec.sumCasesOn ((Primrec.dom_finite p).comp Primrec.fst) ordinary query

private abbrev Entry (s b : Nat) := Cfg s b × Nat

/-- A positive query needs the ticket supplied with the source configuration.
A negative query must pass the test at the universally quantified fuel. -/
private def edge (p : Program s b) (code : Code) (u : Nat) (entry : Entry s b)
    (target : Cfg s b) : Bool :=
  let (c, ticket) := entry
  !halting s c.1 && Sum.casesOn (inspect p c)
    (fun next => decide (target = next))
    (fun branches =>
      bif answers code ticket branches.1 then decide (target = (branches.2.1, c.2))
      else !answers code u branches.1 && decide (target = (branches.2.2, c.2)))

private theorem primEdge (p : Program s b) (code : Code) :
    Primrec (fun a : Nat × Entry s b × Cfg s b => edge p code a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2) := by
  let Input := Nat × Entry s b × Cfg s b
  let source (a : Input) := a.2.1.1
  let ticket (a : Input) := a.2.1.2
  let target (a : Input) := a.2.2
  have hs : Primrec source := Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
  have ht : Primrec ticket := Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hd : Primrec target := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  have ordinary : Primrec₂ (fun (a : Input) (next : Cfg s b) =>
      decide (target a = next)) :=
    (Primrec.eq.comp (hd.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd).decide.to₂
  have query : Primrec₂ (fun (a : Input) (branches : Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)) =>
      bif answers code (ticket a) branches.1 then
        decide (target a = (branches.2.1, (source a).2))
      else !answers code a.1 branches.1 &&
        decide (target a = (branches.2.2, (source a).2))) := by
    have hq : Primrec (fun z : Input × (Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)) => z.2.1) :=
      Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
    have hyes := (primAnswers code).comp (ht.comp Primrec.fst) hq
    have hno := Primrec.not.comp ((primAnswers code).comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst) hq)
    have hstate : Primrec (fun z : Input × (Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)) => z.2.2) :=
      Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
    have hrest : Primrec (fun z : Input × (Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)) => (source z.1).2) :=
      Primrec.snd.comp (hs.comp Primrec.fst)
    have hyesTarget : Primrec (fun z : Input × (Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)) =>
        decide (target z.1 = (z.2.2.1, (source z.1).2))) :=
      (Primrec.eq.comp (hd.comp Primrec.fst) ((Primrec.fst.comp hstate).pair hrest)).decide
    have hnoTarget : Primrec (fun z : Input × (Nat × Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3)) =>
        decide (target z.1 = (z.2.2.2, (source z.1).2))) :=
      (Primrec.eq.comp (hd.comp Primrec.fst) ((Primrec.snd.comp hstate).pair hrest)).decide
    exact (Primrec.cond hyes hyesTarget (Primrec.and.comp hno hnoTarget)).to₂
  have hhalt := Primrec.not.comp ((Primrec.dom_finite (halting s)).comp
    (Primrec.fst.comp hs))
  exact Primrec.and.comp hhalt
    (Primrec.sumCasesOn ((primInspect p).comp hs) ordinary query)

private theorem edge_correct {X : Set Nat} {p : Program s b} {code : Code}
    (hc : ∀ q, (code.eval q).Dom ↔ q ∈ X) (c target : Cfg s b) :
    step X p c target ↔ ∃ ticket, ∀ u, edge p code u (c, ticket) target = true := by
  rcases c with ⟨state, head, tape⟩
  cases hp : p state with
  | inl ordinary =>
    rcases ordinary (tape.getD head 2) with ⟨next, letter, right⟩
    simp [step, edge, inspect, ordinaryNext, hp]
  | inr branches =>
    rcases branches with ⟨yes, no⟩
    cases hr : readNumeral b tape head with
    | none => simp [step, edge, inspect, hp, hr]
    | some q =>
      have hq := mem_iff_answers hc q
      simp only [step, edge, inspect, hp, hr,
        Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true']
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hguard, (⟨hmem, htarget⟩ | ⟨hmem, htarget⟩)⟩
        · obtain ⟨ticket, ht⟩ := hq.mp hmem
          exact ⟨ticket, fun u => by simp [hguard, ht, htarget]⟩
        · have hn (u : Nat) : answers code u q = false :=
            Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true (fun h => hmem (hq.mpr ⟨u, h⟩))
          exact ⟨0, fun u => by simp [hguard, hn, htarget]⟩
      · rintro ⟨ticket, ht⟩
        by_cases hpos : answers code ticket q = true
        · have h := ht 0
          simp [hpos] at h
          exact ⟨h.1, Or.inl ⟨hq.mpr ⟨ticket, hpos⟩, h.2⟩⟩
        · have hn := Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true hpos
          have h (u : Nat) := ht u
          simp [hn] at h
          exact ⟨(h 0).1, Or.inr ⟨fun hmem => by
            obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hq.mp hmem
            simp [(h u).2.1] at hu, (h 0).2.2⟩⟩

private def foldTrace (p : Program s b) (code : Code) (u : Nat) (last : Cfg s b)
    (entries : List (Entry s b)) : Bool × Cfg s b :=
  entries.foldr (fun entry acc => (edge p code u entry acc.2 && acc.1, entry.1))
    (true, last)

private theorem primFoldTrace (p : Program s b) (code : Code) :
    Primrec (fun a : Nat × Cfg s b × List (Entry s b) => foldTrace p code a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2) := by
  let Input := Nat × Cfg s b × List (Entry s b)
  have stepCheck : Primrec₂ (fun (a : Input) (z : Entry s b × (Bool × Cfg s b)) =>
      (edge p code a.1 z.1 z.2.2 && z.2.1, z.1.1)) := by
    have he : Primrec (fun z : Input × (Entry s b × (Bool × Cfg s b)) =>
        edge p code z.1.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.2) :=
      (primEdge p code).comp ((Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst).pair
        ((Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd).pair (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))))
    exact ((Primrec.and.comp he (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))).pair
      (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))).to₂
  exact Primrec.list_foldr (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
    ((Primrec.const true).pair (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)) stepCheck

private def firstCfg (last : Cfg s b) : List (Entry s b) → Cfg s b
  | [] => last
  | entry :: _ => entry.1

private theorem foldTrace_first (p : Program s b) (code : Code) (u : Nat) (last : Cfg s b)
    (entries : List (Entry s b)) :
    (foldTrace p code u last entries).2 = firstCfg last entries := by
  cases entries <;> rfl

private theorem foldTrace_cons (p : Program s b) (code : Code) (u : Nat) (last : Cfg s b)
    (entry : Entry s b) (entries : List (Entry s b)) :
    (foldTrace p code u last (entry :: entries)).1 =
      (edge p code u entry (firstCfg last entries) && (foldTrace p code u last entries).1) := by
  change (edge p code u entry (foldTrace p code u last entries).2 &&
    (foldTrace p code u last entries).1) = _
  rw [foldTrace_first]

-- Head induction on the reviewed closure builds the configuration chain
-- and attaches each edge's witness in the same induction. The reverse
-- induction recovers a reviewed edge from each universally tested entry.
private theorem trace_correct {X : Set Nat} {p : Program s b} {code : Code}
    (hc : ∀ q, (code.eval q).Dom ↔ q ∈ X) (first last : Cfg s b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (step X p) first last ↔
      ∃ entries, firstCfg last entries = first ∧
        ∀ u, (foldTrace p code u last entries).1 = true := by
  constructor
  · intro run
    induction run using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
    | refl => exact ⟨[], rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
    | @head c next hstep _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨entries, hfirst, htail⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨ticket, hedge⟩ := (edge_correct hc c next).mp hstep
      refine ⟨(c, ticket) :: entries, rfl, fun u => ?_⟩
      simp only [foldTrace_cons, hfirst, hedge u, htail u, Bool.and_self]
  · rintro ⟨entries, rfl, hall⟩
    induction entries with
    | nil => exact .refl
    | cons entry entries ih =>
      have h (u : Nat) := hall u
      simp only [foldTrace_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head
        ((edge_correct hc entry.1 _).mpr ⟨entry.2, fun u => (h u).1⟩)
        (ih (fun u => (h u).2))

private abbrev Certificate (s b : Nat) := Cfg s b × List (Entry s b)

private def check (p : Program s b) (code : Code) (n witness u : Nat) : Bool :=
  Option.casesOn (Encodable.decode witness : Option (Certificate s b)) false
    (fun cert => decide (cert.1.1 = 1) &&
      decide (foldTrace p code u cert.1 cert.2 = (true, (0, 0, numeral b n))))

private theorem primCheck (p : Program s b) (code : Code) :
    Primrec (fun a : Nat × Nat × Nat => check p code a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2) := by
  let Input := Nat × Nat × Nat
  have hd : Primrec (fun a : Input => Encodable.decode a.2.1 : Input → Option (Certificate s b)) :=
    Primrec.decode.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hcheck : Primrec₂ (fun (a : Input) (cert : Certificate s b) =>
      decide (cert.1.1 = 1) &&
      decide (foldTrace p code a.2.2 cert.1 cert.2 = (true, (0, 0, numeral b a.1)))) := by
    have hscan := (primFoldTrace p code).comp
      ((Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp
        (Primrec.fst : Primrec (Prod.fst : Input × Certificate s b → Input)))).pair Primrec.snd)
    have hstart : Primrec (fun a : Input × Certificate s b =>
        (true, (0, 0, numeral b a.1.1)) : Input × Certificate s b → Bool × Cfg s b) :=
      (Primrec.const true).pair ((Primrec.const 0).pair
        ((Primrec.const 0).pair ((primNumeral b).comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst))))
    have hstate : Primrec (fun a : Input × Certificate s b => a.2.1.1) :=
      Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)
    exact (Primrec.and.comp (Primrec.eq.comp hstate (Primrec.const 1)).decide
      (Primrec.eq.comp hscan hstart).decide).to₂
  exact Primrec.option_casesOn hd (Primrec.const false) hcheck

private theorem check_correct {X : Set Nat} {p : Program s b} {code : Code}
    (hc : ∀ q, (code.eval q).Dom ↔ q ∈ X) (n : Nat) :
    haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1) ↔ ∃ witness, ∀ u, check p code n witness u = true := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, head, tape, hrun, _, hstate⟩
    subst q
    obtain ⟨entries, hfirst, hall⟩ := (trace_correct (code := code) hc _ _).mp hrun
    let cert : Certificate s b := ((1, head, tape), entries)
    refine ⟨Encodable.encode cert, fun u => ?_⟩
    have hscan : foldTrace p code u (1, head, tape) entries = (true, (0, 0, numeral b n)) :=
      Prod.ext (hall u) ((foldTrace_first p code u _ _).trans hfirst)
    simp [check, Encodable.encodek, cert, hscan]
  · rintro ⟨witness, hall⟩
    cases hw : (Encodable.decode witness : Option (Certificate s b)) with
    | none =>
      have h := hall 0
      simp [check, hw] at h
    | some cert =>
      rcases cert with ⟨⟨q, head, tape⟩, entries⟩
      have h (u : Nat) := hall u
      simp only [check, hw, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      have hstate := (h 0).1
      have hfirst : firstCfg (q, head, tape) entries = (0, 0, numeral b n) :=
        (foldTrace_first p code 0 _ _).symm.trans (congrArg Prod.snd (h 0).2)
      refine ⟨q, head, tape, (trace_correct hc _ _).mpr ⟨entries, hfirst, ?_⟩, ?_, hstate⟩
      · intro u
        exact congrArg Prod.fst (h u).2
      · simp [halting, hstate]

end CETapeSigmaTwo

external.usage: In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, test convergence of the fixed ordinary oracle code at the ticket for a yes answer and at the universal fuel for a no answer.
In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, extract a finite fuel witnessing membership in the oracle. This also turns each unsuccessful universal-fuel test into nonmembership.
In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, a successful ticket for an ordinary oracle code entails convergence of that code and certifies oracle membership.
In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, the fixed tape program table on its finite state carrier is primitive recursive. The fixed alphabet conversion, delimiter comparison and halt guard also have finite domains.
In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, extract the query word before the delimiter from the tape suffix at the head.
In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, accumulate the base-two value of the candidate query word before testing equality with its canonical numeral.
In CETapeOracleSigmaTwo, check each entry of the finite transcript with the successor configuration and combine all edge tests into one primitive-recursive Boolean.
