SingletonOracleTapeCompilation.proof:
by
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §2 (p. 2), identifies each set with
  -- its characteristic function and uses relative computability and
  -- relative enumerability without giving a tape compiler.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1
  --
  -- Alphabeta Math, An oracle computation has a finite query witness,
  -- steps 1.1 and 2.1, starts with a halting tape run and replays its
  -- finite queries. Here approximate proves the corresponding finite-use
  -- and replay properties by induction on Nat.RecursiveIn, before a tape
  -- run is available. In the minimization branch, Nat.mem_rfind requires
  -- a successful test and a defined false result at every earlier test.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/lem-oracle-computation-has-a-finite-query-witness
  --
  -- The coordinator suggested a stack of continuations for native
  -- recursion. We use dovetailed ordinary evaluations on finite oracle
  -- prefixes, so the tape needs only a prefix and the original input.
  -- The pairing schedule visits every prefix-length/fuel pair and tests
  -- an exact prefix. The resulting finite loop uses exists_safe_tape
  -- and wrapper_eval for its ordinary word transformer. To reuse
  -- simulate_run, old_run_lift shows that paths ending in a nonhalting
  -- state cannot traverse any of the replaced terminal instructions.
  -- The new query circuit reads the numeral beyond a two-cell header,
  -- records the bit in that header, and restores the head to the origin.
  -- The numeral codec reuses prim_bits, parse_bits, raw_code, numeral_code,
  -- list_prefix_of_getD and read_output from OracleNegativePullback.
  -- Its step_unique and no_terminal_of_progress exclude accepting runs
  -- when no finite approximation yields a result.
  --
  -- These two conclusions use the installed semidecision and total-output
  -- projections of the shared definition. The article-specific collection
  -- and its defect-report URL both returned HTTP 404 when checked.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-relative-computability-and-enumerability
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  intro X
  dsimp only
  have compile {f : Nat →. Nat}
      (hf : Nat.RecursiveIn
        {fun n => Part.some (@ite Nat (n ∈ X) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)} f) :
      ∃ (s b : Nat) (p : OracleNegativePullback.Program s b), ∀ n,
        (OracleNegativePullback.haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1) ↔ (f n).Dom) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ f n, OracleNegativePullback.haltsWith X p n
          (fun _ t => OracleNegativePullback.readNumeral b t 0 = some y)) := by
    obtain ⟨F, hF, ht⟩ := SingletonTape.approximate X f hf
    obtain ⟨test, hc, htest⟩ := SingletonTape.findTest X hF ht
    exact SingletonTape.compileTest X f test hc htest
  constructor
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨s, b, p, hp⟩ := compile hf
    exact ⟨s, b, p, fun n => (hp n).1⟩
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨s, b, p, hp⟩ := compile hf
    exact ⟨s, b, p, fun n => (hp n).2 (f n) (Part.mem_some _)⟩
SingletonOracleTapeCompilation.support:
namespace SingletonTape
open Computable
open scoped Classical

def agrees (X : Set Nat) (w : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ i b, w[i]? = some b → (b = true ↔ i ∈ X)

def tracks {α β : Type} (X : Set Nat) (F : List Bool × α →. β) (f : α →. β) : Prop :=
  (∀ {w a b}, agrees X w → b ∈ F (w, a) → b ∈ f a) ∧
  (∀ {a b}, b ∈ f a → ∃ k : Nat, ∀ w : List Bool,
    agrees X w → k ≤ w.length → b ∈ F (w, a))

theorem tracks_ignore {α β : Type} (X : Set Nat) (f : α →. β) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => f p.2) f :=
  ⟨fun _ h => h, fun h => ⟨0, fun _ _ _ => h⟩⟩

theorem tracks_input {α β γ : Type} {X : Set Nat} {F : List Bool × β →. γ}
    {f : β →. γ} (h : tracks X F f) (g : α → β) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => F (p.1, g p.2)) (fun a => f (g a)) :=
  ⟨fun hw hm => h.1 hw hm, fun hm => h.2 hm⟩

theorem tracks_map {α β γ : Type} {X : Set Nat} {F : List Bool × α →. β}
    {f : α →. β} (h : tracks X F f) (g : α → β → γ) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => (F p).map (g p.2))
      (fun a => (f a).map (g a)) := by
  constructor
  · intro w a c hw hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := (Part.mem_map_iff _).mp hc
    exact Part.mem_map _ (h.1 hw hb)
  · intro a c hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := (Part.mem_map_iff _).mp hc
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h.2 hb
    exact ⟨k, fun w hw hl => Part.mem_map _ (hk w hw hl)⟩

theorem tracks_bind {α β γ : Type} {X : Set Nat} {F : List Bool × α →. β}
    {G : List Bool × (α × β) →. γ} {f : α →. β} {g : α × β →. γ}
    (hf : tracks X F f) (hg : tracks X G g) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => (F p).bind fun b => G (p.1, p.2, b))
      (fun a => (f a).bind fun b => g (a, b)) := by
  constructor
  · intro w a c hw hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hc
    exact Part.mem_bind_iff.mpr ⟨b, hf.1 hw hb, hg.1 hw hbc⟩
  · intro a c hc
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hc
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hf.2 hb
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hg.2 hbc
    refine ⟨max k l, fun w hw hs => Part.mem_bind_iff.mpr ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hk w hw ((le_max_left k l).trans hs)
    · exact hl w hw ((le_max_right k l).trans hs)

theorem getOracle_tracks (X : Set Nat) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × Nat => (p.1[p.2]?.map Bool.toNat : Part Nat))
      (fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ X then 1 else 0)) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro w n y hw hy
    change y ∈ (w[n]?.map Bool.toNat : Part Nat) at hy
    cases hn : w[n]? with
    | none => simp [hn] at hy
    | some b =>
      have h := hw n b hn
      cases b <;> simp_all [Bool.toNat]
  · intro n y hy
    refine ⟨n + 1, fun w hw hn => ?_⟩
    have hn' : n < w.length := hn
    change y ∈ (w[n]?.map Bool.toNat : Part Nat)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hn']
    have h := hw n w[n] (List.getElem?_eq_getElem hn')
    cases he : w[n] <;> simp_all [Bool.toNat]

theorem tracks_rfind {α : Type} {X : Set Nat}
    {F : List Bool × (α × Nat) →. Bool} {f : α × Nat →. Bool}
    (h : tracks X F f) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × α => Nat.rfind fun n => F (p.1, p.2, n))
      (fun a => Nat.rfind fun n => f (a, n)) := by
  constructor
  · intro w a y hw hy
    obtain ⟨hs, hm⟩ := Nat.mem_rfind.mp hy
    exact Nat.mem_rfind.mpr ⟨h.1 hw hs, fun {m} hm' => h.1 hw (hm (m := m) hm')⟩
  · intro a y hy
    obtain ⟨hs, hm⟩ := Nat.mem_rfind.mp hy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h.2 hs
    have uniform (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ y) : ∃ l : Nat, ∀ w : List Bool,
        agrees X w → l ≤ w.length → ∀ j < n, false ∈ F (w, a, j) := by
      induction n with
      | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn)
        obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := h.2 (hm (m := n) hn)
        refine ⟨max l l', fun w hw hs j hj => ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hj | rfl
        · exact hl w hw ((le_max_left l l').trans hs) j hj
        · exact hl' w hw ((le_max_right l l').trans hs)
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := uniform y le_rfl
    exact ⟨max k l, fun w hw hs => Nat.mem_rfind.mpr
      ⟨hk w hw ((le_max_left k l).trans hs),
        fun {m} hm => hl w hw ((le_max_right k l).trans hs) m hm⟩⟩

theorem tracks_prec {X : Set Nat} {G : List Bool × Nat →. Nat}
    {H : List Bool × Nat →. Nat} {g h : Nat →. Nat}
    (hg : tracks X G g) (hh : tracks X H h) :
    tracks X (fun p : List Bool × Nat =>
      let (a, n) := p.2.unpair
      n.rec (G (p.1, a)) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => H (p.1, a.pair (y.pair b)))
      (fun p =>
        let (a, n) := p.unpair
        n.rec (g a) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => h (a.pair (y.pair b))) := by
  have aux (a n : Nat) :
      tracks X (fun p : List Bool × Unit =>
        n.rec (G (p.1, a)) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => H (p.1, a.pair (y.pair b)))
        (fun _ => n.rec (g a) fun y ih => ih.bind fun b => h (a.pair (y.pair b))) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact tracks_input hg (fun _ : Unit => a)
    | succ n ih =>
      exact tracks_bind ih (tracks_input hh (fun p : Unit × Nat => a.pair (n.pair p.2)))
  constructor
  · intro w p b hw hb
    rcases hp : p.unpair with ⟨a, n⟩
    dsimp only at hb ⊢
    rw [hp] at hb ⊢
    obtain ⟨hs, _⟩ := aux a n
    exact hs (a := ()) hw hb
  · intro p b hb
    rcases hp : p.unpair with ⟨a, n⟩
    dsimp only at hb
    rw [hp] at hb
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := aux a n
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hc (a := ()) hb
    exact ⟨k, fun w hw hwk => by dsimp only; simpa only [hp] using hk w hw hwk⟩

theorem approximate (X : Set Nat) (f : Nat →. Nat)
    (hf : Nat.RecursiveIn {fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ X then 1 else 0)} f) :
    ∃ F : List Bool × Nat →. Nat, Partrec F ∧ tracks X F f := by
  classical
  -- The finite-use statement of Alphabeta Math steps 1.1 and 2.1
  -- assumes a completed tape run. Here finiteness and replay are obtained
  -- from the native recursion derivation before constructing a tape.
  have basic {g : Nat → Nat} (hg : Computable g) :
      ∃ F : List Bool × Nat →. Nat, Partrec F ∧ tracks X F (fun n => Part.some (g n)) :=
    ⟨_, (hg.comp Computable.snd).partrec, tracks_ignore X (fun n => Part.some (g n))⟩
  induction hf with
  | zero => exact basic (Computable.const 0)
  | succ => exact basic (Computable.succ)
  | left => exact basic (Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair)
  | right => exact basic (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)
  | oracle g hg =>
    obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hg
    refine ⟨_, ofOption ?_, getOracle_tracks X⟩
    exact Computable.option_map Computable.list_getElem?
      ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.toNat).to_comp.comp Computable.snd).to₂
  | pair hf hg ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ihf
    obtain ⟨G, hG, htG⟩ := ihg
    have hP : Computable₂ (fun (p : (List Bool × Nat) × Nat) b => Nat.pair p.2 b) :=
      (Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst) Computable.snd).to₂
    let lift : (List Bool × Nat) × Nat → List Bool × Nat := Prod.fst
    have hlift : Computable lift := Computable.fst
    refine ⟨_, hF.bind ((hG.comp hlift).map hP).to₂, ?_⟩
    have hh := tracks_input htG (Prod.fst : Nat × Nat → Nat)
    simpa only [seq_eq_bind_map, Part.bind_eq_bind, Part.map_eq_map, Part.bind_map]
      using (tracks_bind htF (tracks_map hh (fun p b => p.2.pair b)))
  | comp hf hg ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ihf
    obtain ⟨G, hG, htG⟩ := ihg
    exact ⟨_, hG.bind (hF.comp ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst).pair Computable.snd)).to₂,
      tracks_bind htG (tracks_input htF Prod.snd)⟩
  | prec hf hg ihf ihg =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ihf
    obtain ⟨G, hG, htG⟩ := ihg
    let c : List Bool × Nat → Nat × Nat := Nat.unpair ∘ Prod.snd
    have hc : Computable c := Computable.unpair.comp Computable.snd
    have hp := Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp
    have step : Computable (fun p : (List Bool × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) =>
        (p.1.1, (c p.1).1.pair (p.2.1.pair p.2.2))) :=
      (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst).pair
        (hp.comp (Computable.fst.comp (hc.comp Computable.fst)) (hp.comp Computable.fst Computable.snd |>.comp Computable.snd))
    refine ⟨_, ?_, tracks_prec htF htG⟩
    exact (Partrec.nat_rec (Computable.snd.comp hc)
      (hF.comp (Computable.fst.pair (Computable.fst.comp hc))) (hG.comp step).to₂).of_eq
        (fun p => by rcases hp' : p.2.unpair with ⟨a, n⟩; simp [c, hp'])
  | rfind hf ih =>
    obtain ⟨F, hF, htF⟩ := ih
    have hP : Computable (fun p : List Bool × (Nat × Nat) => (p.1, p.2.1.pair p.2.2)) :=
      Computable.fst.pair (Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp
        (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd) (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
    have hTest : Computable₂ (fun (_ : List Bool × (Nat × Nat)) (v : Nat) => decide (v = 0)) :=
      (Primrec.eq.decide.comp Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 0)).to_comp.to₂
    let G : List Bool × (Nat × Nat) →. Bool := fun p => (F (p.1, p.2.1.pair p.2.2)).map
      (fun v => decide (v = 0))
    have hG : Partrec G := (hF.comp hP).map hTest
    have htrack := tracks_rfind (tracks_map (tracks_input htF (fun p : Nat × Nat => p.1.pair p.2))
      (fun _ v => decide (v = 0)))
    exact ⟨_, Partrec.rfind ((hG.comp ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst).pair
      ((Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst).pair Computable.snd))).to₂), htrack⟩

end SingletonTape


namespace SingletonTape
open Relation OracleNegativePullback
open OracleTapeSupplier.OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes
open MachineRealization Compiler.Simulator
open scoped Classical

inductive Control | advance | query | answer (b : Bool) | store (b : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

abbrev Label (Q : Type) := Q ⊕ Control

def extend {Q : Type} (M : Machine Q Work) : Machine (Label Q) Work where
  initial := .inl M.initial
  transition
    | .inl q, a => (M.transition q a).map fun cmd => ⟨.inl cmd.state, cmd.write, cmd.move⟩
    | .inr _, _ => none

def liftCfg {Q : Type} (c : OneSided.Cfg Work Q) : OneSided.Cfg Work (Label Q) :=
  ⟨.inl c.state, c.pos, c.cell⟩

theorem extend_run {Q : Type} (M : Machine Q Work) {c d : OneSided.Cfg Work Q}
    (h : StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step M) c d) :
    StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step (extend M)) (liftCfg c) (liftCfg d) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | @tail a z _ h ih =>
    apply ih.tail
    change OneSided.step (extend M) (liftCfg a) = some (liftCfg z)
    have he : OneSided.step (extend M) (liftCfg a) =
        (OneSided.step M a).map liftCfg := by
      simp only [OneSided.step, liftCfg, extend]
      cases M.transition a.state (a.cell a.pos) <;> rfl
    rw [he, h]
    rfl

variable {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] {b : Nat}

abbrev stateCount (Q : Type) [Fintype Q] := OracleNegativePullback.states (Label Q)

noncomputable def code (q : Q) : Fin (stateCount Q + 3) := stateCode (Sum.inl q, false)
noncomputable def ctrl (c : Control) : Fin (stateCount Q + 3) := stateCode (Sum.inr c, false)
def boolLetter (v : Bool) : Letter := if v then 1 else 0

abbrev Instruction (s b : Nat) :=
  Sum (Fin (b + 4) → Fin (s + 3) × Fin (b + 4) × Bool) (Fin (s + 3) × Fin (s + 3))

noncomputable def control (init : Q) (c : Control) : Instruction (stateCount Q) b :=
  match c with
  | .advance => .inl fun a => (ctrl .query, a, true)
  | .query => .inr (ctrl (.answer true), ctrl (.answer false))
  | .answer v => .inl fun a => (ctrl (.store v), a, false)
  | .store v => .inl fun _ => (code init, letterCode (boolLetter v), false)

noncomputable def oldProgram (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) : Program (stateCount Q) b :=
  program (extend M) (.inl stop) FoldLiteral.blank (symbolCode e)

noncomputable def tapeProgram (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) : Program (stateCount Q) b :=
  fun q =>
    if q = code stop then
      .inl fun a => if a = letterCode 2 then (ctrl .advance, a, true) else (1, a, false)
    else if h : ∃ c, q = ctrl (Q := Q) c then control M.initial h.choose
    else oldProgram M stop e q

theorem ctrl_inj : Function.Injective (ctrl (Q := Q)) := by
  intro c d h
  have hh := congrArg Prod.fst (stateCode_injective h)
  exact Sum.inr.inj hh

theorem ctrl_ne_code (c : Control) (q : Q) : ctrl (Q := Q) c ≠ code q := by
  intro h
  have hh : (Sum.inr c : Label Q) = Sum.inl q := congrArg Prod.fst (stateCode_injective h)
  cases hh

theorem tapeProgram_ctrl (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (c : Control) :
    tapeProgram M stop e (ctrl c) = control M.initial c := by
  have hc : ∃ d, ctrl (Q := Q) c = ctrl d := ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [tapeProgram, ite_eq_right (ctrl_ne_code c stop), dite_eq_left hc]
  rw [← ctrl_inj hc.choose_spec]

theorem old_ctrl (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (c : Control) :
    oldProgram M stop e (ctrl c) = .inl (fun a => (2, a, false)) := by
  let : Nonempty (Label Q) := ⟨(extend M).initial⟩
  let : Nonempty Work := ⟨FoldLiteral.blank⟩
  simp [oldProgram, ctrl, program, extend,
    Function.leftInverse_invFun stateCode_injective (Sum.inr c, false)]

theorem old_step_lift (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    {t u : Cfg (stateCount Q) b} (ht : step X (oldProgram M stop e) t u)
    (hu : halting (stateCount Q) u.1 = false) : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) t u := by
  rcases t with ⟨q, j, w⟩
  by_cases hq : q = code stop
  · subst q
    simp only [step, oldProgram, code, program_query] at ht
    have hh := ht.2
    cases hr : readNumeral b w j with
    | none =>
      simp only [hr] at hh
      subst u
      simp [halting] at hu
    | some n =>
      simp only [hr] at hh
      rcases hh with ⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, rfl⟩ <;> simp [halting] at hu
  · by_cases hc : ∃ c, q = ctrl (Q := Q) c
    · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hc
      simp only [step, old_ctrl] at ht
      have hh := ht.2
      subst u
      simp [halting] at hu
    · exact ⟨ht.1, by simpa only [tapeProgram, ite_eq_right hq, dite_eq_right hc] using ht.2⟩

theorem old_run_lift (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    {t u : Cfg (stateCount Q) b} (h : ReflTransGen (step X (oldProgram M stop e)) t u)
    (hu : halting (stateCount Q) u.1 = false) : ReflTransGen (step X (tapeProgram M stop e)) t u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl
  | tail _ h ih => exact (ih h.1).tail (old_step_lift M stop e X h hu)

def wordOnTape (w : List Letter) (t : List (Fin (b + 4))) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, t.getD i 2 = (w.map letterCode).getD i 2

theorem tape_run (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    (hstop : ∀ a, M.transition stop a = none)
    {w w' : List Letter} {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (ht : wordOnTape w t)
    (hrun : StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step M)
      ⟨M.initial, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w⟩ ⟨stop, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w'⟩) :
    ∃ t', ReflTransGen (step X (tapeProgram M stop e))
      (code M.initial, 0, t) (code stop, 0, t') ∧ wordOnTape w' t' := by
  have hsim : simulates (symbolCode e) (liftCfg (⟨M.initial, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w⟩ :
      OneSided.Cfg Work Q)) (code M.initial, 0, t) :=
    ⟨rfl, rfl, fun i => (ht i).trans (raw_code e w i).symm⟩
  have hs : ∀ a, (extend M).transition (.inl stop) a = none := by
    intro a
    simp [extend, hstop]
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hsu⟩ := simulate_run (extend M) (.inl stop) FoldLiteral.blank
    (symbolCode e) X (symbolCode_injective e) hs hsim (extend_run M hrun)
  rcases u with ⟨q, j, t'⟩
  rcases hsu with ⟨hq, hj, ht'⟩
  change q = code stop at hq
  change j = 0 at hj
  subst q j
  refine ⟨t', old_run_lift M stop e X hu (stateCode_nonhalting _), fun i => ?_⟩
  exact (ht' i).trans (raw_code e w' i)

theorem tape_boot (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ t, step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (0, 0, numeral b n) (code M.initial, 0, t) ∧
      wordOnTape (bits n) t := by
  let w := numeral b n
  let t := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) w 0 (w.getD 0 2)
  have hc : ¬∃ c, (0 : Fin (stateCount Q + 3)) = ctrl (Q := Q) c := by
    rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact stateCode_ne_zero _ hc.symm
  refine ⟨t, ⟨rfl, ?_⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
  · simp [tapeProgram, (stateCode_ne_zero (Sum.inl stop, false)).symm, hc,
      oldProgram, program_start, extend, code, w, t]
  · change (write 2 w 0 (w.getD 0 2)).getD i 2 = _
    rw [write_same, numeral_code]

theorem finDelim_ne_blank : (3 : Fin (b + 4)) ≠ 2 := by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  change 3 = 2 at hv
  omega

theorem finite_prefix (t w : List (Fin (b + 4)))
    (h : ∀ i ≤ w.length, t.getD i 2 = (w ++ [3]).getD i 2) :
    ∃ rest, t = w ++ 3 :: rest := by
  have hc (i : Nat) : (t.take (w.length + 1)).getD i 2 = (w ++ [3]).getD i 2 := by
    by_cases hi : i < w.length + 1
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take_of_lt hi, ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      exact h i (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi)
    · have hi' : w.length + 1 ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_gt hi
      simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take_eq_none hi',
        List.getElem?_eq_none (l := w ++ [3]) (by simpa using hi')]
  obtain ⟨rest, hr⟩ := list_prefix_of_getD _ w 2 3 finDelim_ne_blank hc
  refine ⟨rest ++ t.drop (w.length + 1), ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (w.length + 1) t]
  rw [hr, List.append_assoc]
  rfl

theorem read_delimited (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (n : Nat) (t : List (Fin (b + 4)))
    (h : ∀ i ≤ (bits n).length, t.getD i 2 = ((out n).map letterCode).getD i 2) :
    readNumeral b t 0 = some n := by
  let w := (bits n).map (letterCode (b := b))
  have hl : w.length = (bits n).length := List.length_map ..
  have hword (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ w.length) :
      t.getD i 2 = (w ++ [3]).getD i 2 := by
    rw [hl] at hi
    simpa [w, out, List.map_append, letterCode] using h i hi
  obtain ⟨rest, rfl⟩ := finite_prefix t w hword
  have hread : readNumeral b (w ++ [3]) 0 = some n :=
    read_output e n _ (fun i => by rw [raw_code]; simp [w, out, List.map_append, letterCode])
  have hi (r : List (Fin (b + 4))) :
      (w ++ 3 :: r).takeWhile (· != 3) = w := by
    rw [List.takeWhile_append_of_pos (bits_no_delimiter b n)]
    simp [w]
  have hd (r : List (Fin (b + 4))) : (w ++ 3 :: r).getD w.length 2 = 3 := by
    simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  unfold readNumeral at hread ⊢
  simpa only [List.drop_zero, hi, hd] using hread

def queryWord (v : Bool) (q : Nat) (payload : List Letter) : List Letter :=
  2 :: boolLetter v :: (out q ++ payload)

theorem wordOnTape_writeSame {w : List Letter} {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (h : wordOnTape w t) (i : Nat) :
    wordOnTape w (write 2 t i (t.getD i 2)) :=
  fun j => (write_same _ _ _ _).trans (h j)

theorem wordOnTape_setAnswer {q : Nat} {payload : List Letter} {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (h : wordOnTape (queryWord false q payload) t) (v : Bool) :
    wordOnTape (queryWord v q payload) (write 2 t 1 (letterCode (boolLetter v))) := by
  intro i
  rw [write_getD]
  rcases i with _ | _ | i
  · exact h 0
  · simp [queryWord]
  · exact h (i + 2)

theorem read_queryWord (e : Work ≃ Fin b) {v : Bool} {q : Nat} {payload : List Letter}
    {t : List (Fin (b + 4))} (h : wordOnTape (queryWord v q payload) t) :
    readNumeral b t 2 = some q := by
  have he : readNumeral b t 2 = readNumeral b (t.drop 2) 0 := by
    simp only [readNumeral, List.drop_zero]
  rw [he]
  apply read_delimited e
  intro i hi
  have hg : (t.drop 2).getD i 2 = t.getD (2 + i) 2 := by
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_drop]
  rw [hg, h]
  have hi' : i < ((out q).map (letterCode (b := b))).length := by
    simp [out]
    omega
  simp [queryWord, Nat.add_comm 2 i, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left hi']

theorem tape_accept (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    (y : Nat) {t : List (Fin (b + 4))} (ht : wordOnTape (out y) t) :
    ∃ u, step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (code stop, 0, t) (1, 0, u) ∧
      readNumeral b u 0 = some y := by
  let u := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t 0 (t.getD 0 2)
  have hbit : t.getD 0 2 ≠ letterCode (2 : Letter) := by
    intro he
    have hd : t.getD 0 2 = 3 := he
    have hn : (bits y).length ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hempty : bits y = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp h
      have hne := Nat.toDigits_ne_nil (b := 2) (n := y)
      apply hne
      simpa only [bits, List.map_eq_nil_iff] using hempty
    have h0 : 0 < ((bits y).map (letterCode (b := b))).length := by simpa using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    have helem : t.getD 0 2 ∈ (bits y).map (letterCode (b := b)) := by
      rw [ht 0, out, List.map_append, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left h0,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem h0, Option.getD_some]
      exact List.getElem_mem _
    have hb := bits_no_delimiter b y _ helem
    simp only [hd, bne_self_eq_false, Bool.false_eq_true] at hb
  refine ⟨u, ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hbit
    simp [tapeProgram, hbit, u]
  · apply read_output e
    intro i
    exact (wordOnTape_writeSame ht 0 i).trans (raw_code e (out y) i).symm

theorem tape_query (M : Machine Q Work) (stop : Q) (e : Work ≃ Fin b) (X : Set Nat)
    (q : Nat) (payload : List Letter) {t : List (Fin (b + 4))}
    (ht : wordOnTape (queryWord false q payload) t) :
    ∃ u v,
      step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (code stop, 0, t) u ∧
      ReflTransGen (step X (tapeProgram M stop e)) u (code M.initial, 0, v) ∧
      wordOnTape (queryWord (decide (q ∈ X)) q payload) v := by
  let bit := decide (q ∈ X)
  let t₀ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t 0 (t.getD 0 2)
  let t₁ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t₀ 1 (t₀.getD 1 2)
  let t₂ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t₁ 2 (t₁.getD 2 2)
  let t₃ := write (2 : Fin (b + 4)) t₂ 1 (letterCode (boolLetter bit))
  have htag : t.getD 0 2 = letterCode (2 : Letter) := ht 0
  have h₀ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (code stop, 0, t) (ctrl .advance, 1, t₀) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at htag
    simp [tapeProgram, htag, t₀]
  have h₁ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl .advance, 1, t₀) (ctrl .query, 2, t₁) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, t₁]
  have ht₁ := wordOnTape_writeSame (wordOnTape_writeSame ht 0) 1
  have hr : readNumeral b t₁ 2 = some q := read_queryWord e ht₁
  have h₂ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl .query, 2, t₁) (ctrl (.answer bit), 2, t₁) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp only [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, hr]
    by_cases hx : q ∈ X
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, by simp [bit, hx]⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, by simp [bit, hx]⟩
  have h₃ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl (.answer bit), 2, t₁) (ctrl (.store bit), 1, t₂) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, t₂]
  have h₄ : step X (tapeProgram M stop e) (ctrl (.store bit), 1, t₂) (code M.initial, 0, t₃) := by
    refine ⟨stateCode_nonhalting _, ?_⟩
    simp [tapeProgram_ctrl, control, t₃]
  exact ⟨_, _, h₀, (((ReflTransGen.single h₁).tail h₂).tail h₃).tail h₄,
    wordOnTape_setAnswer (wordOnTape_writeSame ht₁ 2) bit⟩

end SingletonTape


namespace SingletonTape
open Relation OracleNegativePullback
open OracleTapeSupplier.OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes
open MachineRealization Compiler.Simulator
open scoped Classical

noncomputable def oraclePrefix (X : Set Nat) : Nat → List Bool
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 => oraclePrefix X n ++ [decide (n ∈ X)]

@[simp] theorem oraclePrefix_len (X : Set Nat) (k : Nat) : (oraclePrefix X k).length = k := by
  induction k <;> simp [oraclePrefix, *]

theorem oraclePrefix_agrees (X : Set Nat) (k : Nat) : agrees X (oraclePrefix X k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [agrees, oraclePrefix]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i v hv
    by_cases hl : i < k
    · rw [oraclePrefix, List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hl)] at hv
      exact ih i v hv
    · have he : k ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_gt hl
      rw [oraclePrefix, List.getElem?_append_right (by simpa using he), oraclePrefix_len] at hv
      have hi : i = k := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp; omega)] at hv
        cases hv
      subst i
      simp at hv
      rw [← hv]
      exact decide_eq_true_iff

theorem oraclePrefix_take (X : Set Nat) {k n : Nat} (h : k ≤ n) :
    (oraclePrefix X n).take k = oraclePrefix X k := by
  induction n with
  | zero => have : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h; simp [this, oraclePrefix]
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h with rfl | hl
    · apply List.take_of_length_le
      simp
    · have h' : k ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hl
      rw [oraclePrefix, List.take_append_of_le_length (by simpa using h')]
      exact ih h'

theorem findTest (X : Set Nat) {F : List Bool × Nat →. Nat} {f : Nat →. Nat}
    (hF : Partrec F) (ht : tracks X F f) :
    ∃ test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat, Computable test ∧
      ∀ n y, (∃ k, test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = some y) ↔ y ∈ f n := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.Partrec.Code.exists_code.mp hF
  have ceval (p : List Bool × Nat) : c.eval (Encodable.encode p) = F p := by
    rw [hc]
    simp [Encodable.encodek, Part.map_id']
  let test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat := fun p =>
    let kl := p.1.length.unpair
    Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln kl.2 c (Encodable.encode (p.1.take kl.1, p.2))
  have hkl : Primrec (fun p : List Bool × Nat => p.1.length.unpair) :=
    Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp Primrec.fst)
  have htake := Primrec.list_take.comp (Primrec.fst.comp hkl) (Primrec.fst : Primrec (@Prod.fst (List Bool) Nat))
  have hp := Primrec.encode.comp (htake.pair Primrec.snd)
  refine ⟨test, (Nat.Partrec.Code.primrec_evaln.comp
    (((Primrec.snd.comp hkl).pair (Primrec.const c)).pair hp)).to_comp, fun n y => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have h₁ : (Nat.unpair k).1 ≤ k := Nat.unpair_left_le k
    have hr : y ∈ F (oraclePrefix X (Nat.unpair k).1, n) := by
      rw [← ceval]
      apply Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln_sound
      have he := oraclePrefix_take X h₁
      simpa only [test, oraclePrefix_len, he, Option.mem_def] using hk
    exact ht.1 (oraclePrefix_agrees X _) hr
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ht.2 hy
    have hy' : y ∈ c.eval (Encodable.encode (oraclePrefix X k, n)) := by
      rw [ceval]
      exact hk _ (oraclePrefix_agrees X k) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln_complete.mp hy'
    refine ⟨Nat.pair k l, ?_⟩
    simpa only [test, oraclePrefix_len, Nat.unpair_pair, oraclePrefix_take X (Nat.left_le_pair k l),
      Option.mem_def] using hl

def packed (n : Nat) (w : List Bool) : List Letter :=
  bits (Nat.pair n (Encodable.encode w))

def stageWord (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (n : Nat) (w : List Bool) : List Letter :=
  match test (w, n) with
  | some y => out y
  | none => queryWord false w.length (packed n w)

def afterQuery (w : List Letter) : Nat × List Bool :=
  let p := (parse (((w.drop 2).dropWhile (· != 2)).drop 1)).unpair
  (p.1, (Encodable.decode (α := List Bool) p.2).getD [] ++ [w.getD 1 0 == 1])

def dispatch (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (w : List Letter) : List Letter :=
  if w.getD 0 0 == 2 then stageWord test (afterQuery w).1 (afterQuery w).2
  else stageWord test (parse w) []

theorem not_delim_bits (n : Nat) : ∀ l ∈ bits n, l != 2 := by
  intro l hl
  obtain ⟨d, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
  unfold ofChar
  split <;> decide

theorem bits_head_not_delim (n : Nat) : (bits n).getD 0 0 ≠ 2 := by
  cases hk : (bits n)[0]? with
  | none => simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hk]
  | some l =>
    have hl := not_delim_bits n l (List.mem_of_getElem? hk)
    simpa [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hk] using hl

theorem dispatch_initial (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (n : Nat) :
    dispatch test (bits n) = stageWord test n [] := by
  have h := bits_head_not_delim n
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at h
  simp [dispatch, h, parse_bits]

theorem dispatch_afterQuery (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (v : Bool) (q n : Nat)
    (w : List Bool) :
    dispatch test (queryWord v q (packed n w)) = stageWord test n (w ++ [v]) := by
  unfold dispatch afterQuery queryWord
  have hv : (boolLetter v == 1) = v := by cases v <;> rfl
  simp [out, List.append_assoc, List.dropWhile_append_of_pos (not_delim_bits q),
    packed, parse_bits, Encodable.encodek, hv]

theorem comp_dispatch (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (ht : Computable test) :
    Computable (dispatch test) := by
  open Primrec in
  have pparse : Primrec parse := by
    have digit : Primrec (fun p : Nat × Letter => 2 * p.1 + p.2.val) :=
      nat_add.comp (nat_mul.comp (const 2) fst) (fin_val.comp snd)
    exact list_foldl Primrec.id (const 0) (digit.comp snd).to₂
  open Primrec in
  have pout : Primrec out := list_append.comp prim_bits (const [2])
  open Primrec in
  have pPacked : Primrec (fun p : Nat × List Bool => packed p.1 p.2) :=
    prim_bits.comp (Primrec₂.natPair.comp fst (Primrec.encode.comp snd))
  open Primrec in
  have pQuery : Primrec (fun p : List Bool × Nat =>
      queryWord false p.1.length (packed p.2 p.1)) :=
    list_cons.comp (const 2) (list_cons.comp (const (boolLetter false))
      (list_append.comp (pout.comp (list_length.comp fst)) (pPacked.comp (snd.pair fst))))
  have hStage : Computable (fun p : List Bool × Nat => stageWord test p.2 p.1) := by
    apply (Computable.option_casesOn ht pQuery.to_comp (pout.to_comp.comp Computable.snd).to₂).of_eq
    intro p
    unfold stageWord
    cases test p <;> rfl
  open Primrec in
  have pAfter : Primrec afterQuery := by
    have he : Primrec (fun w : List Letter =>
        (parse (((w.drop 2).dropWhile (· != 2)).drop 1)).unpair) :=
      unpair.comp (pparse.comp (list_drop.comp (const 1)
        ((list_dropWhile (Primrec.not.comp (Primrec.beq.comp Primrec.id (const 2)))).comp
          (list_drop.comp (const 2) Primrec.id))))
    have hbit : Primrec (fun w : List Letter => w.getD 1 0 == 1) :=
      Primrec.beq.comp (list_getD 0 |>.comp Primrec.id (const 1)) (const 1)
    exact (fst.comp he).pair (list_append.comp
      (option_getD.comp (Primrec.decode.comp (snd.comp he)) (const []))
      (list_cons.comp hbit (const [])))
  have hp : Primrec (fun w : List Letter => w.getD 0 0 == 2) :=
    Primrec.beq.comp (Primrec.list_getD 0 |>.comp Primrec.id (Primrec.const 0)) (Primrec.const 2)
  apply (Computable.cond hp.to_comp
    (hStage.comp ((Primrec.snd.comp pAfter).pair (Primrec.fst.comp pAfter)).to_comp)
    (hStage.comp ((Primrec.const []).pair pparse).to_comp)).of_eq
  intro w
  unfold dispatch
  cases w.getD 0 0 == 2 <;> rfl

end SingletonTape

namespace SingletonTape
open Relation OracleNegativePullback
open OracleTapeSupplier.OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes
open MachineRealization Compiler.Simulator
open scoped Classical

theorem no_terminal_of_progress {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop}
    (hu : Relator.RightUnique r) {ready : α → Prop}
    (ha : ∀ a, ready a → ∃ b, TransGen r a b ∧ ready b) {a t : α}
    (hready : ready a) (hr : ReflTransGen r a t) : ∃ v, r t v := by
  let live (s : α) : Prop := ∃ z, TransGen r s z ∧ ready z
  have forward {s u : α} (h : r s u) (hs : live s) : live u := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hreadyz⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvz⟩ := TransGen.head'_iff.mp hz
    obtain rfl := hu h hv
    rcases reflTransGen_iff_eq_or_transGen.mp hvz with rfl | h'
    · exact ha _ hreadyz
    · exact ⟨z, h', hreadyz⟩
  have ht : live t := by
    induction hr with
    | refl => exact ha _ hready
    | tail _ h ih => exact forward h ih
  obtain ⟨_, hz, _⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨v, hv, _⟩ := TransGen.head'_iff.mp hz
  exact ⟨v, hv⟩

noncomputable def entryWord (X : Set Nat) (n : Nat) : Nat → List Letter
  | 0 => bits n
  | k + 1 => queryWord (decide (k ∈ X)) k (packed n (oraclePrefix X k))

theorem dispatch_entry (X : Set Nat) (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat) (n k : Nat) :
    dispatch test (entryWord X n k) = stageWord test n (oraclePrefix X k) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact dispatch_initial test n
  | succ k => exact dispatch_afterQuery test (decide (k ∈ X)) k n (oraclePrefix X k)

theorem compileTest (X : Set Nat) (f : Nat →. Nat) (test : List Bool × Nat → Option Nat)
    (hc : Computable test)
    (htest : ∀ n y, (∃ k, test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = some y) ↔ y ∈ f n) :
    ∃ (s b : Nat) (p : Program s b), ∀ n,
      (haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1) ↔ (f n).Dom) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ f n, haltsWith X p n (fun _ t => readNumeral b t 0 = some y)) := by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, iΛ, M₀, first, last, hs, hEval₀⟩ :=
    WordEvaluator.exists_safe_tape (comp_dispatch test hc).partrec
  let : Fintype Λ := hΛ
  let : Inhabited Λ := iΛ
  let M := FoldLiteral.wrapper M₀ first
  let stop : FoldLiteral.State Λ := some none
  let Q := FoldLiteral.State Λ
  let e := Fintype.equivFin Work
  let b := Fintype.card Work
  let s := stateCount Q
  let p := tapeProgram M stop e
  let r := step X p
  have hstop : ∀ a, M.transition stop a = none := fun _ => rfl
  have hEval (w : List Letter) : StateTransition.Reaches (OneSided.step M)
      ⟨M.initial, 0, FoldLiteral.raw w⟩ ⟨stop, 0, FoldLiteral.raw (dispatch test w)⟩ := by
    apply (StateTransition.mem_eval.mp ?_).1
    change FoldLiteral.final (dispatch test w) ∈
      StateTransition.eval (OneSided.step M) (FoldLiteral.initial w)
    rw [FoldLiteral.wrapper_eval M₀ first last hs hEval₀]
    exact Part.mem_map _ (Part.mem_some _)
  refine ⟨s, b, p, fun n => ?_⟩
  let boot : Cfg s b := (0, 0, numeral b n)
  let QInit := code M.initial
  let QStop := code stop
  let entry := entryWord X n
  let check := fun k => test (oraclePrefix X k, n)
  have hzero : ∃ t, r boot (QInit, 0, t) ∧ wordOnTape (entry 0) t :=
    tape_boot M stop e X n
  have transform {k : Nat} {t : List (Fin (b+4))} (ht : wordOnTape (entry k) t) :
      ∃ t', ReflTransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (QStop, 0, t') ∧
        wordOnTape (stageWord test n (oraclePrefix X k)) t' := by
    obtain ⟨t', hreach, hout⟩ := tape_run M stop e X hstop ht (hEval (entry k))
    refine ⟨t', hreach, ?_⟩
    rw [dispatch_entry] at hout
    exact hout
  have advance {k : Nat} {t : List (Fin (b+4))} (ht : wordOnTape (entry k) t)
      (hk : check k = none) :
      ∃ t', TransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (QInit, 0, t') ∧ wordOnTape (entry (k+1)) t' := by
    obtain ⟨t', hr, hout⟩ := transform ht
    have ho : wordOnTape (queryWord false k (packed n (oraclePrefix X k))) t' := by
      simpa only [stageWord, show test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = none from hk, oraclePrefix_len]
        using hout
    obtain ⟨_, u, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := tape_query M stop e X k _ ho
    exact ⟨u, (TransGen.tail' hr h₁).trans_left h₂, h₃⟩
  have accept {k y : Nat} {t : List (Fin (b+4))} (ht : wordOnTape (entry k) t)
      (hk : check k = some y) :
      ∃ t', ReflTransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (1, 0, t') ∧ readNumeral b t' 0 = some y := by
    obtain ⟨t', hr, hout⟩ := transform ht
    have ho : wordOnTape (out y) t' := by
      simpa only [stageWord, show test (oraclePrefix X k, n) = some y from hk] using hout
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hy⟩ := tape_accept M stop e X y ho
    exact ⟨u, hr.tail hu, hy⟩
  have reach (k : Nat) (hk : ∀ i < k, check i = none) :
      ∃ t, ReflTransGen r boot (QInit, 0, t) ∧ wordOnTape (entry k) t := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := hzero
      exact ⟨t, .single ht, hw⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := ih (fun i hi => hk i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi))
      obtain ⟨t', hr, hw'⟩ := advance hw (hk k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
      exact ⟨t', ht.trans hr.to_reflTransGen, hw'⟩
  have outcome (y : Nat) (hy : y ∈ f n) :
      ∃ t, ReflTransGen r boot (1, 0, t) ∧ readNumeral b t 0 = some y := by
    have hex : ∃ k, check k = some y := (htest n y).mpr hy
    let k := Nat.find hex
    have earlier (i : Nat) (hi : i < k) : check i = none := by
      cases he : check i with
      | none => rfl
      | some z =>
        have hzy := Part.mem_unique ((htest n z).mp ⟨i, he⟩) hy
        subst z
        exact (Nat.find_min hex hi he).elim
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hw⟩ := reach k earlier
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hread⟩ := accept hw (Nat.find_spec hex)
    exact ⟨u, ht.trans hu, hread⟩
  have acceptsOnly (hh : haltsWith X p n (fun q _ => q = 1)) : (f n).Dom := by
    by_contra hd
    have allNone (k : Nat) : check k = none := by
      cases he : check k with
      | none => rfl
      | some y => exact (hd ((htest n y).mp ⟨k, he⟩).fst).elim
    let ready (a : Cfg s b) : Prop := ∃ k t, a = (QInit, 0, t) ∧ wordOnTape (entry k) t
    have progress (a : Cfg s b) (ha : ready a) : ∃ t, TransGen r a t ∧ ready t := by
      obtain ⟨k, t, rfl, hw⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hw'⟩ := advance hw (allNone k)
      exact ⟨_, hu, k+1, u, rfl, hw'⟩
    obtain ⟨t, hb, hw⟩ := hzero
    obtain ⟨q, j, tape, hrun, hhalt, _⟩ := hh
    have ht := no_terminal_of_progress (step_unique X p) progress
      (show ready (QInit, 0, t) from ⟨0, t, rfl, hw⟩)
      (show ReflTransGen r (QInit, 0, t) (q, j, tape) from by
        rcases ReflTransGen.cases_head hrun with he | ⟨u, hu, htail⟩
        · have hq := congrArg Prod.fst he
          have he' : q = 0 := hq.symm
          rw [he'] at hhalt
          change false = true at hhalt
          contradiction
        · have h := step_unique X p hb hu
          rw [h]
          exact htail)
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ht
    exact Bool.noConfusion (hhalt.symm.trans hv.1)
  have hhalt : halting s (1 : Fin (s+3)) = true := by simp [halting]
  refine ⟨⟨acceptsOnly, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := outcome _ (Part.get_mem hd)
    exact ⟨1, 0, t, ht, hhalt, rfl⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hr⟩ := outcome y hy
    exact ⟨1, 0, t, ht, hhalt, hr⟩

end SingletonTape

external.usage: Used via the installed port in Proofs.OracleNegativePullbackDecision to compile the total finite-prefix dispatcher on List (Fin 3). Supplies the finite TM0, tape safety, and exact evaluation for the ordinary part of each round.

Used via the installed port to obtain the one-sided run from the literal dispatcher input to its literal output with the head at cell zero and a blank tail. The continuation proof transports these runs to the reviewed List-tape machine.

Used directly in SingletonTape.findTest. Soundness and completeness characterize the outputs of the ordinary bounded evaluations. Primitive recursiveness makes the pairing schedule and its bounded evaluator into a total computable dispatcher test.

Used in both directions in SingletonTape.tracks_rfind. A successful minimum needs a defined false test at every smaller index. The finite approximation covers these earlier tests together with the witness, preserving divergence at any earlier undefined test.

∀ X : Set Nat,
  let O : Set (Nat →. Nat) :=
    {fun n => Part.some (@ite Nat (n ∈ X) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)}
  (∀ f : Nat →. Nat, Nat.RecursiveIn O f →
    (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability X).2.1 {n | (f n).Dom}) ∧
  (∀ f : Nat → Nat, Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (f n)) →
    (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability X).2.2 f)

PriorityBoundedOracleSearches.proof:
by
  classical
  intro φ rowAt pairBefore query M K oracle hrow horder hbefore hquery hstable hM
    upperCandidate lowerCandidate
  -- The coordinator passes the computable query map and its pointwise stability law.
  -- The terminal tape decision has a different interface. The two scans use the
  -- native singleton oracle for repeated queries. Taking M = Set.univ recovers
  -- the marker eligibility of Cintioli's construction, independently of A.
  let Rel := PriorityBoundedSearch.OracleTotal oracle
  have liftOrdinary {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : Computable f) : Rel f :=
    PriorityBoundedSearch.liftOrdinary hf
  have relComp {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : Rel f) (hg : Rel g) :
      Rel (fun n => f (g n)) := PriorityBoundedSearch.relComp hf hg
  have rel₂ {f g : Nat → Nat} {op : Nat → Nat → Nat} (hop : Computable₂ op)
      (hf : Rel f) (hg : Rel g) : Rel (fun n => op (f n) (g n)) :=
    PriorityBoundedSearch.rel₂ hop hf hg
  let answer (n : Nat) : Nat := if n ∈ K then 1 else 0
  have hanswer : Rel answer := Nat.RecursiveIn.oracle _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have answerZero (n : Nat) : answer n = 0 ↔ n ∉ K := by simp [answer]
  let admissible (m : Nat) : Nat := if m ∈ M then 1 else 0
  have admissibleOne (m : Nat) : admissible m = 1 ↔ m ∈ M := by simp [admissible]

  let req (a : Nat) := a.unpair.1
  let stage (a : Nat) := a.unpair.2.unpair.1
  let masks (a : Nat) := a.unpair.2.unpair.2
  have hreq : Computable req := Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair
  have hparams : Computable (fun a : Nat => a.unpair.2.unpair) :=
    Computable.unpair.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)
  have hstage : Computable stage := Computable.fst.comp hparams
  have hmasks : Computable masks := Computable.snd.comp hparams
  have hinput : Computable (fun p : Nat => Nat.pair (req p.unpair.1) p.unpair.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (hreq.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair))
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)
  let upperBefore (i j : Nat) := pairBefore i.unpair j.unpair
  have hupperBefore : ComputablePred (fun p : Nat × Nat => upperBefore p.1 p.2) := by
    have hdecode : Computable (fun p : Nat × Nat => (p.1.unpair, p.2.unpair)) :=
      (Computable.unpair.comp Computable.fst).pair (Computable.unpair.comp Computable.snd)
    exact (hbefore.decide.comp hdecode).computablePred
  let upperBound (a : Nat) := (stage a + 1) ^ 2
  have hupperBound : Computable upperBound := by
    have h := Computable.succ.comp hstage
    exact (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp h h).of_eq (fun a => by simp only [upperBound, pow_two])
  let upperTest (a i : Nat) := PriorityBoundedSearch.gate (answer (query (Nat.pair (req a) i)))
    (if PriorityBoundedSearch.fits (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (rowAt (req a) i.unpair.1 i.unpair.2),
      stage a, masks a) then 1 else 0)
  have hupperTest : Rel (fun p => upperTest p.unpair.1 p.unpair.2) := by
    have ha : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.1) := Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair
    have hq : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.2.unpair) :=
      Computable.unpair.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)
    have hc := hrow.comp ((hreq.comp ha).pair hq)
    have hf := PriorityBoundedSearch.hfits.decide.to_comp.comp (hc.pair ((hstage.comp ha).pair (hmasks.comp ha)))
    have hflag := Computable.cond hf (Computable.const (1 : Nat)) (Computable.const 0)
    refine (rel₂ PriorityBoundedSearch.hgate (relComp hanswer (liftOrdinary (hquery.comp hinput)))
      (liftOrdinary hflag)).of_eq ?_
    intro p
    simp [upperTest, Bool.cond_eq_ite]
  let upperInput (e s z : Nat) := Nat.pair e (Nat.pair s z)
  have upperSpec (e s z i : Nat) :
      (i < upperBound (upperInput e s z) ∧ upperTest (upperInput e s z) i = 1) ↔
        upperCandidate e s (Finset.equivBitIndices z) i.unpair := by
    have hi := PriorityBoundedSearch.square s i.unpair
    rw [Nat.pair_unpair] at hi
    have hs := hstable e i.unpair.1 i.unpair.2
    rw [Nat.pair_unpair] at hs
    simp only [upperCandidate, upperBound, upperTest, upperInput, req, stage, masks,
      Nat.unpair_pair, PriorityBoundedSearch.gateOne, answerZero, ite_eq_left_iff, Nat.zero_ne_one,
      imp_false, not_not, PriorityBoundedSearch.fits, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hi, hs]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hx, ht⟩, hstable, PriorityBoundedSearch.hfits⟩
      exact ⟨hx, ht, PriorityBoundedSearch.hfits, hstable⟩
    · rintro ⟨hx, ht, PriorityBoundedSearch.hfits, hstable⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hx, ht⟩, hstable, PriorityBoundedSearch.hfits⟩

  let lowerBound (a : Nat) := (stage a).succ
  let lowerFree (a m : Nat) : Prop :=
    m ∉ Finset.equivBitIndices (masks a).unpair.1 ∧
    m ∉ Finset.equivBitIndices (masks a).unpair.2
  let lowerTest (a m : Nat) := PriorityBoundedSearch.gate
    (answer (Nat.pair (req a) m) + (if lowerFree a m then 0 else 1)) (admissible m)
  have hlowerTest : Rel (fun p => lowerTest p.unpair.1 p.unpair.2) := by
    have hm : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.2) := Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair
    have hc := Computable.unpair.comp (hmasks.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair))
    have hfree : Computable (fun p : Nat => decide (lowerFree p.unpair.1 p.unpair.2)) := by
      have h₁ := Primrec.not.to_comp.comp (PriorityBoundedSearch.testBit.to_comp.comp (Computable.fst.comp hc) hm)
      have h₂ := Primrec.not.to_comp.comp (PriorityBoundedSearch.testBit.to_comp.comp (Computable.snd.comp hc) hm)
      refine (Primrec.and.to_comp.comp h₁ h₂).of_eq ?_
      intro p
      simp [lowerFree]
    have hreject := rel₂ Primrec.nat_add.to_comp (relComp hanswer (liftOrdinary hinput))
      (liftOrdinary (Computable.cond hfree (Computable.const (0 : Nat)) (Computable.const 1)))
    exact (rel₂ PriorityBoundedSearch.hgate hreject (relComp (f := admissible) hM (liftOrdinary hm))).of_eq (fun p => by
      simp [lowerTest, Bool.cond_eq_ite])
  let lowerInput (e s c a : Nat) := upperInput e s (Nat.pair c a)
  have lowerSpec (e s c a m : Nat) :
      (m < lowerBound (lowerInput e s c a) ∧ lowerTest (lowerInput e s c a) m = 1) ↔
        lowerCandidate e s (Finset.equivBitIndices c) (Finset.equivBitIndices a) m := by
    simp only [lowerCandidate, lowerBound, lowerTest, lowerInput, upperInput, req, stage,
      lowerFree, masks, Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.lt_succ_iff, PriorityBoundedSearch.gateOne, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff,
      answerZero, admissibleOne, ite_eq_left_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, imp_false, not_not]
    have hk : Nat.pair e m ∉ K ↔ ¬ (φ e m).Dom := by
      simp [K]
    rw [hk]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hle, ⟨hdiv, hcontent, hactive⟩, hmem⟩
      exact ⟨hle, hmem, hdiv, hcontent, hactive⟩
    · rintro ⟨hle, hmem, hdiv, hcontent, hactive⟩
      exact ⟨hle, ⟨hdiv, hcontent, hactive⟩, hmem⟩

  let upperCode (a : Nat) := PriorityBoundedSearch.scan upperTest upperBefore a (upperBound a)
  let lowerCode (a : Nat) := PriorityBoundedSearch.scan lowerTest Nat.lt a (lowerBound a)
  have hu : Rel upperCode := PriorityBoundedSearch.scanRelative upperTest upperBefore hupperTest hupperBefore
    upperBound hupperBound
  have hl : Rel lowerCode := PriorityBoundedSearch.scanRelative lowerTest Nat.lt hlowerTest (Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.computablePred)
    lowerBound (Computable.succ.comp hstage)
  let upperSearch (e s : Nat) (Z : Finset Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
    PriorityBoundedSearch.pairResult (upperCode (upperInput e s (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm Z)))
  let lowerSearch (e s : Nat) (content active : Finset Nat) : Option Nat :=
    PriorityBoundedSearch.natResult (lowerCode (lowerInput e s (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm content)
      (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm active)))
  refine ⟨upperSearch, lowerSearch, hu.of_eq ?_, hl.of_eq ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p
    cases hp : p.unpair with
    | mk e args =>
      cases ha : args.unpair with
      | mk s z =>
        have hinner : Nat.pair s z = args := by simpa only [ha] using Nat.pair_unpair args
        have houter : Nat.pair e args = p := by simpa only [hp] using Nat.pair_unpair p
        simp only [ha, upperSearch, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
          upperInput, hinner, houter, PriorityBoundedSearch.pairRoundTrip]
  · intro p
    cases hp : p.unpair with
    | mk e args =>
      cases ha : args.unpair with
      | mk s sets =>
        cases hz : sets.unpair with
        | mk c a =>
          have hsets : Nat.pair c a = sets := by simpa only [hz] using Nat.pair_unpair sets
          have hinner : Nat.pair s sets = args := by simpa only [ha] using Nat.pair_unpair args
          have houter : Nat.pair e args = p := by simpa only [hp] using Nat.pair_unpair p
          simp only [ha, hz, lowerSearch, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, lowerInput,
            upperInput, hsets, hinner, houter, PriorityBoundedSearch.natRoundTrip]
  · intro e s Z
    let z := Finset.equivBitIndices.symm Z
    let input := upperInput e s z
    refine PriorityBoundedSearch.pairResult_correct upperTest pairBefore horder input
      (upperBound input) (upperCandidate e s Z) ?_
    intro i
    exact (upperSpec e s z i).trans (by rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
  · intro e s content active
    let c := Finset.equivBitIndices.symm content
    let a := Finset.equivBitIndices.symm active
    let input := lowerInput e s c a
    refine PriorityBoundedSearch.natResult_correct lowerTest input (lowerBound input)
      (lowerCandidate e s content active) ?_
    intro m
    exact (lowerSpec e s c a m).trans (by rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
PriorityBoundedOracleSearches.support:
namespace PriorityBoundedSearch

private def OracleTotal (oracle : Set (Nat →. Nat)) (f : Nat → Nat) :=
  Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some (f n))

variable {oracle : Set (Nat →. Nat)}

private theorem liftOrdinary {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : Computable f) : OracleTotal oracle f :=
  RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hf.computableIn

private theorem relComp {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : OracleTotal oracle f) (hg : OracleTotal oracle g) :
    OracleTotal oracle (fun n => f (g n)) :=
  (Nat.RecursiveIn.comp hf hg).of_eq (fun _ => Part.bind_some _ _)

private theorem relPair {f g : Nat → Nat} (hf : OracleTotal oracle f) (hg : OracleTotal oracle g) :
    OracleTotal oracle (fun n => Nat.pair (f n) (g n)) :=
  (Nat.RecursiveIn.pair hf hg).of_eq (fun n => by
    change Part.map Nat.pair (Part.some (f n)) <*> Part.some (g n) = _
    rw [Part.map_some, ← Part.pure_eq_some (Nat.pair (f n)), pure_seq]
    exact Part.map_some _ _)

private theorem rel₂ {f g : Nat → Nat} {op : Nat → Nat → Nat} (hop : Computable₂ op)
    (hf : OracleTotal oracle f) (hg : OracleTotal oracle g) : OracleTotal oracle (fun n => op (f n) (g n)) := by
  have h : Computable (fun n : Nat => op n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2) :=
    hop.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair) (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)
  exact relComp (liftOrdinary h) (relPair hf hg) |>.of_eq (fun n => by
    simp only [Nat.unpair_pair])

-- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §4, pp. 8–9, upper and lower strategies.
-- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8
-- The article-specific Alphabeta Math portal and defect report returned 404.
-- Step 2.2 of the shared-library proof inspires the finite accumulator.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/prop-basic-arithmetic-and-bounded-quantification-are-primitive-recursive
-- Here the step can query K, so use singleton-oracle recursion. The
-- accumulator records the best candidate and its invariant proves minimality.
private noncomputable def advance (before : Nat → Nat → Prop) (value i best : Nat) : Nat := by
  classical
  exact if value = 1 ∧ (best = 0 ∨ before i best.pred) then i.succ else best

private noncomputable def scan (test : Nat → Nat → Nat) (before : Nat → Nat → Prop) (a n : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.rec 0 (fun i best => advance before (test a i) i best) n

private theorem scanCorrect (test : Nat → Nat → Nat) (before : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (hirr : ∀ i, ¬ before i i)
    (htrans : ∀ i j k, before i j → before j k → before i k) (a n : Nat) :
    match scan test before a n with
    | 0 => ∀ k < n, test a k ≠ 1
    | j + 1 => (j < n ∧ test a j = 1) ∧
        ∀ k < n, test a k = 1 → ¬ before k j := by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [scan]
  | succ n ih =>
    change (match advance before (test a n) n (scan test before a n) with
      | 0 => ∀ k < n.succ, test a k ≠ 1
      | j + 1 => (j < n.succ ∧ test a j = 1) ∧
          ∀ k < n.succ, test a k = 1 → ¬ before k j)
    generalize scan test before a n = best at ih ⊢
    cases best with
    | zero =>
      unfold advance
      by_cases hn : test a n = 1
      · have htake : test a n = 1 ∧ (0 = 0 ∨ before n (Nat.pred 0)) :=
          ⟨hn, Or.inl rfl⟩
        rw [ite_eq_left htake]
        refine ⟨⟨Nat.lt_succ_self n, hn⟩, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hv
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk) with hlt | rfl
        · exact (ih k hlt hv).elim
        · exact hirr k
      · have hskip : ¬ (test a n = 1 ∧ (0 = 0 ∨ before n (Nat.pred 0))) :=
          fun h => hn h.1
        rw [ite_eq_right hskip]
        intro k hk hv
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk) with hlt | rfl
        · exact ih k hlt hv
        · exact hn hv
    | succ j =>
      simp only [advance, Nat.succ_ne_zero, false_or, Nat.pred_succ]
      by_cases hn : test a n = 1 ∧ before n j
      · rw [ite_eq_left hn]
        refine ⟨⟨Nat.lt_succ_self n, hn.1⟩, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hv hkn
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk) with hlt | rfl
        · exact ih.2 k hlt hv (htrans _ _ _ hkn hn.2)
        · exact hirr k hkn
      · rw [ite_eq_right hn]
        refine ⟨⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_lt ih.1.1, ih.1.2⟩, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hv
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk) with hlt | rfl
        · exact ih.2 k hlt hv
        · exact fun h => hn ⟨hv, h⟩

private theorem scanRelative (test : Nat → Nat → Nat) (before : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (htest : OracleTotal oracle (fun p => test p.unpair.1 p.unpair.2))
    (hcmp : ComputablePred (fun p : Nat × Nat => before p.1 p.2))
    (bound : Nat → Nat) (hbound : Computable bound) :
    OracleTotal oracle (fun a => scan test before a (bound a)) := by
  classical
  let step (p : Nat) : Nat :=
    let a := p.unpair.1
    let i := p.unpair.2.unpair.1
    let best := p.unpair.2.unpair.2
    if test a i = 1 ∧ (best = 0 ∨ before i best.pred) then i.succ else best
  have ha : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.1) := Computable.fst.comp Computable.unpair
  have hd : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.2.unpair) :=
    Computable.unpair.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.unpair)
  have hi : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.2.unpair.1) := Computable.fst.comp hd
  have hb : Computable (fun p : Nat => p.unpair.2.unpair.2) := Computable.snd.comp hd
  have ht : OracleTotal oracle (fun p => test p.unpair.1 p.unpair.2.unpair.1) := by
    have h := relComp htest (relPair (liftOrdinary ha) (liftOrdinary hi))
    exact h.of_eq (fun n => by simp only [Nat.unpair_pair])
  let choose (v : Nat) (p : Nat × Nat) : Nat := advance before v p.1 p.2
  have hchoose : Computable₂ choose := by
    have hpos : Computable (fun p : Nat × (Nat × Nat) => p.2) := Computable.snd
    have hindex := Computable.fst.comp hpos
    have hbest := Computable.snd.comp hpos
    have hc := hcmp.decide.comp (hindex.pair (Primrec.pred.to_comp.comp hbest))
    have hv : Computable (fun p : Nat × (Nat × Nat) => decide (p.1 = 1)) :=
      (Primrec.eq.decide.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const (1 : Nat))).to_comp
    have hb₀ := Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp.comp hbest (Computable.const (0 : Nat))
    have htest' := Primrec.and.to_comp.comp hv (Primrec.or.to_comp.comp hb₀ hc)
    refine (Computable.cond htest' (Computable.succ.comp hindex) hbest).of_eq ?_
    intro p
    simp [choose, advance, Bool.cond_eq_ite]
  have hfinal : Computable₂ (fun v (pos : Nat) => choose v pos.unpair) :=
    hchoose.comp Computable.fst (Computable.unpair.comp Computable.snd)
  have hstep : OracleTotal oracle step := by
    refine (rel₂ hfinal ht (relPair (liftOrdinary hi) (liftOrdinary hb))).of_eq ?_
    intro n
    simp [step, choose, advance]
  have hprec := Nat.RecursiveIn.prec (liftOrdinary (Computable.const 0)) hstep
  have hloop : OracleTotal oracle (fun p => scan test before p.unpair.1 p.unpair.2) := by
    refine hprec.of_eq ?_
    intro p
    cases hp : p.unpair with
    | mk a n =>
      simp only [hp]
      change Nat.rec (Part.some 0) (fun y IH =>
        IH.bind fun i => Part.some (step (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair y i)))) n =
          Part.some (scan test before a n)
      clear hp p
      induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        change (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Part Nat) (Part.some 0) (fun y IH => IH.bind fun i =>
          Part.some (step (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair y i)))) n).bind
            (fun i => Part.some (step (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair n i)))) = _
        rw [ih, Part.bind_some]
        simp [step, scan, advance]
  refine (relComp hloop (relPair (liftOrdinary Computable.id) (liftOrdinary hbound))).of_eq ?_
  intro n
  simp [id]

private def pairResult (code : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match code with
  | 0 => none
  | j + 1 => some j.unpair

private def natResult (code : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match code with
  | 0 => none
  | j + 1 => some j

private theorem pairRoundTrip (code : Nat) :
    (match pairResult code with
    | none => 0
    | some (x, t) => (Nat.pair x t).succ) = code := by
  cases code with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j =>
    cases hj : j.unpair with
    | mk x t =>
      have heq : Nat.pair x t = j := by simpa only [hj] using Nat.pair_unpair j
      simp only [pairResult, hj, heq]

private theorem natRoundTrip (code : Nat) :
    (match natResult code with
    | none => 0
    | some m => m.succ) = code := by
  cases code <;> rfl

private theorem pairResult_correct (test : Nat → Nat → Nat)
    (before : (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat) → Prop)
    (order : IsStrictTotalOrder (Nat × Nat) before)
    (a n : Nat) (eligible : (Nat × Nat) → Prop)
    (spec : ∀ i, (i < n ∧ test a i = 1) ↔ eligible i.unpair) :
    match pairResult (scan test (fun i j => before i.unpair j.unpair) a n) with
    | none => ∀ q, ¬ eligible q
    | some q => eligible q ∧ ∀ p, eligible p → ¬ before p q := by
  let : IsStrictTotalOrder (Nat × Nat) before := order
  have h := scanCorrect test (fun i j => before i.unpair j.unpair)
    (fun i => irrefl (r := before) i.unpair)
    (fun i j k => IsTrans.trans i.unpair j.unpair k.unpair) a n
  generalize scan test (fun i j => before i.unpair j.unpair) a n = code at h ⊢
  cases code with
  | zero =>
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hi, ht⟩ := (spec (Nat.pair q.1 q.2)).mpr (by simpa only [Nat.unpair_pair] using hq)
    exact h _ hi ht
  | succ j =>
    refine ⟨(spec j).mp h.1, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    let i := Nat.pair q.1 q.2
    have hi := (spec i).mpr (by simpa only [i, Nat.unpair_pair] using hq)
    simpa only [i, Nat.unpair_pair] using h.2 i hi.1 hi.2

private theorem natResult_correct (test : Nat → Nat → Nat) (a n : Nat)
    (eligible : Nat → Prop) (spec : ∀ i, (i < n ∧ test a i = 1) ↔ eligible i) :
    match natResult (scan test Nat.lt a n) with
    | none => ∀ m, ¬ eligible m
    | some m => eligible m ∧ ∀ k, eligible k → m ≤ k := by
  have h := scanCorrect test Nat.lt Nat.lt_irrefl (fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => Nat.lt_trans h₁ h₂) a n
  generalize scan test Nat.lt a n = code at h ⊢
  cases code with
  | zero =>
    intro m hm
    have hm' := (spec m).mpr hm
    exact h m hm'.1 hm'.2
  | succ j =>
    refine ⟨(spec j).mp h.1, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    have hm' := (spec m).mpr hm
    exact Nat.le_of_not_gt (h.2 m hm'.1 hm'.2)

-- Alphabeta Math, Basic arithmetic operations and bounded quantification
-- are primitive recursive, Steps 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/prop-basic-arithmetic-and-bounded-quantification-are-primitive-recursive
-- Arithmetic and a bounded universal test suffice for the ordinary part of
-- the upper test, even though the supplied row codes are only computable.

private theorem powTwo : Primrec (fun i : Nat => 2 ^ i) := by
  have hstep : Primrec₂ (fun (_ : Unit) (p : Nat × Nat) => p.2 * 2) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const 2)
  refine ((Primrec.nat_rec (Primrec.const 1) hstep).comp
    (Primrec.const ()) Primrec.id).of_eq ?_
  intro i
  change Nat.rec 1 (fun _ acc => acc * 2) i = 2 ^ i
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih => exact (congrArg (· * 2) ih).trans (Nat.pow_succ 2 i).symm

private theorem testBit : Primrec₂ Nat.testBit := by
  have hdiv : Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat => p.1 / 2 ^ p.2) :=
    Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.fst (powTwo.comp Primrec.snd)
  exact (Primrec.eq.decide.comp
    (Primrec.nat_mod.comp hdiv (Primrec.const 2)) (Primrec.const 1)).of_eq
      (fun p => Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq.symm)

private theorem memBits (c m : Nat) : m ∈ Finset.equivBitIndices c ↔ c.testBit m = true := by
  simp only [Finset.equivBitIndices_apply, List.mem_toFinset, Nat.mem_bitIndices]

private theorem bitBound (c m : Nat) (hm : m ∈ Finset.equivBitIndices c) : m < c := by
  have h : 2 ^ m ≤ c := Nat.two_pow_le_of_mem_bitIndices (by
    simpa [Finset.equivBitIndices_apply] using hm)
  exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.lt_two_pow_self h

private def fits (p : Nat × Nat × Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ Finset.equivBitIndices p.1, m ≤ p.2.1 ∧ m ∉ Finset.equivBitIndices p.2.2

private theorem hfits : PrimrecPred fits := by
  classical
  let bitAllowed (m : Nat) (p : Nat × Nat × Nat) : Prop :=
    p.1.testBit m = false ∨ (m ≤ p.2.1 ∧ p.2.2.testBit m = false)
  have hleft : PrimrecPred (fun p : Nat × (Nat × Nat × Nat) =>
      p.2.1.testBit p.1 = false) :=
    Primrec.eq.comp (testBit.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) Primrec.fst)
      (Primrec.const false)
  have hright : PrimrecPred (fun p : Nat × (Nat × Nat × Nat) =>
      p.2.2.2.testBit p.1 = false) :=
    Primrec.eq.comp (testBit.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
      Primrec.fst) (Primrec.const false)
  have hall : PrimrecRel bitAllowed := hleft.or
    ((Primrec.nat_le.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))).and hright)
  refine (hall.forall_mem_list.comp (Primrec.list_range.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.id).of_eq ?_
  intro p
  change (∀ m ∈ List.range p.1, bitAllowed m p) ↔ fits p
  simp only [fits, List.mem_range, bitAllowed, memBits]
  constructor
  · intro h m hm
    obtain ⟨hle, hout⟩ :=
      (h m (bitBound p.1 m ((memBits _ _).mpr hm))).resolve_left (by simp [hm])
    exact ⟨hle, by simp [hout]⟩
  · intro h m _
    cases b : p.1.testBit m with
    | false => exact Or.inl rfl
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨hle, hout⟩ := h m b
      exact Or.inr ⟨hle, Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hout⟩

private def gate (reject value : Nat) : Nat := if reject = 0 then value else 0

private theorem gateOne (reject value : Nat) : gate reject value = 1 ↔ reject = 0 ∧ value = 1 := by
  by_cases h : reject = 0 <;> simp [gate, h]

private theorem hgate : Computable₂ gate :=
  (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.fst (Primrec.const 0))
    Primrec.snd (Primrec.const 0)).to_comp

-- Cintioli, §4, pp. 8–9, upper and lower strategies. The two scans use
-- the row and marker tests from those strategies. Nat.pair enumerates the
-- stage square by the first (s + 1)^2 codes, and the supplied order governs
-- which eligible pair is returned.

private theorem square (s : Nat) (q : Nat × Nat) :
    Nat.pair q.1 q.2 < (s + 1) ^ 2 ↔ q.1 ≤ s ∧ q.2 ≤ s := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : max q.1 q.2 ≤ s := by
      by_contra hn
      have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (n := s + 1) (m := max q.1 q.2) (by omega) 2
      have hl := Nat.max_sq_add_min_le_pair q.1 q.2
      omega
    exact max_le_iff.mp hm
  · intro h
    exact (Nat.pair_lt_max_add_one_sq _ _).trans_le
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le_iff.mpr h) 1) 2)

-- Keep symbolic packed bounds from being evaluated during theorem elaboration.
attribute [irreducible] scan

end PriorityBoundedSearch

external.usage: Direct application. The constructor recurses in the same singleton oracle with the packed parameter, index and accumulator. Induction identifies its total Part value with the finite least-choice fold.
Direct application to List.range of the row code and the primitive-recursive bit predicate, yielding the ordinary row inclusion and disjointness test.
Identify decoded mask membership with a bit test. The power lower bound on the code shows that scanning bit positions strictly below the code checks every member.
Prove that pair codes below (s + 1)^2 are exactly the pairs with both coordinates at most s, independently of the supplied order used to choose the minimum.

statement.type:
∀ (φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat)
    (rowAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Finset Nat)
    (pairBefore : (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat) → Prop)
    (query : Nat → Nat) (M : Set Nat),
  let K : Set Nat := {n | (φ n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2).Dom}
  let oracle : Set (Nat →. Nat) :=
    {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ K then 1 else 0))}
  Computable (fun p : Nat × Nat × Nat =>
    Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (rowAt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) →
  IsStrictTotalOrder (Nat × Nat) pairBefore →
  ComputablePred (fun p : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => pairBefore p.1 p.2) →
  Computable query →
  (∀ e x t, query (Nat.pair e (Nat.pair x t)) ∉ K ↔
    ∀ r, t ≤ r → rowAt e x r = rowAt e x t) →
  Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (by classical exact fun m => Part.some (if m ∈ M then 1 else 0)) →
  let upperCandidate (e s : Nat) (Z : Finset Nat) (q : Nat × Nat) : Prop :=
    q.1 ≤ s ∧ q.2 ≤ s ∧
    (∀ m ∈ rowAt e q.1 q.2, m ≤ s ∧ m ∉ Z) ∧
    ∀ r, q.2 ≤ r → rowAt e q.1 r = rowAt e q.1 q.2
  let lowerCandidate (e s : Nat) (content active : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) : Prop :=
    m ≤ s ∧ m ∈ M ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom ∧ m ∉ content ∧ m ∉ active
  ∃ (upperSearch : Nat → Nat → Finset Nat → Option (Nat × Nat))
    (lowerSearch : Nat → Nat → Finset Nat → Finset Nat → Option Nat),
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n =>
      let (e, args) := n.unpair
      let (s, z) := args.unpair
      Part.some (match upperSearch e s (Finset.equivBitIndices z) with
        | none => 0
        | some (x, t) => (Nat.pair x t).succ)) ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n =>
      let (e, args) := n.unpair
      let (s, sets) := args.unpair
      let (content, active) := sets.unpair
      Part.some (match lowerSearch e s (Finset.equivBitIndices content)
          (Finset.equivBitIndices active) with
        | none => 0
        | some m => m.succ)) ∧
    (∀ e s Z,
      match upperSearch e s Z with
      | none => ∀ q, ¬ upperCandidate e s Z q
      | some q => upperCandidate e s Z q ∧
          ∀ p, upperCandidate e s Z p → ¬ pairBefore p q) ∧
    (∀ e s content active,
      match lowerSearch e s content active with
      | none => ∀ m, ¬ lowerCandidate e s content active m
      | some m => lowerCandidate e s content active m ∧
          ∀ n, lowerCandidate e s content active n → m ≤ n)

PriorityCodedVisitTrace.proof:
by
  intro φ row pairBefore query M K oracle hrow horder hbefore hquery hstable hM
  -- The supplier takes the same paired-domain oracle and finite masks.
  -- Both recursions and their decoded visits use these very search witnesses.
  obtain ⟨U, L, hu, hl, hU, hL⟩ :=
    PriorityBoundedOracleSearches φ row pairBefore query M hrow horder hbefore hquery hstable hM
  change Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some (PriorityCodedTrace.upperCode U n)) at hu
  change Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some (PriorityCodedTrace.lowerCode L n)) at hl
  change PriorityCodedTrace.UpperCorrect row pairBefore U at hU
  change PriorityCodedTrace.LowerCorrect φ M L at hL
  obtain ⟨htrace, hcontent, hrestraints⟩ :=
    PriorityCodedTrace.traceComputations row U L oracle hrow hu hl
  exact ⟨U, L, hu, hl, hU, hL, htrace, hcontent, hrestraints, PriorityCodedTrace.traceLaws hU hL⟩

namespace PriorityCodedTrace

-- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §4, pp. 8–9 and Remark 6, p. 13.
-- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8
-- Both article-specific routes returned HTTP 404.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
-- Pages 8–9 use all natural numbers as potential markers. The coordinator
-- also needs the restriction to M for the c.e. branch. In either instance
-- the supplier certifies the selected candidates and their minimality.
-- The supplier's arithmetic and closure helpers are private. The corresponding
-- local proofs below use the same bit coding and the native oracle constructors.
-- Alphabeta Math, prop-basic-arithmetic-and-bounded-quantification-are-primitive-recursive,
-- Step 2.2, uses bounded iteration with a finite accumulator.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/prop-basic-arithmetic-and-bounded-quantification-are-primitive-recursive
-- Here the finite arithmetic uses the same principle. For visits and stages
-- the step invokes the compiled oracle searches, so we use RecursiveIn.prec.

private theorem powTwo : Primrec (fun i : Nat => 2 ^ i) := by
  have hstep : Primrec₂ (fun (_ : Unit) (p : Nat × Nat) => p.2 * 2) :=
    Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.const 2)
  refine ((Primrec.nat_rec (Primrec.const 1) hstep).comp
    (Primrec.const ()) Primrec.id).of_eq ?_
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    exact (congrArg (· * 2) ih).trans (Nat.pow_succ 2 i).symm

private theorem bitTest : Primrec₂ Nat.testBit := by
  have hdiv : Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat => p.1 / 2 ^ p.2) :=
    Primrec.nat_div.comp Primrec.fst (powTwo.comp Primrec.snd)
  exact (Primrec.eq.decide.comp
    (Primrec.nat_mod.comp hdiv (Primrec.const 2)) (Primrec.const 1)).of_eq
      (fun p => Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq.symm)

private theorem bitBuild : Primrec₂ Nat.bit := by
  exact (Primrec.cond Primrec.fst (Primrec.nat_double_succ.comp Primrec.snd)
    (Primrec.nat_double.comp Primrec.snd)).of_eq
      (fun p => by rcases p with ⟨b, n⟩; cases b <;> simp [Nat.bit_val])

private def orRec (a b bound : Nat) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.rec 0 (fun k acc =>
    Nat.bit (a.testBit (bound - (k + 1)) || b.testBit (bound - (k + 1))) acc) i

private theorem orRec_bit (a b bound i m : Nat) (hi : i ≤ bound) :
    (orRec a b bound i).testBit m =
      if m < i then a.testBit (bound - i + m) || b.testBit (bound - i + m) else false := by
  induction i generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [orRec, Nat.zero_testBit]
  | succ i ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [orRec]
    | succ m =>
      have heq : bound - i + m = bound - (i + 1) + (m + 1) := by omega
      simp only [orRec, Nat.testBit_bit_succ]
      change (orRec a b bound i).testBit m = _
      rw [ih _ (by omega), heq]
      simp

private theorem primOr : Primrec₂ Nat.lor := by
  let index (p : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat)) :=
    (p.1.1 + p.1.2) - (p.2.1 + 1)
  have hindex : Primrec index :=
    Primrec.nat_sub.comp (Primrec.nat_add.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
      (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst)) (Primrec.succ.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd))
  have ha := bitTest.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.fst : Primrec (Prod.fst :
    (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) → Nat × Nat))) hindex
  have hb := bitTest.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst : Primrec (Prod.fst :
    (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) → Nat × Nat))) hindex
  have hbit : Primrec₂ (fun (p : Nat × Nat) (q : Nat × Nat) =>
      Nat.bit (p.1.testBit (index (p, q)) || p.2.testBit (index (p, q))) q.2) :=
    bitBuild.comp ((Primrec.cond ha (Primrec.const true) hb).of_eq (fun p => by cases p.1.1.testBit (index p) <;> rfl)) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  refine (Primrec.nat_rec' (Primrec.nat_add : Primrec₂ Nat.add) (Primrec.const 0) hbit).of_eq ?_
  intro ⟨a, b⟩
  change orRec a b (a + b) (a + b) = a ||| b
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro m
  rw [orRec_bit _ _ _ _ _ le_rfl, Nat.testBit_lor, Nat.sub_self, Nat.zero_add]
  split
  · rfl
  · rw [Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt (n := a) (by
          exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (by omega) Nat.lt_two_pow_self),
        Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt (n := b) (by
          exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (by omega) Nat.lt_two_pow_self)]
    rfl

abbrev Bits := Finset.equivBitIndices

private theorem memBits (c m : Nat) : m ∈ Bits c ↔ c.testBit m = true := by
  simp only [Finset.equivBitIndices_apply, List.mem_toFinset, Nat.mem_bitIndices]

private theorem bitsOr (a b : Nat) : Bits (a ||| b) = Bits a ∪ Bits b := by
  ext m
  simp

private theorem bitsZero : Bits 0 = ∅ := by
  ext m
  simp

abbrev UpperSearch := Nat → Nat → Finset Nat → Option (Nat × Nat)
abbrev LowerSearch := Nat → Nat → Finset Nat → Finset Nat → Option Nat
abbrev Rows := Nat → Nat → Nat → Finset Nat

def upperCode (U : UpperSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  let (e, args) := n.unpair
  let (s, z) := args.unpair
  match U e s (Bits z) with
  | none => 0
  | some (x, t) => (Nat.pair x t).succ

def lowerCode (L : LowerSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  let (e, args) := n.unpair
  let (s, sets) := args.unpair
  let (content, active) := sets.unpair
  match L e s (Bits content) (Bits active) with
  | none => 0
  | some m => m.succ

def UpperCandidate (row : Rows) (e s : Nat) (Z : Finset Nat) (q : Nat × Nat) : Prop :=
  q.1 ≤ s ∧ q.2 ≤ s ∧
  (∀ m ∈ row e q.1 q.2, m ≤ s ∧ m ∉ Z) ∧
  ∀ r, q.2 ≤ r → row e q.1 r = row e q.1 q.2

def LowerCandidate (φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat) (M : Set Nat)
    (e s : Nat) (content active : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) : Prop :=
  m ≤ s ∧ m ∈ M ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom ∧ m ∉ content ∧ m ∉ active

def UpperCorrect (row : Rows) (before : (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat) → Prop)
    (U : UpperSearch) : Prop :=
  ∀ e s Z, match U e s Z with
    | none => ∀ q, ¬ UpperCandidate row e s Z q
    | some q => UpperCandidate row e s Z q ∧ ∀ p, UpperCandidate row e s Z p → ¬ before p q

def LowerCorrect (φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat) (M : Set Nat) (L : LowerSearch) : Prop :=
  ∀ e s content active, match L e s content active with
    | none => ∀ m, ¬ LowerCandidate φ M e s content active m
    | some m => LowerCandidate φ M e s content active m ∧
        ∀ n, LowerCandidate φ M e s content active n → m ≤ n

abbrev State := Finset Nat × (Nat → Option Nat) × (Nat → Bool)

def initial : State := (∅, fun _ => none, fun _ => false)

def markerSet (marker : Nat → Option Nat) (p : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (Finset.range p).biUnion fun j =>
    if 2 * j + 1 < p then
      match marker j with
      | none => ∅
      | some m => {m}
    else ∅

theorem memMarkerSet (marker : Nat → Option Nat) (p m : Nat) :
    m ∈ markerSet marker p ↔ ∃ j, 2 * j + 1 < p ∧ marker j = some m := by
  simp only [markerSet, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, _, h⟩
    split at h
    · cases he : marker j <;> simp_all
      exact ⟨j, by assumption, by assumption⟩
    · simp at h
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, hm⟩
    refine ⟨j, by omega, ?_⟩
    simp [hj, hm]

def upperAction (U : UpperSearch) (s e : Nat) (a : State) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  if a.2.2 e then none else U e s (markerSet a.2.1 (2 * e))

def visit (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s k : Nat) (a : State) : State :=
  let e := k / 2
  if k % 2 = 0 then
    match upperAction U s e a with
    | none => a
    | some (x, t) =>
      let F := row e x t
      let remaining (j : Nat) :=
        match a.2.1 j with
        | none => none
        | some m => if k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ m ∈ F then none else some m
      (a.1 ∪ F, remaining, Function.update a.2.2 e true)
  else
    match a.2.1 e with
    | some _ => a
    | none => (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 e (L e s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s)), a.2.2)

def visits (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s : Nat) (a : State) (k : Nat) :
    State := Nat.rec a (fun p prev => visit row U L s p prev) k

def start (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s : Nat) : State :=
  Nat.rec initial (fun r prev => visits row U L r prev r) s

def state (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s k : Nat) : State :=
  visits row U L s (start row U L s) (min k s)

def chosenPair (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s e : Nat) :
    Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  if 2 * e < s then upperAction U s e (state row U L s (2 * e)) else none

def restraints (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s e : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  markerSet (state row U L s (2 * e)).2.1 (2 * e)


-- The table stores 0 for an empty slot and m+1 for a live marker m.
-- Unstored indices decode to empty slots. The two Nat fields are the bit
-- masks for content and completed upper requirements.
private abbrev Table := List Nat
private abbrev Raw := Nat × Table × Nat
private abbrev Input := Nat × Nat × Raw

private def lookup (a : Table) (j : Nat) : Nat := a.getD j 0

private def markerAt (a : Table) (j : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match lookup a j with
  | 0 => none
  | m + 1 => some m

private def decodeState (a : Raw) : State :=
  (Bits a.1, markerAt a.2.1, a.2.2.testBit)

private def singleMask (a : Table) (p j : Nat) : Nat :=
  if 2 * j + 1 < p ∧ lookup a j ≠ 0 then 2 ^ (lookup a j).pred else 0

private def mask (a : Table) (p : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range p).foldr (fun j acc => singleMask a p j ||| acc) 0

private theorem singleMask_bits (a : Table) (p j : Nat) :
    Bits (singleMask a p j) =
      if 2 * j + 1 < p then
        match markerAt a j with
        | none => ∅
        | some m => {m}
      else ∅ := by
  unfold singleMask markerAt
  by_cases h : 2 * j + 1 < p
  · cases he : lookup a j <;> simp [h]
  · simp [h]

private theorem mask_bits (a : Table) (p : Nat) : Bits (mask a p) = markerSet (markerAt a) p := by
  have fold (l : List Nat) (m : Nat) :
      m ∈ Bits (l.foldr (fun j acc => singleMask a p j ||| acc) 0) ↔
        ∃ j ∈ l, m ∈ Bits (singleMask a p j) := by
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons j l ih =>
      rw [List.foldr_cons, bitsOr, Finset.mem_union, ih]
      simp only [List.mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
  ext m
  simpa only [mask, markerSet, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_range, List.mem_range,
    singleMask_bits] using fold (List.range p) m

private def tabulate (n : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : Table := (List.range n).map f

private theorem lookupTabulate (n j : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) :
    lookup (tabulate n f) j = if j < n then f j else 0 := by
  simp only [lookup, tabulate, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map]
  split
