  · simp [List.getElem?_range ‹_›]
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.mpr (by simpa using (Nat.le_of_not_lt ‹¬ j < n›))]
    rfl

private theorem lookupOut (a : Table) (j : Nat) (h : a.length ≤ j) : lookup a j = 0 := by
  simp [lookup, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.mpr h]

private def cancel (k c : Nat) (a : Table) : Table :=
  tabulate a.length fun j =>
    if k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ c.testBit (lookup a j).pred = true then 0 else lookup a j

private def allocate (e value : Nat) (a : Table) : Table :=
  tabulate (max a.length (e + 1)) fun j => if j = e then value else lookup a j

private theorem lookupCancel (k c : Nat) (a : Table) (j : Nat) :
    lookup (cancel k c a) j =
      if k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ c.testBit (lookup a j).pred = true then 0 else lookup a j := by
  rw [cancel, lookupTabulate]
  split
  · rfl
  · rw [lookupOut a j (by omega)]
    split <;> rfl

private theorem lookupAllocate (e value : Nat) (a : Table) (j : Nat) :
    lookup (allocate e value a) j = if j = e then value else lookup a j := by
  rw [allocate, lookupTabulate]
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i h
    have hn := Nat.le_of_not_lt h
    have hlen : a.length ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_left ..) hn
    have hne : j ≠ e := by have := le_trans (le_max_right a.length (e + 1)) hn; omega
    simp [hne, lookupOut a j hlen]

private def upperArg (p : Input) : Nat :=
  Nat.pair (p.2.1 / 2) (Nat.pair p.1 (mask p.2.2.2.1 (2 * (p.2.1 / 2))))

private def lowerArg (p : Input) : Nat :=
  Nat.pair (p.2.1 / 2)
    (Nat.pair p.1 (Nat.pair p.2.2.1 (mask p.2.2.2.1 p.1)))

private def rowArg (p : Input × Nat) : Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (p.1.2.1 / 2, p.2.pred.unpair.1, p.2.pred.unpair.2)

private def combine (b : Input × Nat × Nat × Nat) : Raw :=
  let (p, u, l, c) := b
  let (_, k, a) := p
  let e := k / 2
  if k % 2 = 0 then
    if a.2.2.testBit e = true ∨ u = 0 then a
    else (a.1 ||| c, cancel k c a.2.1, a.2.2 ||| (2 ^ e))
  else
    if lookup a.2.1 e = 0 then (a.1, allocate e l a.2.1, a.2.2) else a

private def rawVisit (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (s k : Nat) (a : Raw) : Raw :=
  let p : Input := (s, k, a)
  let u := upperCode U (upperArg p)
  let l := lowerCode L (lowerArg p)
  let q := rowArg (p, u)
  combine (p, u, l, Bits.symm (row q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2))

private theorem markerCancel (a : Table) (k c j : Nat) :
    markerAt (cancel k c a) j =
      match markerAt a j with
      | none => none
      | some m => if k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ m ∈ Bits c then none else some m := by
  unfold markerAt
  rw [lookupCancel]
  cases h : lookup a j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m =>
    simp only [Nat.pred_succ, memBits]
    by_cases hm : k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ c.testBit m = true
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hm]
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hm]

private theorem markerAllocate (a : Table) (e j : Nat) (o : Option Nat) :
    markerAt (allocate e (o.elim 0 Nat.succ) a) j = Function.update (markerAt a) e o j := by
  by_cases h : j = e
  · subst j
    simp only [markerAt, lookupAllocate, Function.update_self]
    cases o <;> rfl
  · simp [markerAt, lookupAllocate, h, Function.update_of_ne]

private theorem rawVisit_decode (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (s k : Nat) (a : Raw) :
    decodeState (rawVisit row U L s k a) = visit row U L s k (decodeState a) := by
  simp only [rawVisit, upperArg, lowerArg, upperCode, lowerCode, Nat.unpair_pair, mask_bits,
    combine, visit, upperAction, decodeState]
  let e := k / 2
  change (decodeState (if k % 2 = 0 then _ else _)) = _
  by_cases h : k % 2 = 0
  · simp only [ite_eq_left h]
    by_cases hd : a.2.2.testBit (k / 2) = true
    · simp [hd, decodeState]
    · cases hu : U (k / 2) s (markerSet (markerAt a.2.1) (2 * (k / 2))) with
      | none => simp [hd, decodeState]
      | some q =>
        rcases q with ⟨x,t⟩
        simp only [hd, Bool.false_eq_true, false_or, Nat.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, rowArg,
          Nat.pred_succ, Nat.unpair_pair, decodeState, bitsOr, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
          Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
        constructor
        · funext j
          rw [markerCancel, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        · funext j
          by_cases hj : j = k / 2
          · subst j
            simp
          · simp [Ne.symm hj, Function.update_of_ne hj]
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h]
    cases hl : lookup a.2.1 e with
    | zero =>
      have hm : markerAt a.2.1 (k / 2) = none := by simp [markerAt, ← show e = k / 2 from rfl, hl]
      simp only [hm, ite_true, decodeState,
        Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
      cases hL : L e s (Bits a.1) (markerSet (markerAt a.2.1) s) with
      | none =>
        exact funext (fun j => markerAllocate a.2.1 e j none)
      | some m =>
        exact funext (fun j => markerAllocate a.2.1 e j (some m))
    | succ m =>
      have hm : markerAt a.2.1 (k / 2) = some m := by
        simp [markerAt, ← show e = k / 2 from rfl, hl]
      simp [hm, decodeState]


private theorem primLookup : Primrec₂ lookup := Primrec.list_getD 0

private theorem primLowerIndex : Primrec (fun j : Nat => 2 * j + 1) := Primrec.nat_double_succ

private theorem primMask : Primrec₂ mask := by
  -- The parameter of the fold is (table, priority cutoff).
  let cut : Table × Nat → Nat := Prod.snd
  let j : (Table × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) → Nat := fun q => q.2.1
  let tbl : (Table × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) → Table := fun q => q.1.1
  have hj : Primrec j := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have ht : Primrec tbl := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst
  have hv := primLookup.comp ht hj
  have hp : Primrec (fun q : (Table × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => cut q.1) :=
    Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.fst
  have hl := Primrec.nat_lt.comp (primLowerIndex.comp hj) hp
  have hn := (Primrec.eq.comp hv (Primrec.const 0)).not
  have hm : Primrec (fun q => singleMask (tbl q) (cut q.1) (j q)) :=
    Primrec.ite (hl.and hn) (powTwo.comp (Primrec.pred.comp hv)) (Primrec.const 0)
  exact Primrec.list_foldr (Primrec.list_range.comp (Primrec.snd : Primrec cut))
    (Primrec.const 0) (primOr.comp hm (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂

private theorem primCancel : Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat × Table => cancel p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
  let P := Nat × Nat × Table
  have ht : Primrec (fun p : P => p.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  have hj : Primrec (fun p : P × Nat => p.2) := Primrec.snd
  have hv := primLookup.comp (ht.comp Primrec.fst) hj
  have hb := bitTest.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.fst :
    Primrec (Prod.fst : P × Nat → P)))) (Primrec.pred.comp hv)
  have hk : Primrec (fun p : P × Nat => p.1.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst
  unfold cancel tabulate
  exact Primrec.list_map (Primrec.list_range.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp ht))
    (Primrec.ite ((Primrec.nat_lt.comp hk (primLowerIndex.comp hj)).and
      (Primrec.eq.comp hb (Primrec.const true))) (Primrec.const 0) hv)

private theorem primAllocate :
    Primrec (fun p : Nat × Nat × Table => allocate p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
  let P := Nat × Nat × Table
  have ht : Primrec (fun p : P => p.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
  have he : Primrec (fun p : P => p.1) := Primrec.fst
  have hv : Primrec (fun p : P => p.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  unfold allocate tabulate
  exact Primrec.list_map (Primrec.list_range.comp
    (Primrec.nat_max.comp (Primrec.list_length.comp ht) (Primrec.succ.comp he)))
    (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp Primrec.snd (he.comp Primrec.fst))
      (hv.comp Primrec.fst) (primLookup.comp (ht.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.snd))

private theorem primStage : Primrec (fun p : Input => p.1) := Primrec.fst
private theorem primVisitIndex : Primrec (fun p : Input => p.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
private theorem primRaw : Primrec (fun p : Input => p.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd
private theorem primIndex : Primrec (fun p : Input => p.2.1 / 2) :=
  Primrec.nat_div.comp primVisitIndex (Primrec.const 2)

private theorem primUpperArg : Primrec upperArg :=
  Primrec₂.natPair.comp primIndex (Primrec₂.natPair.comp primStage
    (primMask.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp primRaw))
      (Primrec.nat_double.comp primIndex)))

private theorem primLowerArg : Primrec lowerArg :=
  Primrec₂.natPair.comp primIndex (Primrec₂.natPair.comp primStage
    (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp primRaw)
      (primMask.comp (Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp primRaw)) primStage)))

private theorem primRowArg : Primrec rowArg :=
  (primIndex.comp Primrec.fst).pair (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.pred.comp Primrec.snd))

private theorem primCombine : Primrec combine := by
  let B := Input × Nat × Nat × Nat
  have hi : Primrec (Prod.fst : B → Input) := Primrec.fst
  have he := primIndex.comp hi
  have hk := primVisitIndex.comp hi
  have ha := primRaw.comp hi
  have hc : Primrec (fun b : B => b.2.2.2) := Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have hu : Primrec (fun b : B => b.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
  have hl : Primrec (fun b : B => b.2.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)
  have ht := Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp ha)
  have hd := Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp ha)
  have hn := Primrec.fst.comp ha
  have upper := (primOr.comp hn hc).pair
    ((primCancel.comp (hk.pair (hc.pair ht))).pair (primOr.comp hd (powTwo.comp he)))
  have lower := hn.pair ((primAllocate.comp (he.pair (hl.pair ht))).pair hd)
  unfold combine
  exact Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp (Primrec.nat_mod.comp hk (Primrec.const 2))
    (Primrec.const 0)) (Primrec.ite ((Primrec.eq.comp (bitTest.comp hd he)
      (Primrec.const true)).or (Primrec.eq.comp hu (Primrec.const 0))) ha upper)
    (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp (primLookup.comp ht he) (Primrec.const 0)) lower ha)

private abbrev Total (O : Set (Nat →. Nat)) (f : Nat → Nat) :=
  Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (f n))

private theorem lift {O : Set (Nat →. Nat)} {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : Computable f) :
    Total O f :=
  RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hf.computableIn

private theorem comp {O : Set (Nat →. Nat)} {f g : Nat → Nat}
    (hf : Total O f) (hg : Total O g) : Total O (fun n => f (g n)) :=
  (Nat.RecursiveIn.comp hf hg).of_eq (fun _ => Part.bind_some _ _)

private theorem pair {O : Set (Nat →. Nat)} {f g : Nat → Nat}
    (hf : Total O f) (hg : Total O g) : Total O (fun n => Nat.pair (f n) (g n)) :=
  (Nat.RecursiveIn.pair hf hg).of_eq (fun n => by
    change Part.map Nat.pair (Part.some (f n)) <*> Part.some (g n) = _
    rw [Part.map_some, ← Part.pure_eq_some (Nat.pair (f n)), pure_seq]
    exact Part.map_some _ _)

private theorem prec {O : Set (Nat →. Nat)} {base step : Nat → Nat}
    (hb : Total O base) (hs : Total O step) :
    Total O (fun p =>
      let (a,n) := p.unpair
      Nat.rec (base a) (fun k acc => step (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair k acc))) n) := by
  refine (Nat.RecursiveIn.prec hb hs).of_eq ?_
  intro p
  dsimp only
  cases hp : p.unpair with
  | mk a n =>
   clear hp p
   induction n with
   | zero => rfl
   | succ n ih =>
     change Part.bind _ _ = _
     rw [ih, Part.bind_some]

private def decoded {α : Type} [Encodable α] (d : α) (n : Nat) : α :=
  (Encodable.decode n).getD d

private theorem primDecoded {α : Type} [Primcodable α] (d : α) : Primrec (decoded d) :=
  Primrec.option_getD.comp Primrec.decode (Primrec.const d)

private theorem decoded_encode {α : Type} [Encodable α] (d x : α) :
    decoded d (Encodable.encode x) = x := by simp [decoded, Encodable.encodek]

private def rawInitial : Raw := (0, [], 0)
private def inputDefault : Input := (0, 0, rawInitial)

private def codedVisit (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  let p := decoded inputDefault n
  Encodable.encode (rawVisit row U L p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

private theorem codedVisit_total
    (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (O : Set (Nat →. Nat))
    (hrow : Computable (fun p : Nat × Nat × Nat => Bits.symm (row p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)))
    (hu : Total O (upperCode U)) (hl : Total O (lowerCode L)) :
    Total O (codedVisit row U L) := by
  classical
  let a := decoded inputDefault
  let u n := upperCode U (upperArg (a n))
  let l n := lowerCode L (lowerArg (a n))
  let b : Nat × Nat → Input × Nat := fun p => (a p.1, p.2)
  have ha := primDecoded inputDefault
  have hb : Primrec b := (ha.comp Primrec.fst).pair Primrec.snd
  have hu' : Total O u := comp hu (lift (primUpperArg.comp ha).to_comp)
  have hl' : Total O l := comp hl (lift (primLowerArg.comp ha).to_comp)
  have hc : Total O (fun n =>
      Bits.symm (row (rowArg (a n, u n)).1 (rowArg (a n, u n)).2.1
        (rowArg (a n, u n)).2.2)) :=
    (comp (lift (hrow.comp ((primRowArg.comp hb).to_comp.comp Computable.unpair)))
      (pair (lift Computable.id) hu')).of_eq (fun _ => by simp only [Nat.unpair_pair, b, id_eq])
  have htail : Primrec (fun n : Nat => n.unpair.2.unpair) :=
    Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)
  have hpost : Computable (fun n : Nat => Encodable.encode
      (combine (a n.unpair.1, n.unpair.2.unpair.1,
        n.unpair.2.unpair.2.unpair.1, n.unpair.2.unpair.2.unpair.2))) :=
    (Primrec.encode.comp (primCombine.comp
      ((ha.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair)).pair
        ((Primrec.fst.comp htail).pair (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp htail)))))).to_comp
  -- All three functions supplied to this composition are total. Its selector
  -- only commits the branch specified by the parity, done flag and live marker.
  exact (comp (lift hpost) (pair (lift Computable.id) (pair hu' (pair hl' hc)))).of_eq
    (fun n => by simp only [Nat.unpair_pair, codedVisit, rawVisit, a, u, l, id_eq])


private def innerStep (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  codedVisit row U L (Encodable.encode
    (n.unpair.1.unpair.1, n.unpair.2.unpair.1, decoded rawInitial n.unpair.2.unpair.2))

private def inner (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  let (a, k) := n.unpair
  Nat.rec a.unpair.2 (fun j acc => innerStep row U L (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair j acc))) k

private theorem inner_total (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (O : Set (Nat →. Nat)) (hv : Total O (codedVisit row U L)) :
    Total O (inner row U L) := by
  have hleft : Primrec (fun n : Nat => n.unpair.1.unpair.1) :=
    Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair))
  have hright : Primrec (fun n : Nat => n.unpair.2.unpair) :=
    Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)
  have harg : Primrec (fun n : Nat =>
      Encodable.encode (n.unpair.1.unpair.1, n.unpair.2.unpair.1,
        decoded rawInitial n.unpair.2.unpair.2)) :=
    Primrec.encode.comp (hleft.pair ((Primrec.fst.comp hright).pair
      ((primDecoded rawInitial).comp (Primrec.snd.comp hright))))
  have ht : Total O (innerStep row U L) := by
    unfold innerStep
    exact comp (f := codedVisit row U L) hv (lift harg.to_comp)
  unfold inner
  exact prec (base := fun a => a.unpair.2) (step := innerStep row U L)
    (lift (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair).to_comp) ht

private theorem inner_decode (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (s k v : Nat) :
    decodeState (decoded rawInitial (inner row U L (Nat.pair (Nat.pair s v) k))) =
      visits row U L s (decodeState (decoded rawInitial v)) k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [inner, visits, Nat.unpair_pair]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [inner, Nat.unpair_pair] at ih ⊢
    change decodeState (decoded rawInitial (innerStep row U L
      (Nat.pair (Nat.pair s v) (Nat.pair k _)))) = visit row U L s k _
    have hs j acc : innerStep row U L (Nat.pair (Nat.pair s v) (Nat.pair j acc)) =
        Encodable.encode (rawVisit row U L s j (decoded rawInitial acc)) := by
      simp only [innerStep, Nat.unpair_pair, codedVisit, decoded_encode]
    rw [hs, decoded_encode, rawVisit_decode, ih]; rfl

private def outerStep (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  inner row U L (Nat.pair (Nat.pair n.unpair.2.unpair.1 n.unpair.2.unpair.2)
    n.unpair.2.unpair.1)

private def outer (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.rec (Encodable.encode rawInitial)
    (fun r prev => outerStep row U L (Nat.pair 0 (Nat.pair r prev))) s

private theorem outer_total (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (O : Set (Nat →. Nat)) (hi : Total O (inner row U L)) :
    Total O (outer row U L) := by
  have htail := Primrec.unpair.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)
  have harg : Primrec (fun n : Nat =>
      Nat.pair (Nat.pair n.unpair.2.unpair.1 n.unpair.2.unpair.2) n.unpair.2.unpair.1) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp htail)
      (Primrec.snd.comp htail)) (Primrec.fst.comp htail)
  have hs : Total O (outerStep row U L) := by
    unfold outerStep
    exact comp (f := inner row U L) hi (lift harg.to_comp)
  exact (comp (prec (lift (Computable.const (Encodable.encode rawInitial))) hs)
    (lift (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.const 0) Primrec.id).to_comp)).of_eq
      (fun n => by simp only [Nat.unpair_pair, outer, id_eq])

private theorem outer_decode (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s : Nat) :
    decodeState (decoded rawInitial (outer row U L s)) = start row U L s := by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    change decodeState (decoded rawInitial (Encodable.encode rawInitial)) = initial
    rw [decoded_encode]
    have hmarker : markerAt [] = fun _ => none := by
      funext j
      simp [markerAt, lookup]
    have hdone : Nat.testBit 0 = fun _ => false := funext Nat.zero_testBit
    simp only [decodeState, rawInitial, initial, bitsZero, hmarker, hdone]
  | succ s ih =>
    change decodeState (decoded rawInitial
      (outerStep row U L (Nat.pair 0 (Nat.pair s (outer row U L s))))) =
        visits row U L s (start row U L s) s
    simp only [outerStep, Nat.unpair_pair, inner_decode, ih]

/-- The input is the pair of the stage number and the number of visits requested. -/
def traceCode (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  inner row U L
    (Nat.pair (Nat.pair n.unpair.1 (outer row U L n.unpair.1)) (min n.unpair.2 n.unpair.1))

private theorem traceCode_total (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (O : Set (Nat →. Nat)) (hi : Total O (inner row U L))
    (ho : Total O (outer row U L)) : Total O (traceCode row U L) := by
  have hs : Primrec (fun n : Nat => n.unpair.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair
  have hk : Primrec (fun n : Nat => n.unpair.2) := Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair
  unfold traceCode
  exact comp (f := inner row U L) hi (pair (pair (lift hs.to_comp)
    (comp (f := outer row U L) ho (lift hs.to_comp))) (lift (Primrec.nat_min.comp hk hs).to_comp))

def decodeVisitCode (n : Nat) : State :=
  decodeState (decoded rawInitial n)

/-- Decoding a visit code gives the nested recursion used by the article. -/
theorem traceCode_decode (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s k : Nat) :
    decodeVisitCode (traceCode row U L (Nat.pair s k)) = state row U L s k := by
  simp only [decodeVisitCode, traceCode, Nat.unpair_pair, inner_decode, outer_decode, state]

private theorem restraint_code_eq (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (s e : Nat) :
    mask (decoded rawInitial (traceCode row U L (Nat.pair s (2 * e)))).2.1 (2 * e) =
      Bits.symm (restraints row U L s e) := by
  apply Bits.injective
  rw [mask_bits, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have he := congrArg (fun a : State => a.2.1) (traceCode_decode row U L s (2 * e))
  simp only [decodeVisitCode, decodeState] at he
  unfold restraints
  rw [he]

theorem traceComputations (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (O : Set (Nat →. Nat))
    (hrow : Computable (fun p : Nat × Nat × Nat => Bits.symm (row p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)))
    (hu : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (upperCode U n)))
    (hl : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (lowerCode L n))) :
    Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (traceCode row U L n)) ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun s => Part.some (Bits.symm (state row U L s s).1)) ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some
      (Bits.symm (restraints row U L n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2))) := by
  have hv := codedVisit_total row U L O hrow hu hl
  have hi := inner_total row U L O hv
  have ht := traceCode_total row U L O hi (outer_total row U L O hi)
  refine ⟨ht, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ha : Primrec (fun n : Nat => (decoded rawInitial n).1) :=
      Primrec.fst.comp (primDecoded rawInitial)
    refine (comp (lift ha.to_comp) (comp ht (lift
      (Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.id Primrec.id).to_comp))).of_eq ?_
    intro s
    have he := congrArg Prod.fst (traceCode_decode row U L s s)
    simp only [decodeVisitCode, decodeState] at he
    change Part.some (decoded rawInitial (traceCode row U L (Nat.pair s s))).1 = _
    rw [← he, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · have harg : Primrec (fun n : Nat => Nat.pair n.unpair.1 (2 * n.unpair.2)) :=
      Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair)
        (Primrec.nat_double.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair))
    have htable : Primrec (fun n => (decoded rawInitial n).2.1) :=
      Primrec.fst.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (primDecoded rawInitial))
    have hp : Primrec (fun n : Nat => 2 * n.unpair.2) :=
      Primrec.nat_double.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)
    have hpost : Primrec (fun n : Nat => mask (decoded rawInitial n.unpair.1).2.1 n.unpair.2) :=
      primMask.comp (htable.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair))
        (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair)
    refine (comp (lift hpost.to_comp) (pair (comp ht (lift harg.to_comp))
      (lift hp.to_comp))).of_eq ?_
    intro n
    simp only [Nat.unpair_pair]
    exact congrArg Part.some (restraint_code_eq row U L n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2)


section Laws

variable {φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat} {row : Rows} {M : Set Nat}
  {U : UpperSearch} {L : LowerSearch}
  {before : (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat) → Prop}

private def remaining (k : Nat) (F : Finset Nat) (marker : Nat → Option Nat) (j : Nat) :
    Option Nat :=
  match marker j with
  | none => none
  | some m => if k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ m ∈ F then none else some m

private theorem upperVisit (s i : Nat) (a : State) :
    visit row U L s (2 * i) a =
      match upperAction U s i a with
      | none => a
      | some (x,t) =>
        (a.1 ∪ row i x t, remaining (2 * i) (row i x t) a.2.1, Function.update a.2.2 i true) := by
  have hm : (2 * i) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hd : (2 * i) / 2 = i := by omega
  simp only [visit, hm, hd, ite_true]
  rfl

private theorem lowerVisit (s i : Nat) (a : State) :
    visit row U L s (2 * i + 1) a =
      match a.2.1 i with
      | none => (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 i (L i s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s)), a.2.2)
      | some _ => a := by
  have hm : ¬ (2 * i + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hd : (2 * i + 1) / 2 = i := by omega
  simp only [visit, hm, hd, ite_false]
  cases a.2.1 i <;> rfl

private theorem updateSame (marker : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) :
    Function.update marker i (marker i) = marker := by
  funext j
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j; simp
  · exact Function.update_of_ne h _ _

private inductive Step (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch)
    (s k : Nat) (a : State) : State → Prop
  | unchanged : Step row U L s k a a
  | upper (i : Nat) (q : Nat × Nat) (hk : k = 2 * i)
      (hq : upperAction U s i a = some q) :
      Step row U L s k a
        (a.1 ∪ row i q.1 q.2, remaining k (row i q.1 q.2) a.2.1, Function.update a.2.2 i true)
  | lower (i m : Nat) (hk : k = 2 * i + 1) (hi : a.2.1 i = none)
      (hm : L i s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s) = some m) :
      Step row U L s k a (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 i (some m), a.2.2)

private theorem step (s k : Nat) (a : State) :
    Step row U L s k a (visit row U L s k a) := by
  let i := k / 2
  by_cases h : k % 2 = 0
  · have hk : k = 2 * i := by dsimp [i]; omega
    rw [hk, upperVisit]
    cases hq : upperAction U s i a with
    | none => exact .unchanged
    | some q =>
      rcases q with ⟨x,t⟩
      exact .upper _ _ rfl hq
  · have hk : k = 2 * i + 1 := by dsimp [i]; omega
    rw [hk, lowerVisit]
    cases hi : a.2.1 i with
    | some m => exact .unchanged
    | none =>
      cases hm : L i s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s) with
      | some m => exact .lower _ _ rfl hi hm
      | none =>
        change Step row U L s (2 * i + 1) a (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 i none, a.2.2)
        rw [← hi, updateSame]
        cases a; exact .unchanged

private theorem upperSome (hU : UpperCorrect row before U) {s i : Nat} {a : State}
    {q : Nat × Nat} (hq : upperAction U s i a = some q) :
    a.2.2 i = false ∧ UpperCandidate row i s (markerSet a.2.1 (2 * i)) q := by
  have hb : a.2.2 i ≠ true := by
    intro h
    simp [upperAction, h] at hq
  have hf : a.2.2 i = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hb
  have hu : U i s (markerSet a.2.1 (2 * i)) = some q := by
    simpa [upperAction, hf] using hq
  have hc := hU i s (markerSet a.2.1 (2 * i))
  rw [hu] at hc
  exact ⟨hf, hc.1⟩

private theorem lowerSome (hL : LowerCorrect φ M L) {s i : Nat} {a : State}
    {m : Nat} (hm : L i s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s) = some m) :
    LowerCandidate φ M i s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s) m := by
  have hc := hL i s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s)
  rw [hm] at hc
  exact hc.1

private theorem remainingSome {k : Nat} {F : Finset Nat}
    {marker : Nat → Option Nat} {j m : Nat} (hm : remaining k F marker j = some m) :
    marker j = some m ∧ ¬ (k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ m ∈ F) := by
  unfold remaining at hm
  cases he : marker j with
  | none => simp [he] at hm
  | some n =>
    by_cases h : k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ n ∈ F
    · simp only [he, ite_eq_left h, reduceCtorEq] at hm
    · simp only [he, ite_eq_right h, Option.some.injEq] at hm
      subst m
      exact ⟨rfl, h⟩

private theorem remainingNone {k : Nat} {F : Finset Nat}
    {marker : Nat → Option Nat} {j m : Nat} (hm : marker j = some m)
    (hn : remaining k F marker j = none) : k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ m ∈ F := by
  by_cases h : k < 2 * j + 1 ∧ m ∈ F
  · exact h
  · simp only [remaining, hm, ite_eq_right h, reduceCtorEq] at hn

private structure Valid (φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat) (M : Set Nat) (s : Nat) (a : State) : Prop where
  contentBound : ∀ m ∈ a.1, m ≤ s
  markerBound : ∀ i m, a.2.1 i = some m → m ≤ s
  visited : ∀ i m, a.2.1 i = some m → 2 * i + 1 < s
  active : ∀ i m, a.2.1 i = some m → m ∈ M ∧ ¬ (φ i m).Dom ∧ m ∉ a.1
  unique : ∀ i j m, a.2.1 i = some m → a.2.1 j = some m → i = j

private theorem validInitial : Valid φ M s initial := by
  constructor <;> simp [initial]

private theorem validSucc {s : Nat} {a : State} (h : Valid φ M s a) :
    Valid φ M (s + 1) a :=
  ⟨fun m hm => (h.contentBound m hm).step, fun i m hm => (h.markerBound i m hm).step,
    fun i m hm => Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (h.visited i m hm), h.active, h.unique⟩

private theorem stepValid (hU : UpperCorrect row before U) (hL : LowerCorrect φ M L)
    {s k : Nat} {a b : State} (hk : k < s) (ha : Valid φ M s a)
    (tr : Step row U L s k a b) : Valid φ M s b := by
  cases tr with
  | unchanged => exact ha
  | upper i q hi hq =>
    have hc := (upperSome hU hq).2
    constructor
    · intro m hm
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hm with hm | hm
      · exact ha.contentBound _ hm
      · exact (hc.2.2.1 _ hm).1
    · exact fun j m hm => ha.markerBound _ _ (remainingSome hm).1
    · exact fun j m hm => ha.visited _ _ (remainingSome hm).1
    · intro j m hm
      obtain ⟨old, kept⟩ := remainingSome hm
      obtain ⟨hM, hD, hC⟩ := ha.active _ _ old
      refine ⟨hM, hD, fun h => ?_⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with h | h
      · exact hC h
      · by_cases hp : k < 2 * j + 1
        · exact kept ⟨hp, h⟩
        · have hp' : 2 * j + 1 < 2 * i := by omega
          exact (hc.2.2.1 _ h).2 ((memMarkerSet _ _ _).mpr ⟨j, hp', old⟩)
    · exact fun j l m hj hl => ha.unique _ _ _ (remainingSome hj).1 (remainingSome hl).1
  | lower i n hi _ hn =>
    have hc := lowerSome hL hn
    have fresh (j : Nat) : a.2.1 j ≠ some n := fun hj =>
      hc.2.2.2.2 ((memMarkerSet _ _ _).mpr ⟨j, ha.visited _ _ hj, hj⟩)
    have update (j m : Nat) (h : Function.update a.2.1 i (some n) j = some m) :
        (j = i ∧ m = n) ∨ (j ≠ i ∧ a.2.1 j = some m) := by
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        exact .inl ⟨rfl, (Option.some.inj (by simpa using h)).symm⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨hj, by simpa only [Function.update_of_ne hj] using h⟩
    constructor
    · exact ha.contentBound
    · intro j m hm
      rcases update _ _ hm with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
      · exact hc.1
      · exact ha.markerBound _ _ old
    · intro j m hm
      rcases update _ _ hm with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
      · omega
      · exact ha.visited _ _ old
    · intro j m hm
      rcases update _ _ hm with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
      · exact ⟨hc.2.1, hc.2.2.1, hc.2.2.2.1⟩
      · exact ha.active _ _ old
    · intro j l m hj hl
      rcases update _ _ hj with ⟨hj', hmj⟩ | ⟨_, oldj⟩
      · rcases update _ _ hl with ⟨hl', _⟩ | ⟨_, oldl⟩
        · exact hj'.trans hl'.symm
        · exact (fresh _ (hmj ▸ oldl)).elim
      · rcases update _ _ hl with ⟨_, hml⟩ | ⟨_, oldl⟩
        · exact (fresh _ (hml ▸ oldj)).elim
        · exact ha.unique _ _ _ oldj oldl

private theorem visitsValid (hU : UpperCorrect row before U) (hL : LowerCorrect φ M L)
    {s : Nat} {a : State} (ha : Valid φ M s a) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ s) :
    Valid φ M s (visits row U L s a k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ha
  | succ k ih =>
    exact stepValid hU hL (by omega) (ih (by omega)) (step s k _)

private theorem startValid (hU : UpperCorrect row before U) (hL : LowerCorrect φ M L)
    (s : Nat) : Valid φ M s (start row U L s) := by
  induction s with
  | zero => exact validInitial
  | succ s ih => exact validSucc (visitsValid hU hL ih s le_rfl)

private theorem stateValid (hU : UpperCorrect row before U) (hL : LowerCorrect φ M L)
    (s k : Nat) : Valid φ M s (state row U L s k) :=
  visitsValid hU hL (startValid hU hL s) (min k s) (min_le_right ..)

theorem state_zero (s : Nat) : state row U L s 0 = start row U L s := by
  simp [state, visits]

theorem state_carry (s : Nat) : state row U L (s + 1) 0 = state row U L s s := by
  rw [state_zero]
  simp only [state, min_self]
  rfl

theorem state_next (s k : Nat) (hk : k < s) :
    state row U L s (k + 1) = visit row U L s k (state row U L s k) := by
  simp only [state, Nat.min_eq_left (show k + 1 ≤ s by omega),
    Nat.min_eq_left (show k ≤ s by omega)]
  rfl

private theorem stepContent {s k : Nat} {a b : State} (h : Step row U L s k a b) :
    a.1 ⊆ b.1 := by
  cases h with
  | upper => exact Finset.subset_union_left
  | _ => exact Finset.Subset.rfl

theorem content_mono (s j k : Nat) (hjk : j ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ s) :
    (state row U L s j).1 ⊆ (state row U L s k).1 := by
  induction k, hjk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact Finset.Subset.rfl
  | succ k _ ih =>
    rw [state_next s k (by omega)]
    exact (ih (by omega)).trans (stepContent (step s k _))

end Laws


section Certificate

variable {φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat} {row : Rows} {M : Set Nat}
  {U : UpperSearch} {L : LowerSearch}
  {before : (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat) → Prop}

abbrev content (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s k : Nat) :=
  (state row U L s k).1

abbrev marker (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s k e : Nat) :=
  (state row U L s k).2.1 e

def done (row : Rows) (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) (s e : Nat) : Prop :=
  (state row U L s 0).2.2 e = true

private theorem chosen_at (s i : Nat) (hi : 2 * i < s) :
    chosenPair row U L s i = upperAction U s i (state row U L s (2 * i)) := by
  exact ite_eq_left hi

private theorem flag_same (s k e : Nat) (a : State) (hne : k ≠ 2 * e) :
    (visit row U L s k a).2.2 e = a.2.2 e := by
  have hstep := step (row := row) (U := U) (L := L) s k a
  generalize hresult : visit row U L s k a = result at hstep ⊢
  cases hstep with
  | unchanged => rfl
  | lower => rfl
  | upper i _ hi _ =>
    exact Function.update_of_ne (show e ≠ i by intro h; subst i; exact hne hi) _ _

private theorem flag_at (s e : Nat) (a : State) :
    (visit row U L s (2 * e) a).2.2 e = true ↔
      a.2.2 e = true ∨ (upperAction U s e a).isSome = true := by
  rw [upperVisit]
  cases h : upperAction U s e a with
  | none => simp
  | some q => rcases q with ⟨x,t⟩; simp

private theorem flag_state (s k e : Nat) (hk : k ≤ s) :
    (state row U L s k).2.2 e = true ↔
      done row U L s e ∨ (2 * e < k ∧ (chosenPair row U L s e).isSome = true) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [done]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hs : k < s := by omega
    rw [state_next s k hs]
    by_cases h : k = 2 * e
    · subst k
      rw [flag_at, ← chosen_at s e hs, ih (by omega)]
      simp
    · rw [flag_same s k e _ h, ih (by omega)]
      have he : 2 * e < k + 1 ↔ 2 * e < k := by omega
      rw [he]

/-- Trace laws for the priority verification, stated without importing the parent. -/
structure Laws (φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat) (row : Rows) (M : Set Nat)
    (U : UpperSearch) (L : LowerSearch) : Prop where
  contentInitial : content row U L 0 0 = ∅
  markerInitial : ∀ e, marker row U L 0 0 e = none
  doneInitial : ∀ e, ¬ done row U L 0 e
  contentCarry : ∀ s, content row U L (s + 1) 0 = content row U L s s
  markerCarry : ∀ s e, marker row U L (s + 1) 0 e = marker row U L s s e
  contentPersists : ∀ s j k, j ≤ k → k ≤ s → content row U L s j ⊆ content row U L s k
  doneNext : ∀ s e, done row U L (s + 1) e ↔ done row U L s e ∨ (chosenPair row U L s e).isSome
  action : ∀ s e q, chosenPair row U L s e = some q →
    2 * e < s ∧ ¬ done row U L s e ∧ UpperCandidate row e s (restraints row U L s e) q ∧
    row e q.1 q.2 ⊆ content row U L s s
  upperProgress : ∀ s e q, 2 * e < s → ¬ done row U L s e →
    UpperCandidate row e s (restraints row U L s e) q → (chosenPair row U L s e).isSome
  lowerProgress : ∀ s e m, 2 * e + 1 < s → marker row U L s (2 * e + 1) e = none →
    m ≤ s → m ∈ M → ¬ (φ e m).Dom → m ∉ content row U L s (2 * e + 1) →
    (∀ j, marker row U L s (2 * e + 1) j ≠ some m) → (marker row U L s (2 * e + 2) e).isSome
  enterContent : ∀ s k m, k < s → m ∈ content row U L s (k + 1) → m ∉ content row U L s k →
    ∃ i q, k = 2 * i ∧ chosenPair row U L s i = some q ∧ m ∈ row i q.1 q.2
  enterMarker : ∀ s k e m, k < s → marker row U L s (k + 1) e = some m →
    marker row U L s k e ≠ some m → k = 2 * e + 1 ∧ m ≤ s
  active : ∀ s k e m, marker row U L s k e = some m →
    m ∈ M ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom ∧ m ∉ content row U L s k
  cancellation : ∀ s k e m, k < s → marker row U L s k e = some m →
    marker row U L s (k + 1) e = none →
    ∃ i q, k = 2 * i ∧ 2 * i < 2 * e + 1 ∧ chosenPair row U L s i = some q ∧ m ∈ row i q.1 q.2
  noReplacement : ∀ s k e m, k < s → marker row U L s k e = some m →
    marker row U L s (k + 1) e = none ∨ marker row U L s (k + 1) e = some m
  contentBound : ∀ s k m, m ∈ content row U L s k → m ≤ s
  markerBound : ∀ s k e m, marker row U L s k e = some m → m ≤ s
  visited : ∀ s k e m, marker row U L s k e = some m → 2 * e + 1 < s
  unique : ∀ s k e j m, marker row U L s k e = some m → marker row U L s k j = some m → j = e

private theorem exact_action (s e : Nat) {q : Nat × Nat} (hk : 2 * e < s)
    (hq : chosenPair row U L s e = some q) :
    row e q.1 q.2 ⊆ content row U L s (2 * e + 1) := by
  unfold content
  rw [state_next s (2 * e) hk, upperVisit, ← chosen_at s e hk, hq]
  rcases q with ⟨x,t⟩
  exact Finset.subset_union_right

theorem traceLaws (hU : UpperCorrect row before U) (hL : LowerCorrect φ M L) :
    Laws φ row M U L := by
  refine {
    contentInitial := rfl
    markerInitial := fun _ => rfl
    doneInitial := fun _ => Bool.false_ne_true
    contentCarry := fun s => congrArg Prod.fst (state_carry s)
    markerCarry := fun s e => congrArg (fun a : State => a.2.1 e) (state_carry s)
    contentPersists := content_mono
    doneNext := ?_
    action := ?_
    upperProgress := ?_
    lowerProgress := ?_
    enterContent := ?_
    enterMarker := ?_
    active := fun s k e m => (stateValid hU hL s k).active e m
    cancellation := ?_
    noReplacement := ?_
    contentBound := fun s k => (stateValid hU hL s k).contentBound
    markerBound := fun s k => (stateValid hU hL s k).markerBound
    visited := fun s k => (stateValid hU hL s k).visited
    unique := fun s k e j m he hj => (stateValid hU hL s k).unique j e m hj he
  }
  · intro s e
    conv_lhs => unfold done; rw [state_carry]
    rw [flag_state s s e le_rfl]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.imp id And.right
    · intro h
      rcases h with hd | h
      · exact .inl hd
      · refine .inr ⟨?_, h⟩
        by_contra hn
        simp [chosenPair, hn] at h
  · intro s e q hq
    have hk : 2 * e < s := by
      by_contra hn
      simp [chosenPair, hn] at hq
    have ha := upperSome hU ((chosen_at s e hk).symm.trans hq)
    refine ⟨hk, ?_, ha.2, (exact_action s e hk hq).trans (content_mono _ _ _ (by omega) le_rfl)⟩
    intro hd
    have ht := (flag_state s (2 * e) e hk.le).mpr (.inl hd)
    simp [ha.1] at ht
  · intro s e q hk hn hc
    have hd : ¬ (state row U L s (2 * e)).2.2 e = true := by
      intro h
      exact hn (((flag_state s (2 * e) e hk.le).mp h).resolve_right (by omega))
    rw [chosen_at s e hk]
    unfold upperAction
    rw [ite_eq_right hd]
    change (U e s (restraints row U L s e)).isSome = true
    have hh := hU e s (restraints row U L s e)
    cases hres : U e s (restraints row U L s e) with
    | none =>
      rw [hres] at hh
      exact (hh q hc).elim
    | some _ => rfl
  · intro s e m hk hn hb hM hD hC hf
    let a := state row U L s (2 * e + 1)
    have fresh : m ∉ markerSet a.2.1 s := by
      rintro hm
      obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := (memMarkerSet _ _ _).mp hm
      exact hf j hj
    have hh := hL e s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s)
    change ((state row U L s (2 * e + 1 + 1)).2.1 e).isSome = true
    rw [state_next s _ hk, lowerVisit]
    change ((match a.2.1 e with
      | none => (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 e (L e s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s)), a.2.2)
      | some _ => a).2.1 e).isSome = true
    rw [show a.2.1 e = none from hn]
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    cases hres : L e s a.1 (markerSet a.2.1 s) with
    | none =>
      rw [hres] at hh
      exact (hh m ⟨hb, hM, hD, hC, fresh⟩).elim
    | some _ => rfl
  · intro s k m hk hm hn
    let a := state row U L s k
    have hstep := step (row := row) (U := U) (L := L) s k a
    unfold content at hm
    rw [state_next s k hk] at hm
    change m ∈ (visit row U L s k a).1 at hm
    change m ∉ a.1 at hn
    generalize hresult : visit row U L s k a = result at hstep hm
    cases hstep with
    | unchanged => exact (hn hm).elim
    | lower => exact (hn hm).elim
    | upper i q hi hq =>
      exact ⟨i, q, hi, (chosen_at s i (by omega)).trans (by simpa only [← hi] using hq),
        (Finset.mem_union.mp hm).resolve_left hn⟩
  · intro s k e m hk hm hn
    let a := state row U L s k
    have hstep := step (row := row) (U := U) (L := L) s k a
    unfold marker at hm
    rw [state_next s k hk] at hm
    change (visit row U L s k a).2.1 e = some m at hm
    change a.2.1 e ≠ some m at hn
    generalize hresult : visit row U L s k a = result at hstep hm
    cases hstep with
    | unchanged => exact (hn hm).elim
    | upper => exact (hn (remainingSome hm).1).elim
    | lower i n hi _ hsearch =>
      have he : e = i := by
        by_contra h
        exact hn (by simpa only [Function.update_of_ne h] using hm)
      subst e
      have hn' : n = m := by simpa only [Function.update_self, Option.some.injEq] using hm
      exact ⟨hi, hn' ▸ (lowerSome hL hsearch).1⟩
  · intro s k e m hk hm hn
    let a := state row U L s k
    have hstep := step (row := row) (U := U) (L := L) s k a
    unfold marker at hn
    rw [state_next s k hk] at hn
    change a.2.1 e = some m at hm
    change (visit row U L s k a).2.1 e = none at hn
    generalize hresult : visit row U L s k a = result at hstep hn
    cases hstep with
    | unchanged =>
      have hfalse : some m = (none : Option Nat) := hm.symm.trans hn
      cases hfalse
    | lower i _ _ hi _ =>
      have he : e ≠ i := fun he => by subst e; simp [hm] at hi
      have hfalse : some m = (none : Option Nat) :=
        hm.symm.trans (by simpa only [Function.update_of_ne he] using hn)
      cases hfalse
    | upper i q hi hq =>
      have hx := remainingNone hm hn
      exact ⟨i, q, hi, by omega, (chosen_at s i (by omega)).trans
        (by simpa only [← hi] using hq), hx.2⟩
  · intro s k e m hk hm
    let a := state row U L s k
    unfold marker
    rw [state_next s k hk]
    change a.2.1 e = some m at hm
    change (visit row U L s k a).2.1 e = none ∨ (visit row U L s k a).2.1 e = some m
    have hstep := step (row := row) (U := U) (L := L) s k a
    generalize hresult : visit row U L s k a = result at hstep ⊢
    cases hstep with
    | unchanged => exact .inr hm
    | lower i _ _ hi _ =>
      have he : e ≠ i := fun he => by subst e; simp [hm] at hi
      exact .inr (by simpa only [Function.update_of_ne he] using hm)
    | upper i q hi hq =>
      by_cases h : k < 2 * e + 1 ∧ m ∈ row i q.1 q.2
      · exact .inl (by simp only [remaining, hm, ite_eq_left h])
      · exact .inr (by simp only [remaining, hm, ite_eq_right h])


-- The lower mask in the decoded visit includes every active marker, since a
-- marker can be assigned only at a visit to its own lower requirement.
theorem allActive (T : Laws φ row M U L) (s k m : Nat) :
    m ∈ markerSet (state row U L s k).2.1 s ↔
      ∃ e, marker row U L s k e = some m := by
  rw [memMarkerSet]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨e, _, he⟩ => ⟨e, he⟩,
    fun ⟨e, he⟩ => ⟨e, T.visited s k e m he, he⟩⟩

theorem state_clamp (s k : Nat) :
    state row U L s k = state row U L s (min k s) := by
  unfold state
  rw [Nat.min_eq_left (min_le_right k s)]

theorem visited_before (T : Laws φ row M U L) (s k e m : Nat)
    (hm : marker row U L s k e = some m) :
    2 * e + 1 < s - 1 ∨ 2 * e + 1 < min k s := by
  have aux : ∀ k, k ≤ s → marker row U L s k e = some m →
      2 * e + 1 < s - 1 ∨ 2 * e + 1 < k := by
    intro k hk hm
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      cases s with
      | zero => rw [T.markerInitial e] at hm; contradiction
      | succ s =>
        rw [T.markerCarry s e] at hm
        exact .inl (by simpa using T.visited s s e m hm)
    | succ k ih =>
      by_cases hprev : marker row U L s k e = some m
      · exact (ih (by omega) hprev).imp id (fun h => by omega)
      · have hnew := (T.enterMarker s k e m (by omega) hm hprev).1
        exact .inr (by omega)
  have hclamp := congrArg (fun a : State => a.2.1 e)
    (state_clamp (row := row) (U := U) (L := L) s k)
  exact aux (min k s) (min_le_right ..) (hclamp.symm.trans hm)

end Certificate

end PriorityCodedTrace

external.usage: Iterate the compiled single-visit transition and the completed-stage transition. A local totality lemma reduces each bind to the value from the preceding iteration.
Use the exact finite-set code required by both bounded searches and identify the final content and restraint codes by the equivalence laws.
Identify row membership in the decoded bit set with the ordinary bit test used to cancel a live marker.

statement.type:
∀ (φ : Nat → Nat → Part Nat)
    (row : PriorityCodedTrace.Rows)
    (pairBefore : (Nat × Nat) → (Nat × Nat) → Prop)
    (query : Nat → Nat) (M : Set Nat),
  let K : Set Nat := {n | (φ n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2).Dom}
  let oracle : Set (Nat →. Nat) :=
    {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ K then 1 else 0))}
  Computable (fun p : Nat × Nat × Nat => Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (row p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) →
  IsStrictTotalOrder (Nat × Nat) pairBefore →
  ComputablePred (fun p : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => pairBefore p.1 p.2) →
  Computable query →
  (∀ e x t, query (Nat.pair e (Nat.pair x t)) ∉ K ↔
    ∀ r, t ≤ r → row e x r = row e x t) →
  Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (by classical exact fun m => Part.some (if m ∈ M then 1 else 0)) →
  ∃ (U : PriorityCodedTrace.UpperSearch) (L : PriorityCodedTrace.LowerSearch),
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some (PriorityCodedTrace.upperCode U n)) ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some (PriorityCodedTrace.lowerCode L n)) ∧
    PriorityCodedTrace.UpperCorrect row pairBefore U ∧
    PriorityCodedTrace.LowerCorrect φ M L ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some (PriorityCodedTrace.traceCode row U L n)) ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun s => Part.some
      (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (PriorityCodedTrace.content row U L s s))) ∧
    Nat.RecursiveIn oracle (fun n => Part.some
      (Finset.equivBitIndices.symm (PriorityCodedTrace.restraints row U L n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2))) ∧
    PriorityCodedTrace.Laws φ row M U L

LocalInterpolation.proof:
by
  classical
  intro A cyl encode decode ce finiteOneReducible finiteOneStrict hNonrec hNoncyl hNotCE hNotCoCE
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §4, Theorem 5, pp. 8–12.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8
  -- The article's proof is unnumbered. The article-specific Alphabeta Math
  -- portal and its defect report both returned HTTP 404 on recheck.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  let φ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.canonicalNumbering
  let V := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.row
  let stage := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.rowAt
  obtain ⟨_, hSurj, hUniversal, _⟩ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.canonicalNumbering_acceptable
  -- Alphabeta Math, thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete, Step 1.1 uses
  -- recognizable domains of the universal evaluator. Precomposing it with
  -- the computable packing (e,x,y) ↦ (e,pair x y) gives the row graph.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete
  have hPacked : Computable (fun q : Nat × Nat × Nat => Nat.pair q.2.1 q.2.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hGraph : REPred (fun q : Nat × Nat × Nat => q.2.2 ∈ V q.1 q.2.1) :=
    (hUniversal.comp Computable.fst hPacked).dom_re
  have hStages (e x y : Nat) : y ∈ V e x ↔ ∃ s, y ∈ stage e x s :=
    HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage e x y
  have hCoverage (i : Nat) : ∃ e : Nat, ∀ x y : Nat,
      y ∈ V e x ↔ (φ i (Nat.pair x y)).Dom := by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.rowAt_exhausts_numbering i
    exact ⟨e, fun x y => (hStages e x y).trans (he x y)⟩
  have hStageCode := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.computable_rowAt_code
  have hMonotone := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.monotone_rowAt
  obtain ⟨N, _, _, hPi, hRequirements⟩ :=
    PriorityRequirements φ V stage hUniversal hSurj hGraph hCoverage hStageCode hMonotone hStages
  have hForA := hRequirements A hNonrec hNoncyl hNotCE hNotCoCE

  let P : Set Nat := Nᶜ
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpSurj, hProfile, s, hs, hSection⟩ := ProfileRealization P hPi
  let C : Set Nat := p ⁻¹' A
  -- Alphabeta Math, def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface, Step 1.1
  -- checks membership through computable maps. The pullback and section
  -- supply the two maps on Nat. The reviewed endpoint states strictness by
  -- forward reducibility and exclusion of the reverse at representative level.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface
  obtain ⟨_, hAC, _, hDegree⟩ := PullbackReductions A P p s hp hpSurj hProfile hs hSection
  have hCCyl : finiteOneReducible C cyl := (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 C hDegree
  refine ⟨C, hDegree, ⟨hAC, ?_⟩, ⟨hCCyl, ?_⟩⟩
  · -- The ascending map supplied by the least search is partial recursive
    -- and defined on every infinite p-fibre index. Use its unary code at L_e.
    rintro ⟨h, hh, hFibres, hMem⟩
    let f (y : Nat) : Part Nat :=
      Part.map h (Nat.rfind (fun u => Part.some (decide (p u = y ∧ y < h u))))
    obtain ⟨hf, hAsc, hDom⟩ :=
      AscendingSelfReductionFromPullbackReduction A P p h hp hpSurj ⟨s, hs, hSection⟩
        hProfile hh hFibres hMem
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hSurj f hf
    change φ e = f at he
    have hOdd : (2 * e + 1) % 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hIndex : (2 * e + 1) / 2 = e := by omega
    have hLower : (∀ x y : Nat, y ∈ φ e x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
        ∃ m : Nat, m ∉ N ∪ {x : Nat | (φ e x).Dom} := by
      simpa only [hOdd, ite_false, hIndex] using hForA (2 * e + 1)
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hLower (by rw [he]; exact hAsc)
    have hmP : m ∈ P := fun hmN => hm (Or.inl hmN)
    have hmDom : (f m).Dom := hDom hmP
    exact hm (Or.inr (show (φ e m).Dom by rw [he]; exact hmDom))
  · -- A hypothetical cylinder reduction yields a uniformly c.e. family.
    -- Alphabeta Math, thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable, Steps 1.1 and 3.1
    -- let us use a recognizer for its packed graph. Here the bridge is for
    -- unary Boolean encodings of naturals. Canonical finite stages bound
    -- both the simulation fuel and the row coordinate, with one common code.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
    rintro ⟨h, hh, hFibres, hMem⟩
    have hExhaustion (W : Nat → Set Nat)
        (hCE : ce {z : Nat | ∃ x y : Nat, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}) :
        ∃ e : Nat, ∀ x : Nat, W x = {y : Nat | ∃ t, y ∈ stage e x t} := by
      let G : Set Nat := {z | ∃ x y : Nat, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}
      have hRE : REPred (fun z => z ∈ G) :=
        (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true G).mpr hCE
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.exists_index_stages hRE
      refine ⟨e, fun x => Set.ext (fun y => ?_)⟩
      refine Iff.trans ?_ (he x y)
      constructor
      · intro hy
        exact ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, b, hb, hEq⟩
        have hPair : (x, y) = (a, b) := Nat.pairEquiv.injective hEq
        cases hPair
        exact hb
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨e, he⟩, hHom⟩ :=
      HomogeneousRowsFromCylinderReduction A P p hp hpSurj ⟨s, hs, hSection⟩
        hProfile h hh hFibres hMem stage hStageCode hMonotone hExhaustion
    have hRow (x : Nat) : Set.range (fun n : Nat => p (h (Nat.pair x n))) = V e x :=
      (he x).trans (Set.ext (fun y => (hStages e x y).symm))
    have hEven : (2 * e) % 2 = 0 := by omega
    have hIndex : (2 * e) / 2 = e := by omega
    have hUpper : (∀ x y : Nat, y ∈ V e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
        ∃ x : Nat, (V e x).Finite ∧ V e x ⊆ N := by
      simpa only [hEven, ite_true, hIndex] using hForA (2 * e)
    obtain ⟨x, hFinite, hInN⟩ := hUpper (fun x y hy => by
      apply hHom x y
      change y ∈ Set.range (fun n : Nat => p (h (Nat.pair x n)))
      rwa [hRow x])
    -- The article uses a finite union of fibres and the infinite column.
    -- Two finite preimages express that obstruction. The p-fibre hypothesis
    -- is needed only over this selected row, since the row lies in N.
    have hPreP : (p ⁻¹' (V e x)).Finite := hFinite.preimage' (fun y hy => by
      by_contra hInfinite
      have hyProfile : y ∈ {y : Nat | (p ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Nat)).Infinite} := hInfinite
      have hyP : y ∈ P := hProfile ▸ hyProfile
      exact hyP (hInN hy))
    have hPreH : (h ⁻¹' (p ⁻¹' (V e x))).Finite :=
      hPreP.preimage' (fun y _ => hFibres y)
    have hColumn : (Set.range (Nat.pair x)).Infinite :=
      Set.infinite_range_of_injective (fun a b hab => by
        have hPair : (x, a) = (x, b) := Nat.pairEquiv.injective hab
        exact congrArg Prod.snd hPair)
    apply hColumn (hPreH.subset ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    change p (h (Nat.pair x n)) ∈ V e x
    rw [← hRow x]
    exact ⟨n, rfl⟩

external.usage: LocalInterpolation uses primitive-recursive pairing to pack (x,y) for the partial evaluator, proving that the jointly indexed row graph is recognizable.
LocalInterpolation uses injectivity to reflect membership of a packed graph element to its two coordinates and to show that each fixed-coordinate cylinder column is injective.
LocalInterpolation applies the lemma first to the selected finite row in N under p, using the profile to certify the fibres over that row, then under the hypothetical finite-one reduction h.
LocalInterpolation applies this to n ↦ Nat.pair x n, whose injectivity comes from Nat.pairEquiv. The resulting infinite column is contained in the finite iterated preimage of the selected row.

PriorityConstructionEffectiveness.proof:
by
  classical
  intro φ V row pairBefore hφ hsurj hgraph _huniversal hrow hmono hunion horder hbefore
    K relative bits upperCandidate lowerCandidate
  -- Cintioli, §4, pp. 8–9 and Remark 6, p. 13.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=13
  -- The article-specific Alphabeta Math portal and its defect report returned
  -- HTTP 404, and the local Research Portal has no matching collection.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  -- The numbered steps cited here come from the shared library.
  -- Halting is Σ₁-complete, Steps 1.2 and 2.1:
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete
  -- Search for a later changed row code and query its halting status. The
  -- supplied unary surjectivity gives one fixed index for this search with
  -- the triple packed into its input. FixedStageRowStability requires an
  -- acceptable numbering, so we use the query for these weaker hypotheses.
  have hK : K = PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ := by
    ext n
    change (let (e, m) := n.unpair; (φ e m).Dom) ↔ (φ n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2).Dom
    cases n.unpair
    rfl
  obtain ⟨query, hquery, hstable⟩ := PriorityRequirements.stabilityQuery φ hsurj row hrow
  let O : Set (Nat →. Nat) := {fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ K then 1 else 0)}
  have hM : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun m => Part.some (@ite Nat (m ∈ (Set.univ : Set Nat)) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_univ, ite_true] using
      (RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp (ComputableIn.const (O := O) (α := Nat) (1 : Nat)))
  -- Keep the bounded searches and the decoded trace from one supplier
  -- instance. PriorityCodedVisitTrace obtains both witnesses from
  -- PriorityBoundedOracleSearches and uses mathlib's Nat.RecursiveIn.prec
  -- for the packed visit and stage recursions.
  -- https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/65d730f7150f21fdfa32f3e73a3f549c1f96a0e9/Mathlib/Computability/RecursiveIn.lean#L71
  -- Its all-active invariant identifies the lower search mask with the
  -- active values. With univ, every natural is admissible for this test.
  have hM' : Nat.RecursiveIn
      {fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0)}
      (fun m => Part.some (@ite Nat (m ∈ (Set.univ : Set Nat)) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
    rw [← hK]
    exact hM
  obtain ⟨U, L, hUcode, hLcode, hU, hL, _, _, hZcode, laws⟩ :=
    PriorityCodedVisitTrace φ row pairBefore query Set.univ
      hrow horder hbefore hquery hstable hM'
  -- The one-query theorem decides Kᶜ. The total-output compiler implements
  -- the two packed search outputs and the restraint code on the oracle tape.
  have decideComplement : relative.1 (Kᶜ) :=
    OracleNegativePullbackDecision K id Computable.id
  have compile := (SingletonOracleTapeCompilation K).2
  have hO : O =
      {fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0)} := by
    rw [← hK]
  refine ⟨decideComplement, U, L,
    compile (PriorityCodedTrace.upperCode U) (hO.symm ▸ hUcode),
    compile (PriorityCodedTrace.lowerCode L) (hO.symm ▸ hLcode), hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e s content active
    have correct := hL e s content active
    cases h : L e s content active <;>
      simpa only [h, lowerCandidate, PriorityCodedTrace.LowerCandidate, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
        using correct
  intro upper lower markerSet State initial upperAction visit visits state chosenPair restraints N
  -- The decoded supplier definitions reduce to the reviewed nested Nat.rec
  -- with these exact search witnesses. Splitting the decoded input identifies
  -- the restraint output expressed using projections with the pair match.
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply compile
    have hcode := (hO.symm ▸ hZcode : Nat.RecursiveIn O
      (fun n => Part.some (bits.symm (PriorityCodedTrace.restraints row U L
        n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2))))
    apply hcode.of_eq
    intro n
    cases n.unpair
    rfl
  · intro s k e m hm
    exact ⟨(laws.active s k e m hm).2.1, (laws.active s k e m hm).2.2,
      fun j hj => laws.unique s k e j m hm hj⟩
  · intro s e q m hq hm
    obtain ⟨_, _, hcand, _⟩ := laws.action s e q hq
    exact (hcand.2.2.1 m hm).1
  · intro s m hsm hm
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_gt hsm) (laws.contentBound s s m hm)
  · -- A live marker is outside the current content. Propagate that marker
    -- from the very visit that installs it. Cancellation at the same stage
    -- would require an earlier visit; at a later stage quietness forbids it.
    intro s e m hvisit _ hnew hquiet
    change PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L s (2 * e + 2) e = some m at hnew
    have retain (r k : Nat) (hrs : s ≤ r) (hk : k < r)
        (hindex : r = s → 2 * e + 2 ≤ k)
        (hm : PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r k e = some m) :
        PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r (k + 1) e = some m := by
      rcases laws.noReplacement r k e m hk hm with hcancel | hsame
      · obtain ⟨i, q, hki, hi, hq, _⟩ := laws.cancellation r k e m hk hm hcancel
        by_cases heq : r = s
        · have := hindex heq
          omega
        · have hn := hquiet r i (lt_of_le_of_ne hrs (Ne.symm heq)) hi
          change PriorityCodedTrace.chosenPair row U L r i = none at hn
          rw [hn] at hq
          contradiction
      · exact hsame
    have advance (r a : Nat) (hrs : s ≤ r) (ha : r = s → 2 * e + 2 ≤ a)
        (hm : PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r a e = some m) :
        ∀ k, a ≤ k → k ≤ r → PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r k e = some m := by
      intro k hak hkr
      induction k, hak using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact hm
      | succ k hak ih =>
        exact retain r k hrs (by omega) (fun hr => le_trans (ha hr) hak) (ih (by omega))
    have now (k : Nat) (hk : 2 * e + 2 ≤ k) (hks : k ≤ s) :
        PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L s k e = some m :=
      advance s (2 * e + 2) le_rfl (fun _ => le_rfl) hnew k hk hks
    have finalMarker (r : Nat) (hrs : s ≤ r) :
        PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r r e = some m := by
      induction r, hrs using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact now s (by change 2 * e + 1 < s at hvisit; omega) le_rfl
      | succ r hrs ih =>
        have hstart := (laws.markerCarry r e).trans ih
        exact advance (r + 1) 0 (by omega) (fun h => by omega) hstart
          (r + 1) (Nat.zero_le _) le_rfl
    have later (r k : Nat) (hrs : s < r) (hkr : k ≤ r) :
        PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r k e = some m := by
      cases r with
      | zero => omega
      | succ r =>
        have hstart := (laws.markerCarry r e).trans (finalMarker r (by omega))
        exact advance (r + 1) 0 (by omega) (fun h => by omega) hstart k (Nat.zero_le _) hkr
    have contentAcross (a b : Nat) (hab : a ≤ b) :
        PriorityCodedTrace.content row U L a a ⊆ PriorityCodedTrace.content row U L b b := by
      induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact fun _ h => h
      | succ b _ ih =>
        exact Finset.Subset.trans ih (by
          rw [← laws.contentCarry b]
          exact laws.contentPersists (b + 1) 0 (b + 1) (Nat.zero_le _) le_rfl)
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
      change m ∈ PriorityCodedTrace.content row U L r r at hr
      by_cases hrs : r ≤ s
      · exact (laws.active s s e m (finalMarker s le_rfl)).2.2 (contentAcross r s hrs hr)
      · exact (laws.active r r e m (finalMarker r (by omega))).2.2 hr
    · intro r i q hi hq hm
      obtain ⟨hri, _, hcand, hcontent⟩ := laws.action r i q hq
      by_cases hrs : r < s
      · exact (laws.active s s e m (finalMarker s le_rfl)).2.2
          (contentAcross r s hrs.le (hcontent hm))
      · -- In stage s a lower-priority visit follows the allocation.
        -- In later stages the marker already persists from the start.
        change 2 * e + 1 < 2 * i at hi
        have live : PriorityCodedTrace.marker row U L r (2 * i) e = some m := by
          by_cases heq : r = s
          · subst r
            exact now (2 * i) (by omega) hri.le
          · exact later r (2 * i) (by omega) hri.le
        have restrained : m ∈ PriorityCodedTrace.restraints row U L r i :=
          (PriorityCodedTrace.memMarkerSet ..).mpr ⟨e, hi, live⟩
        exact (hcand.2.2.1 m hm).2 restrained
  · intro A cyl encode decode ce hnonrec hnoncyl hnonCE hnoncoCE
    constructor
    · intro e homogeneous Z hZ
      obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hZ
      -- Recognizable iff enumerable, Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1:
      -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
      -- Specialize the RE triple graph at e and unpack natural pair codes.
      -- The true-bit bridge treats both the empty graph and a computable
      -- range for the nonempty graph. Lemma 2 supplies an existential row.
      obtain ⟨x, hfinite, hdisjoint⟩ := FiniteMarkerAvoidance A (V e) hnoncyl hnonCE
        hnoncoCE ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp
          (PriorityRequirements.rowGraphRE hgraph e)) homogeneous Z (Finset.finite_toSet Z)
      obtain ⟨t, hexhausted, hstableRow⟩ :=
        PriorityRequirements.finiteRowExhaustion (hmono e x) (hunion e x) hfinite
      -- The bound certifies a candidate at each subsequent stage. The
      -- bounded searches themselves take only their current finite inputs.
      let bound := max (max S (2 * e + 1)) (max (max x t) ((row e x t).sup id))
      have candidate (s : Nat) (hs : bound ≤ s) :
          PriorityCodedTrace.UpperCandidate row e s (PriorityCodedTrace.restraints row U L s e)
            (x, t) := by
        have hbound : max (max S (2 * e + 1)) (max (max x t) ((row e x t).sup id)) ≤ s := hs
        simp only [max_le_iff] at hbound
        refine ⟨hbound.2.1.1, hbound.2.1.2, ?_, hstableRow⟩
        intro m hm
        refine ⟨(Finset.le_sup (f := id) hm).trans hbound.2.2, ?_⟩
        change m ∉ restraints s e
        rw [hS s hbound.1.1]
        intro hz
        have hv : m ∈ V e x := by
          rw [← hexhausted]
          exact hm
        have hmem : m ∈ V e x ∩ (Z : Set Nat) := ⟨hv, hz⟩
        rw [hdisjoint] at hmem
        exact hmem
      refine ⟨⟨x, hfinite, hdisjoint⟩, ⟨bound, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro s hs
        cases hresult : U e s (PriorityCodedTrace.restraints row U L s e) with
        | some q => exact ⟨q, hresult⟩
        | none =>
          have hspec := hU e s (PriorityCodedTrace.restraints row U L s e)
          rw [hresult] at hspec
          exact (hspec (x, t) (candidate s hs)).elim
      · -- An earlier action already witnesses success. In its absence the
        -- done flag is false, and the certified candidate forces an action.
        change ∃ s q, PriorityCodedTrace.chosenPair row U L s e = some q
        by_contra absent
        have notDone (s : Nat) : ¬ PriorityCodedTrace.done row U L s e := by
          induction s with
          | zero => exact laws.doneInitial e
          | succ s ih =>
            intro hd
            rcases (laws.doneNext s e).mp hd with hp | hq
            · exact ih hp
            · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hq
              exact absent ⟨s, q, hq⟩
        have hvisit : 2 * e < bound :=
          (Nat.lt_succ_self (2 * e)).trans_le ((le_max_right S (2 * e + 1)).trans (le_max_left ..))
        obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp
          (laws.upperProgress bound e (x, t) hvisit (notDone bound) (candidate bound le_rfl))
        exact absent ⟨bound, q, hq⟩
    · intro e ascending b
      -- Lemma 4 gives infinitely many omissions for the partial-recursive
      -- e-th section. The bound is used only in verification.
      have omissions := CofiniteDomainLemma A (φ e) hnonrec hnoncyl
        (hφ.comp (Computable.const e) Computable.id) ascending
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hb⟩ := omissions.exists_gt b
      exact ⟨m, hb, hm⟩

external.usage: Remark 6 follows Steps 1.2 and 2.1 via PriorityRequirements.stabilityQuery. The predicate compares computable row codes and uses the index for a witness search on the packed triple, with unary surjectivity providing that one fixed index.

Remark 6 follows Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1 via the true-bit Nat range bridge for the recognizable graph of a fixed row family. This supplies the c.e. graph hypothesis of FiniteMarkerAvoidance, including when the graph is empty.
Direct in Remark 6. After CofiniteDomainLemma gives the infinite complement of the domain, specialize Set.Infinite.exists_gt to Nat and the specified bound.

MaslovaCeDichotomy.proof:
by
  classical
  intro encode decode ce finiteOneReducible finiteOneDegree B d hnonrec hce finiteOneDegrees
  let degree := ReducibilityImplications.finiteOneDegree
  let reducible := ReducibilityImplications.FiniteOneReducible
  have degreeEq {X Y : Set Nat} :
      degree X = degree Y ↔ reducible X Y ∧ reducible Y X :=
    ReducibilityImplications.finiteOneDegree_eq_iff
  have compose {X Y Z : Set Nat} (hXY : reducible X Y) (hYZ : reducible Y Z) :
      reducible X Z := ReducibilityImplications.finiteOneTrans hXY hYZ
  have memDegree (X : Set Nat) : X ∈ d ↔ ManyOneDegree.of X = ManyOneDegree.of B :=
    ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.symm
  let cylinder (X : Set Nat) : Set Nat := {z | ∃ x n, x ∈ X ∧ z = Nat.pair x n}
  let top := degree (cylinder B)
  have hTop : top ∈ finiteOneDegrees :=
    ⟨cylinder B, (memDegree _).mpr (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree B).1, rfl⟩
  by_cases hfinite : finiteOneDegrees.Finite
  swap
  · exact Or.inr hfinite
  left
  refine ⟨top, hTop, ?_⟩
  intro E hE
  by_contra hEne

  -- Cintioli, §5, p. 13, quotes the c.e. case from Maslova [2] in the
  -- formulation of Richter–Stephan–Zhang, arXiv:2607.06218, p. 17.
  -- Both passages state the result by attribution. The 1979 primary
  -- proof was unavailable in the inspected sources. The order argument
  -- at the start of Corollary 7 reduces the claim to interpolation below
  -- the cylinder. The §4 construction with restricted markers supplies
  -- this interpolation in the c.e. case.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=13
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.06218#page=17
  -- The article-specific Research Portal and defect report returned HTTP 404.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  -- Alphabeta Math's many-one interface, Step 1.1, checks composition of
  -- witnesses. For finite-one degrees transport between representatives
  -- using finite-one composition, which additionally preserves finite fibres.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface
  let below (D F : Set (Set Nat)) : Prop :=
    ∃ X Y : Set Nat, degree X = D ∧ degree Y = F ∧ reducible X Y
  have below_iff (X Y : Set Nat) : below (degree X) (degree Y) ↔ reducible X Y := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨U, V, hUX, hVY, hUV⟩
      exact compose (degreeEq.mp hUX).2 (compose hUV (degreeEq.mp hVY).1)
    · exact fun h => ⟨X, Y, rfl, rfl, h⟩
  let degreeOrder : LE (Set (Set Nat)) := ⟨below⟩
  have hTrans : IsTrans (Set (Set Nat)) below := ⟨by
    rintro D F G ⟨X, Y, hXD, hYF, hXY⟩ ⟨U, V, hUF, hVG, hUV⟩
    exact ⟨X, V, hXD, hVG, compose hXY
      (compose (degreeEq.mp (hYF.trans hUF.symm)).1 hUV)⟩⟩
  let proper := finiteOneDegrees \ {top}
  have hproper : proper.Finite := hfinite.sdiff
  have hproperNE : proper.Nonempty := ⟨E, hE, by simpa using hEne⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDmax⟩ :=
    @Set.Finite.exists_maximal _ degreeOrder hTrans proper hproper hproperNE
  obtain ⟨A, hAd, rfl⟩ := hDmax.1.1
  have hAne : degree A ≠ top := by simpa using hDmax.1.2
  have hAnrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x : Nat => x ∈ A) :=
    fun h => hnonrec ⟨A, hAd, h⟩
  have hACylIn : cylinder A ∈ d :=
    (memDegree _).mpr ((CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).1.trans ((memDegree _).mp hAd))
  have hCylTop : degree (cylinder A) = top := by
    apply degreeEq.mpr
    exact ⟨(CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree B).2 _ ((memDegree _).mp hACylIn),
      (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 _
        ((CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree B).1.trans ((memDegree _).mp hAd).symm)⟩
  have hAnCyl :
      ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun x : Nat => x ∈ A) (fun x : Nat => x ∈ cylinder A) ∧
        OneOneReducible (fun x : Nat => x ∈ cylinder A) (fun x : Nat => x ∈ A)) := by
    rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    exact hAne ((degreeEq.mpr ⟨(ReducibilityImplications A (cylinder A)).1 h₁,
      (ReducibilityImplications (cylinder A) A).1 h₂⟩).trans hCylTop)

  -- Recognizability equivalence, Step 3.1, is supplied for the actual
  -- false-bit encoding. Precomposition transports semidecision along the
  -- ordinary many-one reduction. Post's theorem, Step 1.1, rules out the
  -- opposite semidecision since this representative is nonrecursive.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-posts-theorem
  obtain ⟨Q, hQd, hQce⟩ := hce
  have hQre : REPred (fun x : Nat => x ∈ Q) :=
    (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false Q).mpr hQce
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfmem⟩ := (ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.mp
    (((memDegree A).mp hAd).trans ((memDegree Q).mp hQd).symm)).1
  have hAre : REPred (fun x : Nat => x ∈ A) :=
    REPred.of_eq (p := fun x => f x ∈ Q) (Partrec.comp hQre hf) fun x => (hfmem x).symm
  have hAcNre : ¬ REPred (fun x : Nat => x ∈ Aᶜ) :=
    fun h => hAnrec (ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mpr ⟨hAre, h⟩)

  -- Cintioli, §4, Theorem 5, p. 8, and the compiled LocalInterpolation
  -- require both colours to be non-c.e. In this branch hAre gives a c.e.
  -- colour. The generalized trace uses M = Aᶜ for the lower markers.
  -- Alphabeta Math's halting completeness, Steps 1.1 and 2.1, uses the
  -- paired domain of the universal evaluator. Here a single recognizer
  -- code suffices for every input x. Subtracting its oracle answer from
  -- 1 gives the membership bit for M.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-halting-is-sigma-one-complete
  let φ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.canonicalNumbering
  let V := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.row
  let stage := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.rowAt
  have hφacc : AcceptableNumbering φ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.canonicalNumbering_acceptable
  have hφ : Partrec₂ φ := hφacc.2.2.1
  let K := PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ
  let oracle (n : Nat) : Part Nat := Part.some (@ite Nat (n ∈ K) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)
  obtain ⟨code, hcode⟩ := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff_exists_code A).mp hAre
  let index := Encodable.encode code
  have hQuery (x : Nat) : Nat.pair index x ∈ K ↔ x ∈ A := by
    rw [PriorityRequirements.pair_mem_haltingOracle]
    change ((Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code (Encodable.encode code)).eval x).Dom ↔ x ∈ A
    rw [Denumerable.ofNat_encode]
    exact hcode x
  have hInput : Computable (fun x => Nat.pair index x) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.const index) Computable.id
  have hCall : Nat.RecursiveIn ({oracle} : Set (Nat →. Nat)) oracle :=
    Nat.RecursiveIn.oracle oracle (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hSwap : Computable (fun b : Nat => 1 - b) :=
    Primrec.nat_sub.to_comp.comp (Computable.const 1) Computable.id
  -- Use the classical decision instance expected by existsEffectiveTrace.
  have hM : Nat.RecursiveIn ({oracle} : Set (Nat →. Nat))
      (fun x => Part.some (@ite Nat (x ∈ Aᶜ) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
    refine ((RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hSwap.computableIn).comp
      (hCall.comp (RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hInput.computableIn))).of_eq fun x => ?_
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A
    · simp [oracle, Set.mem_compl_iff, hx, (hQuery x).mpr hx]
    · simp [oracle, Set.mem_compl_iff, hx, (hQuery x).not.mpr hx]
  let before (q r : Nat × Nat) : Prop := Nat.pair q.1 q.2 < Nat.pair r.1 r.2
  have hOrder : IsStrictTotalOrder (Nat × Nat) before :=
    Nat.pairEquiv.injective.isStrictTotalOrder_onFun (· < ·)
  have hPairCode : Primrec (fun q : Nat × Nat => Nat.pair q.1 q.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd
  have hBefore : ComputablePred (fun p : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => before p.1 p.2) :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (hPairCode.comp Primrec.fst) (hPairCode.comp Primrec.snd)).computablePred
  obtain ⟨T, _, hSigma⟩ := PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace φ stage Aᶜ before
    hφ hφacc.2.1 HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.computable_rowAt_code hOrder hBefore hM
  let N := T.output
  let P : Set Nat := Nᶜ
  -- Post's theorem, Steps 2.1 and 3.1. The supplier gives the transcript
  -- certificate for this trace, and the unary presentation commutes with
  -- complement. Both requirements below use the trace producing that certificate.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-posts-theorem
  have hPi : {xs : Fin 1 → Nat | xs 0 ∈ P} ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).2.1 := by
    change ({xs : Fin 1 → Nat | xs 0 ∈ N}ᶜᶜ : Set (Fin 1 → Nat)) ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1
    simpa using hSigma

  have hVre : REPred (fun q : Nat × Nat × Nat => q.2.2 ∈ V q.1 q.2.1) :=
    (hφ.comp Computable.fst (hPairCode.to_comp.comp Computable.snd)).dom_re
  have upper (e : Nat) (homogeneous : ∀ x y, y ∈ V e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) :
      ∃ x, (V e x).Finite ∧ V e x ⊆ N := by
    apply T.upper_met V HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.monotone_rowAt
      HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage e
    intro Z hZ hZM
    -- Cintioli's Lemma 2, pp. 4–6, uses non-enumerability for colours
    -- represented by the finite restraints. Its restricted supplier
    -- applies since every marker is in Aᶜ and hAcNre covers that colour.
    -- Recognizability equivalence, Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1, supplies the
    -- true-bit c.e. graph from the canonical row-domain semidecision.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
    refine FiniteMarkerAvoidance.of_nonCE_marker_colors A (V e) hAnCyl
      ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp
        (PriorityRequirements.rowGraphRE hVre e)) homogeneous Z hZ ?_
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨fun hzA => (hZM hz hzA).elim, fun _ hceAc =>
      hAcNre ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true Aᶜ).mpr hceAc)⟩

  have hAinf : A.Infinite := by
    intro hAfin
    have hmem : PrimrecRel (fun (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) => x ∈ xs) :=
      (PrimrecRel.exists_mem_list (R := @Eq Nat) Primrec.eq).of_eq (by
        intro xs x
        simp)
    exact hAnrec
      (((hmem.decide.to_comp.comp (Computable.const hAfin.toFinset.toList)
        Computable.id).computablePred).of_eq
          (fun x => Finset.mem_toList.trans hAfin.mem_toFinset))
  obtain ⟨enumerate, hEnumerate, hRange⟩ :=
    ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_exists_computable_range hAre hAinf.nonempty
  -- Lemma 4 gives unbounded omissions in Nat. Apply it to the race with
  -- a partial map defined exactly on A. Every omission from the union
  -- of the domains is in Aᶜ and is also omitted by the original map.
  -- Wait for recognition of x, then search the total enumeration for a
  -- larger member. This is Step 1.1 of recognizability equivalence with
  -- the computable test x < enumerate n in place of equality.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
  let pass (x n : Nat) : Part Bool := Part.some (decide (x < enumerate n))
  have hPass : Partrec₂ pass :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp Computable.fst
      (hEnumerate.comp Computable.snd)).partrec
  let search (x : Nat) : Part Nat := Part.map enumerate (Nat.rfind (pass x))
  have hSearch : Partrec search :=
    (Partrec.rfind hPass).map (hEnumerate.comp Computable.snd)
  let advance (x : Nat) : Part Nat :=
    (Part.assert (x ∈ A) (fun _ => Part.some ())).bind (fun _ => search x)
  have hAdvance : Partrec advance := Partrec.bind hAre (hSearch.comp Computable.fst)
  have hAdvanceDom (x : Nat) : (advance x).Dom ↔ x ∈ A := by
    rw [Part.dom_iff_mem]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu, _⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hy
      obtain ⟨hx, _⟩ := Part.mem_assert_iff.mp hu
      exact hx
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hyA, hxy⟩ := hAinf.exists_gt x
      rw [← hRange] at hyA
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hyA
      have hFound : (Nat.rfind (pass x)).Dom := (Nat.rfind_dom' (p := pass x)).mpr
        ⟨n, by simp [pass, hxy], fun _ => by simp [pass]⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.mp hFound
      refine ⟨enumerate k, Part.mem_bind_iff.mpr ⟨(), ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · simp [hx]
      · exact (Part.mem_map_iff _).mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  have hAdvanceAsc (x y : Nat) (hy : y ∈ advance x) : x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hySearch⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hy
    obtain ⟨hx, _⟩ := Part.mem_assert_iff.mp hu
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := (Part.mem_map_iff enumerate).mp hySearch
    have hLt : x < enumerate k := by simpa [pass] using Nat.rfind_spec hk
    exact ⟨hLt, iff_of_true (hRange ▸ Set.mem_range_self k) hx⟩
  have lower (e : Nat) (ascending : ∀ x y, y ∈ φ e x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) :
      ∃ m, m ∈ P ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom := by
    obtain ⟨race, hRace, hRaceDom, hRaceVal⟩ :=
      CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union (hφacc.1 e) hAdvance
    have hRaceAsc (x y : Nat) (hy : y ∈ race x) : x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) :=
      (hRaceVal x y hy).elim (ascending x y) (hAdvanceAsc x y)
    have hMissing := CofiniteDomainLemma A race hAnrec hAnCyl hRace hRaceAsc
    obtain ⟨m, _, hmN, hmDom⟩ := T.lower_met e fun b => by
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hb⟩ := hMissing.exists_gt b
      change ¬ (race m).Dom at hm
      rw [hRaceDom, hAdvanceDom] at hm
      exact ⟨m, hb, fun h => hm (Or.inr h), fun h => hm (Or.inl h)⟩
    exact ⟨m, hmN, hmDom⟩

  -- Cintioli, Lemma 1 and the proof of Theorem 5, pp. 11–12. Realize
  -- the Π₂ set as the infinite-fibre profile and use the computable section
  -- for the forward reduction to the pullback.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=11
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpSurj, hProfile, s, hs, hSection⟩ := ProfileRealization P hPi
  let C := Set.preimage p A
  have hsExists : ∃ s : Nat → Nat, Computable s ∧ Function.RightInverse s p :=
    ⟨s, hs, hSection⟩
  obtain ⟨_, hAC, _, hCdeg⟩ := PullbackReductions A P p s hp hpSurj hProfile hs hSection
  have hCd : C ∈ d := (memDegree C).mpr (hCdeg.trans ((memDegree A).mp hAd))
  have hCnotA : ¬ reducible C A := by
    rintro ⟨h, hh, hFib, hMem⟩
    -- The least-search map supplied on p. 12 is ascending and defined
    -- on P. Its exact canonical index lets the lower requirement find
    -- a point of P where that same map is undefined.
    -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=12
    obtain ⟨hPartial, hAsc, hDom⟩ :=
      AscendingSelfReductionFromPullbackReduction A P p h hp hpSurj hsExists hProfile hh hFib hMem
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hφacc.2.1 _ hPartial
    obtain ⟨m, hmP, hmDom⟩ := lower e (by simpa only [he] using hAsc)
    exact hmDom (by rw [he]; exact hDom hmP)
  have hCnotTop : ¬ reducible (cylinder A) C := by
    rintro ⟨h, hh, hFib, hMem⟩
    -- Exhaust the whole row family at one canonical index. The row
    -- supplier uses true bits and its graph packs (x,y) with Nat.pair.
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨e, he⟩, hHom⟩ :=
      HomogeneousRowsFromCylinderReduction A P p hp hpSurj hsExists hProfile h hh hFib hMem
        stage HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.computable_rowAt_code
        HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.monotone_rowAt (by
          intro W hW
          obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.exists_index_stages
            ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mpr hW)
          refine ⟨e, fun x => Set.ext fun y => ?_⟩
          refine Iff.trans ?_ (he x y)
          constructor
          · exact fun hy => ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩
          · rintro ⟨u, v, hv, huv⟩
            obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp huv
            exact hv)
    have hRows (x : Nat) : Set.range (fun n => p (h (Nat.pair x n))) = V e x :=
      (he x).trans (Set.ext fun y => (HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage e x y).symm)
