    obtain ⟨x, hxFin, hxSub⟩ := upper e fun u y hy =>
      hHom u y (by
        change y ∈ Set.range (fun n => p (h (Nat.pair u n)))
        rwa [hRows u])
    have hpFib : ∀ y ∈ V e x, (Set.preimage p ({y} : Set Nat)).Finite := by
      intro y hy
      by_contra hInf
      have hyP : y ∈ P := by
        rw [← hProfile]
        exact hInf
      exact hyP (hxSub hy)
    -- Pull the selected finite row back along each finite-fibre map over
    -- that row. The resulting finite set would contain the whole x-column.
    have hImageFinite : (Set.preimage h (Set.preimage p (V e x))).Finite :=
      (hxFin.preimage' hpFib).preimage' (fun y _ => hFib y)
    have hColumnInf : (Set.range (Nat.pair x)).Infinite :=
      Set.infinite_range_of_injective (fun _ _ hEq => (Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp hEq).2)
    apply hImageFinite.not_infinite
    apply hColumnInf.mono
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    change p (h (Nat.pair x n)) ∈ V e x
    rw [← hRows x]
    exact Set.mem_range_self n
  have hCneTop : degree C ≠ top := fun heq =>
    hCnotTop (degreeEq.mp (hCylTop.trans heq.symm)).1
  have hCproper : degree C ∈ proper := ⟨⟨C, hCd, rfl⟩, by simpa using hCneTop⟩
  exact hCnotA ((below_iff C A).mp (hDmax.2 hCproper ((below_iff A C).mpr hAC)))

Step 1.1 inspires the membership equivalence for transporting reductions across choices of representatives. Finite-one composition also preserves finite fibres.
Steps 1.1–3.1 inspire the exact false-bit and true-bit Nat bridges and the terminating search through the computable enumeration of A for a larger member.

ComplementCeDichotomy.proof:
by
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §1 p. 1 and Corollary 7 p. 14, pass
  -- to the complementary degree. The paper excludes a finite cardinality
  -- greater than one. Here the two disjuncts transfer directly along Φ.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=1
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=14
  -- The article-specific portal and its defect report returned HTTP 404.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  intro finiteOneReducible finiteOneDegree d representatives hnonrec hcoce finiteOneDegrees
  obtain ⟨A, hAd, hAcoce⟩ := hcoce
  change ManyOneDegree.of A = d at hAd
  subst d
  let F (e : ManyOneDegree) := Set.image finiteOneDegree {X | ManyOneDegree.of X = e}
  change (∃! D, D ∈ F (ManyOneDegree.of A)) ∨ (F (ManyOneDegree.of A)).Infinite

  -- Alphabeta Math's many-one interface, verification Step 1.1, uses
  -- total computable maps and membership equivalences on Nat. Here the
  -- second reduction from quotient equality lets us precompose a total
  -- decision procedure for Y with a reduction from Aᶜ to Y. Negating the
  -- resulting test decides A, contradicting nonrecursiveness of its degree.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface
  have hComplementNonrecursive :
      ¬ ∃ Y : Set Nat, ManyOneDegree.of Y = ManyOneDegree.of Aᶜ ∧
        ComputablePred (fun n : Nat => n ∈ Y) := by
    rintro ⟨Y, hY, hYcomp⟩
    have hComplComp : ComputablePred (fun n : Nat => n ∈ Aᶜ) :=
      ComputablePred.computable_of_manyOneReducible
        (ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.mp hY).2 hYcomp
    have hAcomp : ComputablePred (fun n : Nat => n ∈ A) := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] using hComplComp.not
    exact hnonrec ⟨A, rfl, hAcomp⟩

  -- The two Nat reductions in the Maslova supplier characterize precisely
  -- the quotient fibre of Aᶜ. Its finite-one class map agrees definitionally
  -- with the one in this endpoint.
  let complementRepresentatives : Set (Set Nat) :=
    {Y | ManyOneReducibilityOnNat Y Aᶜ ∧ ManyOneReducibilityOnNat Aᶜ Y}
  have hFibre (Y : Set Nat) :
      Y ∈ complementRepresentatives ↔ ManyOneDegree.of Y = ManyOneDegree.of Aᶜ :=
    ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.symm
  have hRepresentatives :
      complementRepresentatives = {Y | ManyOneDegree.of Y = ManyOneDegree.of Aᶜ} :=
    Set.ext hFibre
  have hMaslova := MaslovaCeDichotomy Aᶜ
    (fun ⟨Y, hY, hYcomp⟩ => hComplementNonrecursive ⟨Y, (hFibre Y).mp hY, hYcomp⟩)
    ⟨Aᶜ, (hFibre Aᶜ).mpr rfl,
      -- Recognizability equivalence, Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1, uses binary
      -- words and handles the empty language separately. The compiled
      -- bridge gives the corresponding Nat enumeration for n false bits.
      -- The supplied REPred proves the encoded c.e. premise for Aᶜ itself.
      -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
      (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false Aᶜ).mp hAcoce⟩
  change (∃! D, D ∈ Set.image finiteOneDegree complementRepresentatives) ∨
    (Set.image finiteOneDegree complementRepresentatives).Infinite at hMaslova
  rw [hRepresentatives] at hMaslova

  -- The order-isomorphism supplier takes the same co-c.e. hypothesis and
  -- identifies the subtypes of these very class images. Only its underlying
  -- equivalence is needed to transport cardinality.
  obtain ⟨Φ, _⟩ := ComplementationOrderIsomorphism A hAcoce
  have e : F (ManyOneDegree.of A) ≃ F (ManyOneDegree.of Aᶜ) := Φ.toEquiv
  rcases hMaslova with hUnique | hInfinite
  · exact Or.inl (e.existsUnique_subtype_congr.mpr hUnique)
  · exact Or.inr (Set.infinite_coe_iff.mp
      (e.infinite_iff.mpr (Set.infinite_coe_iff.mpr hInfinite)))

external.usage: In ComplementCeDichotomy, identify the Nat representative relation in MaslovaCeDichotomy with the quotient fibre of the complementary degree. Also obtain the reduction from the complement to a hypothetical computable representative of that fibre.
In ComplementCeDichotomy, pull computability back along the reduction from the complement to a hypothetical computable representative of the complementary degree.

In ComplementCeDichotomy, negate the resulting decision predicate for the complement. Double negation then gives a decision predicate for the original representative, contradicting the degree hypothesis.

NonrecursiveManyOneDegreeDichotomy.proof:
by
  classical
  -- Cintioli, arXiv:2609.00419v1, §5, Corollary 7, pp. 13–14.
  -- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=13
  -- The article-specific Alphabeta Math portal and defect report returned
  -- HTTP 404. The numbered steps cited below are from the shared library.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/research-portal/nonrecursive-many-one-degrees-2609-00419/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects
  intro finiteOneReducible finiteOneDegree d
  induction d using ManyOneDegree.ind_on with
  | h B =>
    intro representatives hNonrecursive finiteOneDegrees
    have hDichotomy :
        (∃! D, D ∈ finiteOneDegrees) ∨ finiteOneDegrees.Infinite := by
      -- The article splits on the representative of the maximal proper
      -- class. The two compiled dichotomies take witnesses anywhere in
      -- the fibre, so we split before constructing a maximal class.
      by_cases hCe : ∃ X ∈ representatives, REPred (fun n : Nat => n ∈ X)
      · let maslovaRepresentatives : Set (Set Nat) :=
          {X | ManyOneReducibilityOnNat X B ∧ ManyOneReducibilityOnNat B X}
        have hMem (X : Set Nat) : X ∈ maslovaRepresentatives ↔ X ∈ representatives :=
          ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.symm
        have hFibre : maslovaRepresentatives = representatives := Set.ext hMem
        obtain ⟨X, hXB, hX⟩ := hCe
        -- Recognizability equivalence, Steps 1.2, 2.1 and 3.1, gives a
        -- range presentation with a separate empty case. The Nat bridge
        -- supplies the false-bit word encoding expected by Maslova.
        -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
        have hMaslova := MaslovaCeDichotomy B
          (fun ⟨Y, hYB, hY⟩ => hNonrecursive ⟨Y, (hMem Y).mp hYB, hY⟩)
          ⟨X, (hMem X).mpr hXB, (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false X).mp hX⟩
        change (∃! D, D ∈ Set.image finiteOneDegree maslovaRepresentatives) ∨
          (Set.image finiteOneDegree maslovaRepresentatives).Infinite at hMaslova
        rw [hFibre] at hMaslova
        exact hMaslova
      by_cases hCoCe : ∃ X ∈ representatives, REPred (fun n : Nat => n ∈ Xᶜ)
      · -- The compiled complementation dichotomy transfers the two
        -- alternatives along the equivalence of degree fibres.
        exact ComplementCeDichotomy (ManyOneDegree.of B) hNonrecursive hCoCe
      by_cases hFinite : finiteOneDegrees.Finite
      swap
      · exact Or.inr hFinite
      left
      let cylinder (X : Set Nat) : Set Nat := {z | ∃ x n, x ∈ X ∧ z = Nat.pair x n}
      let top := finiteOneDegree (cylinder B)
      have hTop : top ∈ finiteOneDegrees :=
        ⟨cylinder B, (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree B).1, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨top, hTop, ?_⟩
      intro E hE
      by_contra hEne

      -- Alphabeta Math's many-one interface, verification Step 1.1,
      -- composes total Nat reductions and the membership equivalences.
      -- The finite-one composition supplier also checks the finite
      -- fibres. Transport across equal classes uses mutual reductions.
      -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-computable-many-one-reducibility-interface
      have classEq {X Y : Set Nat} :
          finiteOneDegree X = finiteOneDegree Y ↔
            finiteOneReducible X Y ∧ finiteOneReducible Y X :=
        ReducibilityImplications.finiteOneDegree_eq_iff
      have compose {X Y Z : Set Nat} (hXY : finiteOneReducible X Y)
          (hYZ : finiteOneReducible Y Z) : finiteOneReducible X Z :=
        ReducibilityImplications.finiteOneTrans hXY hYZ
      let below (D F : Set (Set Nat)) : Prop :=
        ∃ X Y : Set Nat, finiteOneDegree X = D ∧ finiteOneDegree Y = F ∧
          finiteOneReducible X Y
      have below_iff (X Y : Set Nat) :
          below (finiteOneDegree X) (finiteOneDegree Y) ↔ finiteOneReducible X Y := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨U, V, hUX, hVY, hUV⟩
          exact compose (classEq.mp hUX).2 (compose hUV (classEq.mp hVY).1)
        · exact fun h => ⟨X, Y, rfl, rfl, h⟩
      let degreeOrder : LE (Set (Set Nat)) := ⟨below⟩
      have hTrans : IsTrans (Set (Set Nat)) below := ⟨by
        rintro D F G ⟨X, Y, hXD, hYF, hXY⟩ ⟨U, V, hUF, hVG, hUV⟩
        exact ⟨X, V, hXD, hVG, compose hXY
          (compose (classEq.mp (hYF.trans hUF.symm)).1 hUV)⟩⟩
      -- Corollary 7's class covered by the greatest class comes from
      -- maximality in the finite nonempty set with the cylinder removed.
      let proper := finiteOneDegrees \ {top}
      have hProperFinite : proper.Finite := hFinite.sdiff
      have hProperNonempty : proper.Nonempty := ⟨E, hE, by simpa using hEne⟩
      obtain ⟨D, hDmax⟩ :=
        @Set.Finite.exists_maximal _ degreeOrder hTrans proper hProperFinite hProperNonempty
      obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := hDmax.1.1
      have hAne : finiteOneDegree A ≠ top := by simpa using hDmax.1.2
      have hAnrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun n : Nat => n ∈ A) :=
        fun h => hNonrecursive ⟨A, hA, h⟩

      -- The cylinder theorem places both cylinders in the same many-one
      -- fibre and supplies each direction of finite-one reducibility.
      have hAB : ManyOneDegree.of A = ManyOneDegree.of B := hA
      have hCylTop : finiteOneDegree (cylinder A) = top := classEq.mpr
        ⟨(CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree B).2 _
            ((CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).1.trans hAB),
          (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 _
            ((CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree B).1.trans hAB.symm)⟩
      have hAnCyl :
          ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun n : Nat => n ∈ A) (fun n : Nat => n ∈ cylinder A) ∧
            OneOneReducible (fun n : Nat => n ∈ cylinder A) (fun n : Nat => n ∈ A)) := by
        rintro ⟨hTo, hFrom⟩
        exact hAne ((classEq.mpr
          ⟨(ReducibilityImplications A (cylinder A)).1 hTo,
            (ReducibilityImplications (cylinder A) A).1 hFrom⟩).trans hCylTop)

      -- The reverse direction of the encoding bridge implements
      -- recognizability Step 1.1, including the empty case. Theorem 5
      -- uses the true-bit encoding for both colours.
      -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable
      obtain ⟨C, hCA, ⟨hAC, hNotCA⟩, ⟨_, hNotCylC⟩⟩ :=
        LocalInterpolation A hAnrec hAnCyl
          (fun h => hCe ⟨A, hA, (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true A).mpr h⟩)
          (fun h => hCoCe ⟨A, hA, (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true Aᶜ).mpr h⟩)
      have hCmem : finiteOneDegree C ∈ finiteOneDegrees := ⟨C, hCA.trans hAB, rfl⟩
      have hCne : finiteOneDegree C ≠ top :=
        fun h => hNotCylC (classEq.mp (h.trans hCylTop.symm)).2
      have hCproper : finiteOneDegree C ∈ proper := ⟨hCmem, by simpa using hCne⟩
      exact hNotCA ((below_iff C A).mp
        (hDmax.2 hCproper ((below_iff A C).mpr hAC)))

    -- The endpoint also states the finite-cardinality exclusion explicitly.
    refine ⟨hDichotomy, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨hFinite, D, hD, E, hE, hDE⟩
    rcases hDichotomy with ⟨T, _, hUnique⟩ | hInfinite
    · exact hDE ((hUnique D hD).trans (hUnique E hE).symm)
    · exact hInfinite hFinite

PriorityRequirements.advice:
Use the draft `PriorityRequirements.stabilityQuery φ hsurj stage hstage`. Destructure the result as ⟨query, hquery, hstable⟩ and pass these directly to `PriorityCodedVisitTrace` with the supplied pair order and marker oracle. The trace supplier’s paired domain is definitionally equal to `PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ`. The query and its specification type-check at that call site.

Pack the triple as n = Nat.pair e (Nat.pair x t). For arbitrary n, decode e, x and t by two unpairings. Let C(n,d) be the bit code of row e x (t + d), and let B(n,d) be decide (C(n,d) ≠ C(n,0)). Computable unpairing, projections, addition and natural-number equality compose with the uniform stage-code hypothesis to make B total and computable. Define F(n) = Nat.rfind (fun d => Part.some (B(n,d))). Partrec.rfind gives Partrec F. Nat.rfind_dom gives F(n).Dom ↔ ∃ d, B(n,d) = true because Part.some supplies the domain proof at every smaller offset. In particular, F diverges on stable triples. The Boolean test and query map are total.

Apply unary surjectivity once to F to obtain i with φ i = F. The query is q(n) = Nat.pair i n, with i constant over all triples. Nat.unpair_pair and φ i = F give q(n) ∈ K ↔ F(n).Dom. For a packed triple, injectivity of Finset.equivBitIndices.symm and t + 0 = t turn this into q(n) ∈ K ↔ ∃ d, row e x (t + d) ≠ row e x t. If q(n) ∉ K and r ≥ t, take d = r − t and use t + (r − t) = r to get equality. Conversely, if every stage r ≥ t agrees with stage t, every t + d agrees, so F diverges at n and q(n) ∉ K. This is the fixed-stage test in §4, p. 8. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00419v1#page=8

**Upper witness.** Fix e and use the computable pullback z ↦ (e, Nat.unpair z) of the supplied REPred triple predicate. Nat.pair_unpair and Nat.unpair_pair identify that pullback with Gₑ = {z | ∃ x y, y ∈ V e x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}. PriorityRequirements.rowGraphRE supplies precisely this equivalence. Apply (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp to get the supplier's c.e. premise with n copies of true. Apply FiniteMarkerAvoidance to V e with the noncylinder and both non-c.e. hypotheses, homogeneity, and the finite set Z of actual final active higher-priority markers. At the pre-visit state (s, 2e), PriorityRequirements.VerificationTrace.stabilization makes that set equal to Z. The set consists of values of some m at lower priorities 2j+1 < 2e. There are finitely many such indices, each with at most one final value. PriorityCodedTrace.memMarkerSet implements exactly this restraint predicate in the adapter. A finite row is exhausted at a common stage t by monotonicity and the stage-union law. Choose s beyond the restraint cutoff with 2e < s and s ≥ max(x, t, sup(row e x t)). The pair (x,t) then passes all three tests. If the flag is already done, doneNext traces it to an actual earlier action. Otherwise upperProgress forces an action. For the pair actually chosen, stabilizedRow identifies the full row with its finite stage value and action puts it into content s s, hence into output. See PriorityRequirements.finiteRowExhaustion, .stabilizedRow, .VerificationTrace.upper_met and .finish in the draft.

**Lower witness.** Fix e and specialize hφ with hφ.comp (Computable.const e) Computable.id. CofiniteDomainLemma applies to that ordinary Partrec section with the given pointwise strict increase and colour preservation, nonrecursiveness and noncylindricity. Set.Infinite.exists_gt produces m outside dom(φ e) strictly above the quiet and stabilization cutoffs, the largest final higher marker and 2e+1. With k = 2e+1, use state (m,k) just before Lₑ. At (m,0), contentCarry and contentBound at stage m−1 exclude m. If m first enters before k during stage m, enterContent attributes that entry to an actual higher upper action, contrary to the quiet bound. A higher active marker lies in the stabilized finite restraint set and is smaller than m. For Lₑ itself and lower priorities, markerCarry and markerBound exclude the value m at the start of the stage, and enterMarker can first introduce it only at that strategy's own visit, at or after k. Thus a markerless Lₑ has m as an eligible candidate at its stage-m search. Use the marker a it already holds or the a chosen by the search. This a can differ from m. The stable live a belongs to M, is outside dom(φ e), and is outside every sufficiently late end-of-stage content by active. Any earlier entry into end-of-stage content would carry forward by contentCarry and contentPersists to stage max(s,S₁), where S₁ is the stable cutoff and s the alleged entry stage. This excludes all entries into output. See PriorityRequirements.VerificationTrace.lower_met and .finish.

**Restricted admissibility.** FiniteInjuryAndStabilization.of_trace uses only boundary carry, once-only actual upper actions, attribution of cancellation to a higher upper action, and preservation or clearing of each live marker. It permits the restricted transition law. All live markers lie in M, so Z ⊆ M. The original upper hypothesis of two non-c.e. colours suffices for every M. The weaker sufficient hypothesis in FiniteMarkerAvoidance.of_nonCE_marker_colors concerns only colours represented in the actual Z. For A c.e. and nonrecursive, Aᶜ is non-c.e. by ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re', so M = Aᶜ makes every actual restraint eligible for this lemma. The row-graph conversion still uses true. If the consumer gives c.e. using false bits, unfold ComputablyEnumerableSet to its range formulation and use (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false A).mpr to recover REPred.

The genuine lower proof obligation for a restricted M is unboundedness of M ∩ {m | ¬ (φ e m).Dom}. The unrestricted CofiniteDomainLemma conclusion alone is insufficient even for M = ∅. Once the restricted unboundedness premise holds, the freshness, protection and exclusion proofs use the same laws. For M = Aᶜ with A c.e. nonrecursive, A is infinite. Enumerate A computably and search for a pair of enumeration indices whose values are x and some y > x. This gives an ascending colour-preserving partial recursive ψ with domain exactly A. Use CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union to race ψ and φ e, yielding g with domain A ∪ dom(φ e) and outputs from one of the two at each input. A two-sided race is essential when just one branch converges. CofiniteDomainLemma on g gives infinitely many omissions in Aᶜ outside dom(φ e). For effectivity of this M, unary surjectivity gives one index i for a semidecider whose domain is A, and querying K at Nat.pair i m and flipping the answer gives the required characteristic function. The restricted result is a consumer of the general trace adapter. The quantifier order of the original endpoint uses M = Set.univ, with the trace chosen before A.

/-- A c.e. colour supplies an ascending partial map defined on exactly that colour. -/
theorem ceAscendingMap {A : Set ℕ} (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A)) (hinf : A.Infinite) :
    ∃ ψ : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec ψ ∧
      (∀ x, (ψ x).Dom ↔ x ∈ A) ∧
      (∀ x y, y ∈ ψ x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) := by
  -- Alphabeta Math, thm-recognizable-iff-enumerable, Steps 1.2, 2.1, 3.1.
  -- The Nat range bridge supplies an enumerator, which we search over pairs.
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hrange⟩ := ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_exists_computable_range hA hinf.nonempty
  let test (x n : ℕ) : Option ℕ :=
    if a n.unpair.1 = x ∧ x < a n.unpair.2 then some (a n.unpair.2) else none
  have first : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => a p.2.unpair.1) :=
    ha.comp (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.unpair.comp Computable.snd))
  have last : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => a p.2.unpair.2) :=
    ha.comp (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.unpair.comp Computable.snd))
  have eqTest := Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp.comp first Computable.fst
  have ltTest := Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp Computable.fst last
  have both : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => decide (a p.2.unpair.1 = p.1 ∧ p.1 < a p.2.unpair.2)) :=
    (Primrec.and.to_comp.comp eqTest ltTest).of_eq (by intro p; simp [Bool.decide_and])
  have htest : Computable₂ test := by
    change Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => test p.1 p.2)
    simpa only [test, Bool.cond_decide] using
      both.cond (Computable.option_some.comp last) (Computable.const (none : Option ℕ))
  have valid {x n y} (hy : y ∈ test x n) : x < y ∧ y ∈ A ∧ x ∈ A := by
    unfold test at hy
    split at hy
    next h =>
      have he : a n.unpair.2 = y := by simpa using hy
      subst y
      exact ⟨h.2, hrange ▸ (show a n.unpair.2 ∈ Set.range a from ⟨_, rfl⟩),
        hrange ▸ (show x ∈ Set.range a from ⟨n.unpair.1, h.1⟩)⟩
    next => simp at hy
  refine ⟨fun x => Nat.rfindOpt (test x), Partrec.rfindOpt htest, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.rfindOpt_dom]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, y, hy⟩
      exact (valid hy).2.2
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hinf.exists_gt x
      rw [← hrange] at hx hy
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨Nat.pair i j, a j, by simp [test, hxy]⟩
  · intro x y h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec h
    obtain ⟨hxy, hy, hx⟩ := valid hn
    exact ⟨hxy, iff_of_true hy hx⟩

theorem ceComplementHasUnboundedOmissions
    (A : Set ℕ) (f : ℕ → Part ℕ)
    (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnoncyl : ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun x => x ∈ A)
        (fun z => ∃ x n : ℕ, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n) ∧
      OneOneReducible (fun z => ∃ x n : ℕ, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n)
        (fun x => x ∈ A)))
    (hf : Partrec f)
    (hasc : ∀ x y, y ∈ f x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) :
    ∀ b : ℕ, ∃ m, b < m ∧ m ∈ Aᶜ ∧ ¬ (f m).Dom := by
  classical
  have hAinf : A.Infinite := by
    intro hfin
    let xs := hfin.toFinset.toList
    have listMem : PrimrecRel (fun (ys : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) => x ∈ ys) :=
      (PrimrecRel.exists_mem_list (R := @Eq ℕ) Primrec.eq).of_eq (by intro ys x; simp)
    have comp : ComputablePred (fun x : ℕ => x ∈ xs) :=
      (listMem.decide.to_comp.comp (Computable.const xs) Computable.id).computablePred
    exact hnonrec (comp.of_eq (fun x => Finset.mem_toList.trans hfin.mem_toFinset))
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hdomψ, hascψ⟩ := ceAscendingMap hA hAinf
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hdomg, hout⟩ := CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union hf hψ
  have hascg (x y : ℕ) (hy : y ∈ g x) := (hout x y hy).elim (hasc x y) (hascψ x y)
  have hinf := CofiniteDomainLemma A g hnonrec hnoncyl hg hascg
  intro b
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmb⟩ := hinf.exists_gt b
  change ¬ (g m).Dom at hm
  exact ⟨m, hmb, fun h => hm ((hdomg m).2 (.inr ((hdomψ m).2 h))),
    fun h => hm ((hdomg m).2 (.inl h))⟩

/-- Witness formulas for a trace whose lower markers lie in the non-c.e. colour. -/
theorem ceRestrictedRequirements
    {φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ} {row : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    (A : Set ℕ) (T : VerificationTrace φ row (Aᶜ)) (V : ℕ → ℕ → Set ℕ)
    (hφ : Partrec₂ φ)
    (hV : REPred (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => p.2.2 ∈ V p.1 p.2.1))
    (hmono : ∀ e x, Monotone (row e x))
    (hunion : ∀ e x y, y ∈ V e x ↔ ∃ s, y ∈ row e x s)
    (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnoncyl : ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun x => x ∈ A)
        (fun z => ∃ x n : ℕ, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n) ∧
      OneOneReducible (fun z => ∃ x n : ℕ, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n)
        (fun x => x ∈ A))) :
    (∀ e, (∀ x y, y ∈ V e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
      ∃ x, (V e x).Finite ∧ V e x ⊆ T.output) ∧
    (∀ e, (∀ x y, y ∈ φ e x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
      ∃ m, m ∈ Aᶜ ∧ m ∉ T.output ∧ ¬ (φ e m).Dom) := by
  constructor
  · intro e hhom
    have hnotRE : ¬ REPred (fun x => x ∈ Aᶜ) :=
      fun h => hnonrec (ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mpr ⟨hA, h⟩)
    refine T.upper_met V hmono hunion e (fun Z hZ hZM => ?_)
    exact FiniteMarkerAvoidance.of_nonCE_marker_colors A (V e) hnoncyl
      ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp (rowGraphRE hV e))
      hhom Z hZ (fun z hz =>
        ⟨fun h => ((hZM hz) h).elim, fun _ hce =>
          hnotRE ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mpr hce)⟩)
  · intro e hasc
    exact T.lower_met e (ceComplementHasUnboundedOmissions A (φ e) hA hnonrec hnoncyl
      (hφ.comp (Computable.const e) Computable.id) hasc)

/-- The c.e. colour is the domain of a single section, so its complement is
decidable by one query to the paired halting oracle. -/
theorem ceComplementOracle
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ → Part ℕ) (A : Set ℕ)
    (hsurj : ∀ f : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec f → ∃ e, φ e = f)
    (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A)) :
    Nat.RecursiveIn
      {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0))}
      (by classical exact fun m => Part.some (if m ∈ Aᶜ then 1 else 0)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hdom⟩ := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff_exists_code A).mp hA
  have hc : Partrec c.eval :=
    Partrec.nat_iff.mpr (Nat.Partrec.Code.exists_code.mpr ⟨c, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsurj c.eval hc
  let answer (n : ℕ) := if n ∈ haltingOracle φ then 1 else 0
  let O : Set (ℕ →. ℕ) := {fun n => Part.some (answer n)}
  have hanswer : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (answer n)) :=
    Nat.RecursiveIn.oracle _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hpair : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (Nat.pair i n)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp
      (Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.const i) Computable.id).computableIn
  have hflip : Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (1 - n)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp
      (Primrec.nat_sub.to_comp.comp (Computable.const 1) Computable.id).computableIn
  refine (hflip.comp (hanswer.comp hpair)).of_eq ?_
  intro n
  have hn : Nat.pair i n ∈ haltingOracle φ ↔ n ∈ A :=
    (pair_mem_haltingOracle φ i n).trans (by rw [hi]; exact hdom n)
  by_cases hnA : n ∈ A <;> simp [answer, hn, hnA]

end PriorityRequirements

import Proofs.CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree
import Proofs.ComputablyEnumerableSet
import Mathlib.Order.Preorder.Finite

namespace MaslovaDegreeOrder

open ReducibilityImplications (FiniteOneReducible finiteOneDegree finiteOneDegree_eq_iff
  finiteOneRefl finiteOneTrans)

abbrev manyOneClass (A : Set Nat) : Set (Set Nat) :=
  {X | ManyOneReducibilityOnNat X A ∧ ManyOneReducibilityOnNat A X}

abbrev finiteOneClasses (A : Set Nat) : Set (Set (Set Nat)) :=
  finiteOneDegree '' manyOneClass A

abbrev cylinder (A : Set Nat) : Set Nat :=
  {z | ∃ x n : Nat, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n}

abbrev IsCylinder (X : Set Nat) : Prop :=
  OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ X) (fun n => n ∈ cylinder X) ∧
  OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ cylinder X) (fun n => n ∈ X)

theorem mem_manyOneClass {X A : Set Nat} :
    X ∈ manyOneClass A ↔ ManyOneDegree.of X = ManyOneDegree.of A := by
  change ManyOneEquiv (fun n => n ∈ X) (fun n => n ∈ A) ↔ _
  exact (ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of (p := X) (q := A)).symm

theorem transport {X X' Y Y' : Set Nat}
    (hx : finiteOneDegree X = finiteOneDegree X')
    (hy : finiteOneDegree Y = finiteOneDegree Y')
    (h : FiniteOneReducible X' Y') : FiniteOneReducible X Y :=
  finiteOneTrans (finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mp hx).1
    (finiteOneTrans h (finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mp hy).2)

def classLE (D E : Set (Set Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∃ X Y, finiteOneDegree X = D ∧ finiteOneDegree Y = E ∧ FiniteOneReducible X Y

theorem classLE_iff (X Y : Set Nat) :
    classLE (finiteOneDegree X) (finiteOneDegree Y) ↔ FiniteOneReducible X Y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨X', Y', hx, hy, h⟩
    exact transport hx.symm hy.symm h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨X, Y, rfl, rfl, h⟩

theorem classLE_trans {D E F : Set (Set Nat)} :
    classLE D E → classLE E F → classLE D F := by
  rintro ⟨X, Y, hX, hY, hXY⟩ ⟨Y', Z, hY', hZ, hYZ⟩
  have hYY' := (finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mp (hY.trans hY'.symm)).1
  exact ⟨X, Z, hX, hZ, finiteOneTrans hXY (finiteOneTrans hYY' hYZ)⟩

theorem classLE_refl_of_mem {A : Set Nat} {D : Set (Set Nat)}
    (hD : D ∈ finiteOneClasses A) : classLE D D := by
  obtain ⟨X, _, rfl⟩ := hD
  exact (classLE_iff X X).mpr (finiteOneRefl X)

theorem classLE_antisymm {D E : Set (Set Nat)}
    (hDE : classLE D E) (hED : classLE E D) : D = E := by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, rfl, rfl, hXY⟩ := hDE
  exact finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mpr ⟨hXY, (classLE_iff Y X).mp hED⟩

theorem top_mem (A : Set Nat) : finiteOneDegree (cylinder A) ∈ finiteOneClasses A :=
  ⟨cylinder A, mem_manyOneClass.mpr (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).1, rfl⟩

theorem le_cylinder {X A : Set Nat} (hX : X ∈ manyOneClass A) :
    FiniteOneReducible X (cylinder A) :=
  (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 X (mem_manyOneClass.mp hX)

theorem cylinder_eq_of_mem {A X : Set Nat} (hX : X ∈ manyOneClass A) :
    finiteOneDegree (cylinder X) = finiteOneDegree (cylinder A) := by
  have hAX : ManyOneDegree.of X = ManyOneDegree.of A := mem_manyOneClass.mp hX
  have hCX : ManyOneDegree.of (cylinder X) = ManyOneDegree.of X :=
    (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree X).1
  have hCA : ManyOneDegree.of (cylinder A) = ManyOneDegree.of A :=
    (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).1
  exact finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mpr
    ⟨(CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 (cylinder X) (hCX.trans hAX),
     (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree X).2 (cylinder A) (hCA.trans hAX.symm)⟩

theorem exists_nonCylinder_maximal (A : Set Nat)
    (hFin : (finiteOneClasses A).Finite)
    (hMulti : ¬ ∃! D, D ∈ finiteOneClasses A) :
    ∃ X ∈ manyOneClass A, ¬ IsCylinder X ∧
      ¬ FiniteOneReducible (cylinder X) X ∧
      ∀ Y ∈ manyOneClass A, FiniteOneReducible X Y →
        ¬ FiniteOneReducible (cylinder X) Y → FiniteOneReducible Y X := by
  classical
  let T := finiteOneDegree (cylinder A)
  have hT : T ∈ finiteOneClasses A := top_mem A
  let s := finiteOneClasses A \ {T}
  have hs : s.Finite := hFin.subset (fun _ h => h.1)
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    apply hMulti
    refine ⟨T, hT, ?_⟩
    intro D hD
    by_contra hDT

    exact hXT ((finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mpr ⟨hXC, hBack⟩).trans hCylEq)

theorem dichotomy_of_interpolation (A : Set Nat)
    (interpolate : ∀ X ∈ manyOneClass A, ¬ IsCylinder X →
      ∃ Y ∈ manyOneClass A, FiniteOneReducible X Y ∧ ¬ FiniteOneReducible Y X ∧
        ¬ FiniteOneReducible (cylinder X) Y) :

  · left
    by_contra hMulti
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hNotCyl, _, hMax⟩ := exists_nonCylinder_maximal A hFin hMulti
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, hXY, hYX, hCY⟩ := interpolate X hX hNotCyl
    exact hYX (hMax Y hY hXY hCY)
  · exact Or.inr hFin

#print axioms dichotomy_of_interpolation


theorem rePred_of_manyOne {X B : Set Nat} (hXB : ManyOneReducibilityOnNat X B)

  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfMem⟩ := hXB
  have hPull : REPred (fun n => f n ∈ B) := Partrec.comp hB hf

theorem exact_endpoint_of_ce_interpolation
    (interpolate : ∀ X : Set Nat,

let decode (w : _root_.List _root_.Bool) :=
  if w = encode (_root_.List.length w) then _root_.Option.some (_root_.List.length w)

  ∃ f : _root_.Nat → _root_.Nat, _root_.Computable f ∧

    (∀ x : _root_.Nat, x ∈ X ↔ f x ∈ Y)
let finiteOneDegree (X : _root_.Set _root_.Nat) : _root_.Set (_root_.Set _root_.Nat) :=
  {Y | finiteOneReducible Y X ∧ finiteOneReducible X Y}
∀ A : _root_.Set _root_.Nat,
  let d : _root_.Set (_root_.Set _root_.Nat) :=

  (∃ X ∈ d, ce X) →

  intro X hX hNotCyl
  have hNonrecX : ¬ ComputablePred (fun n => n ∈ X) :=
    fun h => hNonrec ⟨X, hX, h⟩

  obtain ⟨Y, hYX, hRest⟩ := interpolate X hNonrecX hReX hNreX hNotCyl

theorem re_of_degree_has_ce (A : Set ℕ) :
    let encode (n : ℕ) := List.replicate n false
    let decode (w : List Bool) :=
      if w = encode (List.length w) then some (List.length w) else none
    let ce : Set ℕ → Prop :=
      ComputablyEnumerableSet encode decode (List.replicate_left_injective false)
        (fun n => by simp [decode, encode])
        (fun w hw => ite_eq_right (fun h => hw ⟨List.length w, h.symm⟩))
    let d : Set (Set ℕ) :=
      {X | ManyOneReducibilityOnNat X A ∧ ManyOneReducibilityOnNat A X}
    (∃ X ∈ d, ce X) → REPred (fun n : ℕ => n ∈ A) := by
  intro encode decode ce d hce
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨_, hAX⟩, hX⟩ := hce
  have hXre : REPred (fun x : ℕ => x ∈ X) :=
    (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false X).2 hX
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hmem⟩ := hAX
  have hp : REPred (fun x : ℕ => f x ∈ X) := Partrec.comp hXre hf
  exact hp.of_eq fun x => (hmem x).symm

theorem complementRecursiveIn (A : Set ℕ) (hA : REPred (fun x : ℕ => x ∈ A)) :
    Nat.RecursiveIn
      {(by classical exact fun n : ℕ => Part.some (if n ∈ PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle canonicalNumbering then 1 else 0))}
      (fun x : ℕ => Part.some (@ite ℕ (x ∈ Aᶜ) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff_exists_code A).1 hA
  let e : ℕ := Encodable.encode c
  let K := PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle canonicalNumbering
  let answer (n : ℕ) : Part ℕ := Part.some (if n ∈ K then 1 else 0)
  change Nat.RecursiveIn {answer} _
  have hquery (x : ℕ) : Nat.pair e x ∈ K ↔ x ∈ A := by
    rw [PriorityRequirements.pair_mem_haltingOracle]
    simpa only [canonicalNumbering, e, Denumerable.ofNat_encode] using hc x
  have hpair : Nat.RecursiveIn {answer} (fun x => Part.some (Nat.pair e x)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp
      ((Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.const e) Primrec.id).to_comp.computableIn)
  have hanswer : Nat.RecursiveIn {answer} answer :=
    Nat.RecursiveIn.oracle answer (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hswap : Nat.RecursiveIn {answer} (fun b => Part.some (1 - b)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp
      ((Primrec.nat_sub.comp (Primrec.const 1) Primrec.id).to_comp.computableIn)
  refine (hswap.comp (hanswer.comp hpair)).of_eq fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A
  · have hyes := (hquery x).2 hx
    simp [answer, hyes, hx]
  · have hno := (hquery x).not.2 hx
    simp [answer, hno, hx]

theorem existsRestrictedTrace (A : Set ℕ) (hA : REPred (fun x : ℕ => x ∈ A)) :
    ∃ T : PriorityRequirements.VerificationTrace canonicalNumbering rowAt Aᶜ,
      (RelativeComputabilityAndEnumerability
        (PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle canonicalNumbering)).2.1 T.output ∧
      {xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output} ∈
        (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1 ∧
      {xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.outputᶜ} ∈
        (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).2.1 := by
  let before (q r : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := Nat.pair q.1 q.2 < Nat.pair r.1 r.2
  have horder : IsStrictTotalOrder (ℕ × ℕ) before :=
    Nat.pairEquiv.injective.isStrictTotalOrder_onFun (· < ·)
  have hpairCode : Primrec (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => Nat.pair q.1 q.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd
  have hbefore : ComputablePred (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ) => before p.1 p.2) :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (hpairCode.comp Primrec.fst)
      (hpairCode.comp Primrec.snd)).computablePred
  obtain ⟨_, hsurj, hφ, _⟩ := canonicalNumbering_acceptable
  obtain ⟨T, hce, hsigma⟩ :=
    PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace canonicalNumbering rowAt Aᶜ before
      hφ hsurj computable_rowAt_code horder hbefore (complementRecursiveIn A hA)
  refine ⟨T, hce, hsigma, ?_⟩
  change ({xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output}ᶜᶜ : Set (Fin 1 → ℕ)) ∈
    (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1
  simpa using hsigma

#print axioms re_of_degree_has_ce
#print axioms complementRecursiveIn
#print axioms existsRestrictedTrace
end MaslovaRestrictedTraceCheck

The restricted requirements are proved for the c.e. representative A in MaslovaCeDichotomy, arXiv:2609.00419v1 §5 p. 13. Apply `MaslovaRestricted.existsRestrictedRequirements` to the endpoint's exact false-bit c.e. hypothesis for A, its noncomputability, and its failure of one-one equivalence with its cylinder. It returns one N with unary Π₂ complement and both indexed requirements. Apply `MaslovaRestricted.packedExhaustion` to the true-bit packed graph premise of `HomogeneousRowsFromCylinderReduction`. Its output uses the exact required stage-union row equality, and `HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage` identifies those rows with the canonical `row` used for the requirements.

For the upper requirement, `canonicalTripleRE` takes the domain of the joint partial evaluator on (e, Nat.pair x y). `PriorityRequirements.rowGraphRE` fixes e and computably unpairs z. `ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true` supplies the exact true-bit c.e. premise of `FiniteMarkerAvoidance.of_nonCE_marker_colors`, including the empty case. `VerificationTrace.upper_met` gets a finite stabilized restraint Z from the trace and uses `VerificationTrace.active` to prove Z ⊆ M. Set M = Aᶜ. For every z ∈ Z, z ∈ A contradicts admissibility, and the negative-colour condition follows from non-recursiveness and the false-bit bridge for A, the true-bit bridge for Aᶜ, and `ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'`. Thus every finite admissible restraint has a disjoint finite row. The selected stabilized row enters the output of the same trace.

For the lower requirement, finite A would have a computable membership test using a fixed finite list, so A is infinite. `ceAdvance` first gates on recognizability of x ∈ A and then searches a computable enumeration of A for y>x. Infinitude gives termination of the continuation for each x∈A. Each returned y belongs to A and strictly exceeds x. `CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union` gives a partial-recursive χ with (χ x).Dom ↔ (φ e x).Dom ∨ x∈A, and each χ-output comes from one branch at that input. The two ascending colour laws therefore apply to every output, including on the overlap. `CofiniteDomainLemma` makes the complement of dom χ infinite. By the domain equivalence each of those omitted inputs is in Aᶜ and outside dom(φ e), so `Set.Infinite.exists_gt` supplies the exact unbounded premise of `T.lower_met`, yielding m∈Aᶜ outside both N and dom(φ e).

Use `PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace` and the two methods on its returned trace. Its `hM` is `Nat.RecursiveIn` for the native singleton characteristic oracle. import Proofs.PriorityRequirements
import Proofs.HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness

namespace MaslovaRestricted

open HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness

abbrev Cylinder (A : Set ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {z | ∃ x n : ℕ, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n}

abbrev NonCylinder (A : Set ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun x => x ∈ A) (fun x => x ∈ Cylinder A) ∧
    OneOneReducible (fun x => x ∈ Cylinder A) (fun x => x ∈ A))

abbrev Ascending (A : Set ℕ) (f : ℕ → Part ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, y ∈ f x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)

theorem canonicalTripleRE :
    REPred (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => p.2.2 ∈ row p.1 p.2.1) := by
  have hpair : Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => Nat.pair p.2.1 p.2.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
      (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  exact (canonicalNumbering_acceptable.2.2.1.comp Computable.fst hpair).dom_re

theorem packedExhaustion (W : ℕ → Set ℕ)
    (hW :
      let encode (n : ℕ) := List.replicate n true
      let decode (w : List Bool) := if encode w.length = w then some w.length else none
      ComputablyEnumerableSet encode decode
        (Function.LeftInverse.injective
          (show Function.LeftInverse List.length encode from fun _ => List.length_replicate))
        (fun n => by simp [decode, encode])
        (fun w hw => ite_eq_right (fun h => hw ⟨w.length, h⟩))
        {z : ℕ | ∃ x y : ℕ, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}) :
    ∃ e, ∀ x, W x = {y | ∃ s, y ∈ rowAt e x s} := by
  let G : Set ℕ := {z | ∃ x y : ℕ, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_index_stages ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true G).mpr hW)
  refine ⟨e, fun x => Set.ext fun y => Iff.trans ?_ (he x y)⟩
  change y ∈ W x ↔ ∃ a b : ℕ, b ∈ W a ∧ Nat.pair x y = Nat.pair a b
  constructor
  · exact fun h => ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp hab
    exact hb

theorem avoidComplement (A : Set ℕ) (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x => x ∈ A)) (hnoncyl : NonCylinder A)
    (e : ℕ) (hhom : ∀ x y, y ∈ row e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) :
    ∀ Z : Set ℕ, Z.Finite → Z ⊆ Aᶜ →
      ∃ x, (row e x).Finite ∧ row e x ∩ Z = ∅ := by
  have hnco : ¬ REPred (fun x => x ∈ Aᶜ) := by
    intro h
    exact hnonrec (ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mpr ⟨hA, h⟩)
  intro Z hZ hsub
  exact FiniteMarkerAvoidance.of_nonCE_marker_colors A (row e) hnoncyl
    ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp
      (PriorityRequirements.rowGraphRE canonicalTripleRE e)) hhom Z hZ
    (fun z hz => ⟨fun ha => (hsub hz ha).elim,
      fun _ hce => hnco ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mpr hce)⟩)

theorem ceAdvance {A : Set ℕ} (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A)) (hinf : A.Infinite) :
    ∃ ψ : ℕ → Part ℕ, Partrec ψ ∧ (∀ x, (ψ x).Dom ↔ x ∈ A) ∧ Ascending A ψ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨enumA, henum, hrange⟩ :=
    ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_exists_computable_range hA hinf.nonempty
  let step (x n : ℕ) : Option ℕ := if x < enumA n then some (enumA n) else none
  have hstep : Computable₂ step := by
    change Computable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => step p.1 p.2)
    have hout := henum.comp (Computable.snd : Computable (Prod.snd : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ))
    simpa only [step, Bool.cond_eq_ite, decide_eq_true_eq] using
      (Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp Computable.fst hout).cond
        (Primrec.option_some.to_comp.comp hout) (Computable.const (none : Option ℕ))
  let advance (x : ℕ) := Nat.rfindOpt (step x)
  have hadvance : Partrec advance := Partrec.rfindOpt hstep
  have hsuccess (x : ℕ) : (advance x).Dom := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hinf.exists_gt x
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : y ∈ Set.range enumA := hrange.symm ▸ hy
    exact Nat.rfindOpt_dom.mpr ⟨n, enumA n, by simp [step, hxy]⟩
  let gate (x : ℕ) := Part.assert (x ∈ A) (fun _ => Part.some ())
  let ψ (x : ℕ) := (gate x).bind (fun _ => advance x)
  have hgate : Partrec gate := hA
  have hψ : Partrec ψ := hgate.bind (hadvance.comp (Computable.fst : Computable (Prod.fst : ℕ × Unit → ℕ)))
  have hdom (x : ℕ) : (ψ x).Dom ↔ x ∈ A := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A <;> simp [ψ, gate, Part.assert_pos, Part.assert_neg, hx, hsuccess]
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, hdom, ?_⟩
  intro x y hy
  obtain ⟨_, _, hout⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp hy
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec hout
  have hx := (hdom x).mp (Part.dom_iff_mem.mpr ⟨y, hy⟩)
  by_cases hxy : x < enumA n
  · have heq : enumA n = y := by simpa [step, hxy] using hn
    have hyA : enumA n ∈ A := hrange ▸ Set.mem_range_self n
    exact ⟨heq ▸ hxy, iff_of_true (heq ▸ hyA) hx⟩
  · simp [step, hxy] at hn

theorem omittedAbove (A : Set ℕ) (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x => x ∈ A)) (hnoncyl : NonCylinder A)
    (f : ℕ → Part ℕ) (hf : Partrec f) (hasc : Ascending A f) :
    ∀ b, ∃ m, b < m ∧ m ∈ Aᶜ ∧ ¬ (f m).Dom := by
  classical
  have hinf : A.Infinite := by
    intro hfin
    have hlist : PrimrecRel (fun (xs : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) => x ∈ xs) :=
      (PrimrecRel.exists_mem_list (R := @Eq ℕ) Primrec.eq).of_eq (by intro xs x; simp)
    have hmem := hlist.decide.to_comp.comp (Computable.const hfin.toFinset.toList) Computable.id
    exact hnonrec (hmem.computablePred.of_eq (fun x => Finset.mem_toList.trans hfin.mem_toFinset))
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hψdom, hψasc⟩ := ceAdvance hA hinf
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hχdom, hχout⟩ := CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union hf hψ
  have hdom (x : ℕ) : (χ x).Dom ↔ (f x).Dom ∨ x ∈ A := (hχdom x).trans (or_congr_right (hψdom x))
  have hχasc : Ascending A χ := fun x y hy => (hχout x y hy).elim (hasc x y) (hψasc x y)
  intro b
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hb⟩ := (CofiniteDomainLemma A χ hnonrec hnoncyl hχ hχasc).exists_gt b
  have hout : ¬ ((f m).Dom ∨ m ∈ A) := fun h => hm ((hdom m).mpr h)
  exact ⟨m, hb, fun ha => hout (Or.inr ha), fun hd => hout (Or.inl hd)⟩

theorem restrictRequirements (A : Set ℕ) (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A))
    (hnonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x => x ∈ A)) (hnoncyl : NonCylinder A)
    (T : PriorityRequirements.VerificationTrace canonicalNumbering rowAt Aᶜ) :
    (∀ e, (∀ x y, y ∈ row e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
      ∃ x, (row e x).Finite ∧ row e x ⊆ T.output) ∧
    (∀ e, Ascending A (canonicalNumbering e) →
      ∃ m, m ∈ Aᶜ ∧ m ∉ T.output ∧ ¬ (canonicalNumbering e m).Dom) := by
  exact ⟨fun e hhom => T.upper_met row monotone_rowAt mem_row_iff_exists_stage e
    (avoidComplement A hA hnonrec hnoncyl e hhom),
    fun e hasc => T.lower_met e
      (omittedAbove A hA hnonrec hnoncyl (canonicalNumbering e)
        (canonicalNumbering_acceptable.1 e) hasc)⟩

theorem complementOracle (A : Set ℕ) (hA : REPred (fun x => x ∈ A)) :
    Nat.RecursiveIn
      {(by classical exact fun n => Part.some (if n ∈ PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle canonicalNumbering then 1 else 0))}
      (fun m => Part.some (@ite ℕ (m ∈ Aᶜ) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff_exists_code A).mp hA
  let e := Encodable.encode c
  let K := PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle canonicalNumbering
  let answer (n : ℕ) : ℕ := if n ∈ K then 1 else 0
  let O : Set (ℕ →. ℕ) := {fun n => Part.some (answer n)}
  let Rel (f : ℕ → ℕ) := Nat.RecursiveIn O (fun n => Part.some (f n))
  have liftOrdinary {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Computable f) : Rel f :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hf.computableIn
  have relComp {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Rel f) (hg : Rel g) :
      Rel (fun n => f (g n)) :=
    (Nat.RecursiveIn.comp hf hg).of_eq (fun _ => Part.bind_some _ _)
  have hanswer : Rel answer := Nat.RecursiveIn.oracle _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hquery : Rel (Nat.pair e) :=
    liftOrdinary (Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.const e) Computable.id)
  have hswap : Rel (fun k : ℕ => 1 - k) :=
    liftOrdinary (Primrec.nat_sub.to_comp.comp (Computable.const 1) Computable.id)
  refine (relComp hswap (relComp hanswer hquery)).of_eq fun m => ?_
  have hiff : Nat.pair e m ∈ K ↔ m ∈ A := by
    rw [show Nat.pair e m ∈ K ↔ (canonicalNumbering e m).Dom from
      PriorityRequirements.pair_mem_haltingOracle canonicalNumbering e m]
    simpa [canonicalNumbering, e] using hc m
  by_cases hm : m ∈ A <;> simp [answer, hiff, hm]

theorem existsRestrictedRequirements (A : Set ℕ)
    (hA :
      let encode (n : ℕ) := List.replicate n false
      let decode (w : List Bool) := if w = encode w.length then some w.length else none
      ComputablyEnumerableSet encode decode (List.replicate_left_injective false)
        (fun n => by simp [decode, encode])
        (fun w hw => ite_eq_right (fun h => hw ⟨w.length, h.symm⟩)) A)
    (hnonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun x => x ∈ A)) (hnoncyl : NonCylinder A) :
    ∃ N : Set ℕ,
      ({xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ Nᶜ} : Set (Fin 1 → ℕ)) ∈
        (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).2.1 ∧
      (∀ e, (∀ x y, y ∈ row e x → (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) →
        ∃ x, (row e x).Finite ∧ row e x ⊆ N) ∧
      (∀ e, Ascending A (canonicalNumbering e) →
        ∃ m, m ∈ Aᶜ ∧ m ∉ N ∧ ¬ (canonicalNumbering e m).Dom) := by
  have hRE := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false A).mpr hA
  let before (q r : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := Nat.pair q.1 q.2 < Nat.pair r.1 r.2
  have horder : IsStrictTotalOrder (ℕ × ℕ) before :=
    Nat.pairEquiv.injective.isStrictTotalOrder_onFun (· < ·)
  have hpair : Primrec (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => Nat.pair q.1 q.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd
  have hbefore : ComputablePred (fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ) => before p.1 p.2) :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (hpair.comp Primrec.fst) (hpair.comp Primrec.snd)).computablePred
  obtain ⟨T, _, hSigma⟩ := PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace canonicalNumbering rowAt Aᶜ before
    canonicalNumbering_acceptable.2.2.1 canonicalNumbering_acceptable.2.1 computable_rowAt_code
    horder hbefore (complementOracle A hRE)
  exact ⟨T.output, by
    change ({xs : Fin 1 → ℕ | xs 0 ∈ T.output}ᶜᶜ : Set (Fin 1 → ℕ)) ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1
    simpa using hSigma, restrictRequirements A hRE hnonrec hnoncyl T⟩

end MaslovaRestricted

#print axioms MaslovaRestricted.existsRestrictedRequirements

**Upper strictness.** Use `ProfileRealization` on the Π₂ certificate for `P = T.outputᶜ`. It supplies the computable surjection, the profile equality with P on the right, and the computable right inverse. `PullbackReductions` and `CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree` give the forward reductions and the many-one degree equality. For a hypothetical finite-one `h : Cyl(A) → C`, use `HomogeneousRowsFromCylinderReduction` with the true-bit c.e. bridge for the packed row graph. `HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.exists_index_stages` produces one e outside the quantifier over x. `Nat.pair_eq_pair` and `HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage` identify each full canonical row with `range (fun n => p (h (Nat.pair x n)))`. Thus the same e is available to `T.upper_met`. Its restricted avoidance callback only sees finite restraints Z ⊆ Aᶜ. The A-colour implication is vacuous on Z and the Aᶜ-colour is non-c.e. by the r.e./co-r.e. computability equivalence and nonrecursiveness of A. The selected row is finite and contained in `T.output`, so every p-fibre over that row is finite by the profile. Apply `Set.Finite.preimage'` first to p and then to h. That finite composite preimage contains the whole infinite range of `Nat.pair x`, a contradiction.

**Lower strictness.** For a hypothetical finite-one `h : C → A`, `AscendingSelfReductionFromPullbackReduction` supplies the precise least-search partial map f, its ascent and colour preservation, and `P ⊆ dom f`. For y in P, the infinite p-fibre cannot be covered by the finite h-preimage of `{0, …, y}`, which makes the search converge. Index that map itself using `canonicalNumbering_acceptable`. The restricted `T.lower_met` needs unbounded omitted points in Aᶜ. A witness from `CofiniteDomainLemma` on f alone could lie in A. Build an advancing partial map with domain exactly A by waiting for x∈A and searching a computable enumeration of the infinite c.e. A for an output greater than x. `CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union` races the two maps and preserves their output laws. Apply `CofiniteDomainLemma` to the race and use its exact domain formula to obtain unbounded points in Aᶜ outside dom f. The lower requirement then gives m outside `T.output` and outside the e-th domain. Since m∈P, the supplier's domain inclusion and the index equality give the contradiction.

**Integration details.** Apply `PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace` with M = Aᶜ and the order on Nat pair codes. The standalone `PriorityRequirements` and `LocalInterpolation` endpoints require both colours to be non-c.e. and cannot be instantiated on this c.e. representative. The trace constructor expects a native `Nat.RecursiveIn` witness for the total characteristic function of M. def cylinder (A : Set Nat) : Set Nat :=
  {z | ∃ x n : Nat, x ∈ A ∧ z = Nat.pair x n}

theorem advancingOnCE (A : Set Nat) (hA : REPred (fun n => n ∈ A))
    (hNonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun n => n ∈ A)) :
    ∃ g : Nat → Part Nat, Partrec g ∧
      (∀ n, (g n).Dom ↔ n ∈ A) ∧
      (∀ x y, y ∈ g x → x < y ∧ (y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)) := by
  classical
  have hInf : A.Infinite := by
    intro hFin
    let L := hFin.toFinset.toList
    have hRel : PrimrecRel (fun (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) => x ∈ xs) :=
      (PrimrecRel.exists_mem_list (R := @Eq Nat) Primrec.eq).of_eq (by
        intro xs x
        simp)
    exact hNonrec
      (((hRel.decide.to_comp.comp (Computable.const L) Computable.id).computablePred).of_eq
        (fun x => Finset.mem_toList.trans hFin.mem_toFinset))
  obtain ⟨enum, hEnum, hRange⟩ :=
    ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_exists_computable_range hA hInf.nonempty
  let test (x i : Nat) : Option Nat := bif decide (x < enum i) then some (enum i) else none
  have hTest : Computable₂ test :=
    (Computable.cond
      (Primrec.nat_lt.decide.to_comp.comp Computable.fst (hEnum.comp Computable.snd))
      ((Computable.option_some.comp (hEnum.comp Computable.snd)))
      (Computable.const (none : Option Nat))).to₂
  have hAdvance := Partrec.rfindOpt hTest
  let g (x : Nat) : Part Nat :=
    (Part.assert (x ∈ A) (fun _ => Part.some ())).bind
      (fun _ => Nat.rfindOpt (test x))
  have hg : Partrec g :=
    Partrec.bind hA (hAdvance.comp Computable.fst).to₂
  have hGood (x y : Nat) (hy : y ∈ g x) : x ∈ A ∧ x < y ∧ y ∈ A := by
    dsimp only [g] at hy
    rw [Part.mem_bind_iff] at hy
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hy⟩ := hy
    have hx := (Part.mem_assert_iff.mp hu).1
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec hy
    by_cases hlt : x < enum i
    · have hyEq : enum i = y := by simpa [test, hlt, Option.mem_def] using hi
      exact ⟨hx, hyEq ▸ hlt, hyEq ▸ (hRange ▸ Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
    · simp [test, hlt, Option.mem_def] at hi
  refine ⟨g, hg, fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun x y hy => ?_⟩
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.mp hd
    exact (hGood x y hy).1
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hInf.exists_gt x
    rw [← hRange] at hy
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hd : (Nat.rfindOpt (test x)).Dom :=
      Nat.rfindOpt_dom.mpr ⟨i, enum i, by simp [test, hxy, Option.mem_def]⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Part.dom_iff_mem.mp hd
    exact Part.dom_iff_mem.mpr
      ⟨y, Part.mem_bind_iff.mpr ⟨(), by simp [Part.assert_pos hx], hy⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hx, hlt, hyA⟩ := hGood x y hy
    exact ⟨hlt, iff_of_true hyA hx⟩

theorem strictPullback (A : Set Nat)
    (hA : REPred (fun n => n ∈ A))
    (hNonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun n => n ∈ A))
    (hNoncyl : ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ A) (fun n => n ∈ cylinder A) ∧
      OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ cylinder A) (fun n => n ∈ A)))
    (T : PriorityRequirements.VerificationTrace φ stage Aᶜ)
    (hSigma : {xs : Fin 1 → Nat | xs 0 ∈ T.output} ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1) :
    ∃ C : Set Nat, ManyOneDegree.of C = ManyOneDegree.of A ∧
      FiniteOneReducible A C ∧ ¬ FiniteOneReducible C A ∧
      FiniteOneReducible C (cylinder A) ∧ ¬ FiniteOneReducible (cylinder A) C := by
  classical
  let P : Set Nat := T.outputᶜ
  have hPi : {xs : Fin 1 → Nat | xs 0 ∈ P} ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).2.1 := by
    change ({xs : Fin 1 → Nat | xs 0 ∈ T.output}ᶜᶜ : Set (Fin 1 → Nat)) ∈
      (ArithmeticalHierarchyLevels 2 1 (Nat.le_succ 1)).1
    simpa using hSigma
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hSurjP, hProfile, s, hs, hSection⟩ := ProfileRealization P hPi
  let C : Set Nat := p ⁻¹' A
  obtain ⟨_, hAC, _, hDegree⟩ :=
    PullbackReductions A P p s hp hSurjP hProfile hs hSection
  have hCyl := (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 C hDegree
  obtain ⟨_, hSurj, hUniversal, _⟩ :=
    HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.canonicalNumbering_acceptable
  refine ⟨C, hDegree, hAC, ?_, hCyl, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hh, hFibres, hMem⟩
    let f (y : Nat) : Part Nat :=
      Part.map h (Nat.rfind (fun u => Part.some (decide (p u = y ∧ y < h u))))
    have hfSpec : Partrec f ∧
        (∀ y z : Nat, z ∈ f y → y < z ∧ (z ∈ A ↔ y ∈ A)) ∧
        P ⊆ {y | (f y).Dom} :=
      AscendingSelfReductionFromPullbackReduction A P p h hp hSurjP ⟨s, hs, hSection⟩
        hProfile hh hFibres hMem
    obtain ⟨hf, hAsc, hDom⟩ := hfSpec
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hSurj f hf
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hDomG, hAscG⟩ := advancingOnCE A hA hNonrec
    obtain ⟨race, hRace, hDomRace, hOutRace⟩ := CofiniteDomainLemma.partrec_union hf hg
    have hInf := CofiniteDomainLemma A race hNonrec hNoncyl hRace (fun x y hy =>
      (hOutRace x y hy).elim (hAsc x y) (hAscG x y))
    obtain ⟨m, _, hmN, hmDom⟩ := T.lower_met e (fun b => by
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hbm⟩ := hInf.exists_gt b
      change ¬ (race m).Dom at hm
      rw [hDomRace] at hm
      refine ⟨m, hbm, fun hmA => hm (Or.inr ((hDomG m).mpr hmA)), ?_⟩
      rw [he]
      exact fun hmf => hm (Or.inl hmf))
    exact hmDom (he ▸ hDom hmN)
  · rintro ⟨h, hh, hFibres, hMem⟩
    have hExhaust (W : Nat → Set Nat)
        (hCE : {z : Nat | ∃ x y : Nat, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y} = ∅ ∨
          ∃ enum : Nat → Nat, Computable (fun n => List.replicate (enum n) true) ∧
            Set.range enum = {z : Nat | ∃ x y : Nat, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}) :
        ∃ e : Nat, ∀ x : Nat, W x = {y : Nat | ∃ t, y ∈ stage e x t} := by
      let G : Set Nat := {z | ∃ x y : Nat, y ∈ W x ∧ z = Nat.pair x y}
      have hRE := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true G).mpr hCE
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.exists_index_stages hRE
      refine ⟨e, fun x => Set.ext (fun y => Iff.trans ?_ (he x y))⟩
      constructor
      · exact fun hy => ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp hab
        exact hb
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨e, he⟩, hHom⟩ :=
      HomogeneousRowsFromCylinderReduction A P p hp hSurjP ⟨s, hs, hSection⟩
        hProfile h hh hFibres hMem stage
        HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.computable_rowAt_code
        HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.monotone_rowAt hExhaust
    have hRow (x : Nat) : Set.range (fun n : Nat => p (h (Nat.pair x n))) = V e x :=
      (he x).trans (Set.ext (fun y =>
        (HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage e x y).symm))
    have hPacked : Computable (fun q : Nat × Nat × Nat => Nat.pair q.2.1 q.2.2) :=
      Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd)
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
    have hGraph : REPred (fun q : Nat × Nat × Nat => q.2.2 ∈ V q.1 q.2.1) :=
      (hUniversal.comp Computable.fst hPacked).dom_re
    have hCoCE : ¬ REPred (fun x => x ∈ Aᶜ) := fun h =>
      hNonrec (ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mpr ⟨hA, h⟩)
    have hHomV (x y : Nat) (hy : y ∈ V e x) : y ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A :=
      hHom x y (by
        change y ∈ Set.range (fun n : Nat => p (h (Nat.pair x n)))
        rwa [hRow x])
    obtain ⟨x, hFinite, hInN⟩ :=
      T.upper_met V HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.monotone_rowAt
        HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.mem_row_iff_exists_stage e (fun Z hZ hZA =>
          FiniteMarkerAvoidance.of_nonCE_marker_colors A (V e) hNoncyl
            ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mp
              (PriorityRequirements.rowGraphRE hGraph e))
            hHomV Z hZ (fun z hz =>
              ⟨fun hzA => False.elim ((hZA hz) hzA),
                fun _ h => hCoCE ((ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff true _).mpr h)⟩))
    have hPreP : (p ⁻¹' (V e x)).Finite := hFinite.preimage' (fun y hy => by
      by_contra hInf
      have hyP : y ∈ P :=
        hProfile ▸ (show y ∈ {z : Nat | (p ⁻¹' ({z} : Set Nat)).Infinite} from hInf)
      exact hyP (hInN hy))
    have hPreH : (h ⁻¹' (p ⁻¹' (V e x))).Finite :=
      hPreP.preimage' (fun y _ => hFibres y)
    have hColumn : (Set.range (Nat.pair x)).Infinite :=
      Set.infinite_range_of_injective (fun _ _ hab => (Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp hab).2)
    apply hColumn (hPreH.subset ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    change p (h (Nat.pair x n)) ∈ V e x
    rw [← hRow x]
    exact ⟨n, rfl⟩

theorem existsStrictPullback (A : Set Nat)
    (hA : REPred (fun n => n ∈ A))
    (hNonrec : ¬ ComputablePred (fun n => n ∈ A))
    (hNoncyl : ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ A) (fun n => n ∈ cylinder A) ∧
      OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ cylinder A) (fun n => n ∈ A))) :
    ∃ C : Set Nat, ManyOneDegree.of C = ManyOneDegree.of A ∧
      FiniteOneReducible A C ∧ ¬ FiniteOneReducible C A ∧
      FiniteOneReducible C (cylinder A) ∧ ¬ FiniteOneReducible (cylinder A) C := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, hSurj, hUniversal, _⟩ :=
    HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.canonicalNumbering_acceptable
  let before (q r : Nat × Nat) : Prop := Nat.pair q.1 q.2 < Nat.pair r.1 r.2
  have hOrder : IsStrictTotalOrder (Nat × Nat) before :=
    Nat.pairEquiv.injective.isStrictTotalOrder_onFun (· < ·)
  have hCode : Primrec (fun q : Nat × Nat => Nat.pair q.1 q.2) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.comp Primrec.fst Primrec.snd
  have hBefore : ComputablePred (fun p : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => before p.1 p.2) :=
    (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (hCode.comp Primrec.fst) (hCode.comp Primrec.snd)).computablePred

  let K := PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ
  let oracle (n : Nat) : Part Nat :=
    Part.some (@ite Nat (n ∈ K) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)
  obtain ⟨code, hCodeDom⟩ := (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff_exists_code A).mp hA
  let e := Encodable.encode code
  have hQuerySpec (n : Nat) : Nat.pair e n ∈ K ↔ n ∈ A := by
    rw [show K = PriorityRequirements.haltingOracle φ from rfl,
      PriorityRequirements.pair_mem_haltingOracle]
    change ((Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code (Encodable.encode code)).eval n).Dom ↔ n ∈ A
    rw [Denumerable.ofNat_encode]
    exact hCodeDom n
  have hPairComputable : Computable (Nat.pair e) :=
    Primrec₂.natPair.to_comp.comp (Computable.const e) Computable.id
  have hFlipComputable : Computable (fun n : Nat => 1 - n) :=
    Primrec.nat_sub.to_comp.comp (Computable.const 1) Computable.id
  have hPair : Nat.RecursiveIn {oracle} (fun n => Part.some (Nat.pair e n)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hPairComputable.computableIn
  have hOracle : Nat.RecursiveIn {oracle} oracle :=
    Nat.RecursiveIn.oracle oracle (Set.mem_singleton oracle)
  have hFlip : Nat.RecursiveIn {oracle} (fun n => Part.some (1 - n)) :=
    RecursiveIn.iff_nat.mp hFlipComputable.computableIn
  have hM : Nat.RecursiveIn {oracle} (fun n =>
      Part.some (@ite Nat (n ∈ Aᶜ) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)) := by
    refine (hFlip.comp (hOracle.comp hPair)).of_eq (fun n => ?_)
    by_cases h : n ∈ A <;> simp [oracle, hQuerySpec n, h]
  obtain ⟨T, _, hSigma⟩ :=
    PriorityRequirements.existsEffectiveTrace φ stage Aᶜ before hUniversal hSurj
      HaltingSigmaOneCompleteness.computable_rowAt_code hOrder hBefore hM
  exact strictPullback A hA hNonrec hNoncyl T hSigma

end MaslovaStrictness

theorem MaslovaCeDichotomy : (
let encode (n : _root_.Nat) := _root_.List.replicate n _root_.Bool.false
let decode (w : _root_.List _root_.Bool) :=
  if w = encode (_root_.List.length w) then _root_.Option.some (_root_.List.length w)
  else _root_.Option.none
let ce : _root_.Set _root_.Nat → Prop :=
  _root_.ComputablyEnumerableSet encode decode
    (_root_.List.replicate_left_injective _root_.Bool.false)
    (fun n => by simp [decode, encode])
    (fun w hw => _root_.ite_eq_right (fun h => hw ⟨_root_.List.length w, h.symm⟩))
let finiteOneReducible (X Y : _root_.Set _root_.Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : _root_.Nat → _root_.Nat, _root_.Computable f ∧
    (∀ y : _root_.Nat, _root_.Set.Finite (_root_.Set.preimage f ({y} : _root_.Set _root_.Nat))) ∧
    (∀ x : _root_.Nat, x ∈ X ↔ f x ∈ Y)
let finiteOneDegree (X : _root_.Set _root_.Nat) : _root_.Set (_root_.Set _root_.Nat) :=
  {Y | finiteOneReducible Y X ∧ finiteOneReducible X Y}
∀ A : _root_.Set _root_.Nat,
  let d : _root_.Set (_root_.Set _root_.Nat) :=
    {X | _root_.ManyOneReducibilityOnNat X A ∧ _root_.ManyOneReducibilityOnNat A X}
  (¬ ∃ X ∈ d, _root_.ComputablePred (fun n : _root_.Nat => n ∈ X)) →
  (∃ X ∈ d, ce X) →
  let finiteOneDegrees := _root_.Set.image finiteOneDegree d
  _root_.ExistsUnique (fun D => D ∈ finiteOneDegrees) ∨ _root_.Set.Infinite finiteOneDegrees) := by
  classical
  intro encode decode ce fo degree A d hNonrec hCE F
  have hEq (X : Set Nat) : X ∈ d ↔ ManyOneDegree.of X = ManyOneDegree.of A :=
    ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.symm
  obtain ⟨B, hBd, hBce⟩ := hCE
  have hB : REPred (fun n => n ∈ B) :=
    (ComputablyEnumerableSet.nat_rePred_iff false B).mpr hBce
  have hRE (X : Set Nat) (hXd : X ∈ d) : REPred (fun n => n ∈ X) := by
    have hXB := (hEq X).mp hXd |>.trans ((hEq B).mp hBd).symm
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hMem⟩ := (ManyOneDegree.of_eq_of.mp hXB).1
    let semi (n : Nat) : Part Unit := Part.assert (n ∈ B) (fun _ => Part.some ())
    have hSemi : Partrec semi := hB
    refine (hSemi.comp hf).dom_re.of_eq (fun n => ?_)
    simp [semi, hMem n, Part.dom_iff_mem]

  let top : F := ⟨degree (MaslovaStrictness.cylinder A),
    ⟨MaslovaStrictness.cylinder A, (hEq _).mpr (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).1, rfl⟩⟩
  by_cases hFin : F.Finite
  · left
    by_cases hOnly : ∀ E : F, E = top
    · exact ⟨top.val, top.property, fun D hD => congrArg Subtype.val (hOnly ⟨D, hD⟩)⟩
    have hBelow : ({E : F | E ≠ top} : Set F).Nonempty := by
      push Not at hOnly
      exact hOnly
    let rep (E : F) : Set Nat := Classical.choose E.property
    have hRep (E : F) : rep E ∈ d ∧ finiteOneDegree (rep E) = E.val :=
      Classical.choose_spec E.property
    let _ : LE F := ⟨fun E D => FiniteOneReducible (rep E) (rep D)⟩
    let _ : IsTrans F (· ≤ ·) := ⟨fun _ _ _ => finiteOneTrans⟩
    let _ : Finite F := hFin.to_subtype
    obtain ⟨E, hMax⟩ := (Set.toFinite {E : F | E ≠ top}).exists_maximal hBelow

    let X := rep E
    have hXd : X ∈ d := (hRep E).1
    have hXDegree := (hEq X).mp hXd
    have hXT : finiteOneDegree (MaslovaStrictness.cylinder X) = top.val := by
      have hCylX := (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree X).1
      have hCylA := (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).1
      exact finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mpr
        ⟨(CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree A).2 _ (hCylX.trans hXDegree),
          (CylinderGreatestFiniteOneDegree X).2 _ (hCylA.trans hXDegree.symm)⟩
    have hNoncyl : ¬ (OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ X)
        (fun n => n ∈ MaslovaStrictness.cylinder X) ∧
        OneOneReducible (fun n => n ∈ MaslovaStrictness.cylinder X) (fun n => n ∈ X)) := by
      rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      apply hMax.1
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (hRep E).2.symm.trans ((finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mpr
        ⟨(ReducibilityImplications _ _).1 h1, (ReducibilityImplications _ _).1 h2⟩).trans hXT)
    obtain ⟨C, hCX, hXC, hnCX, _, hnCylC⟩ :=
      MaslovaStrictness.existsStrictPullback X (hRE X hXd) (fun h => hNonrec ⟨X, hXd, h⟩) hNoncyl
    let D : F := ⟨finiteOneDegree C, ⟨C, (hEq C).mpr (hCX.trans hXDegree), rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨_, hCD⟩ : FiniteOneReducible (rep D) C ∧ FiniteOneReducible C (rep D) :=
      finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mp (hRep D).2
    have hDT : D ≠ top := by
      intro hDT
      apply hnCylC
      exact (finiteOneDegree_eq_iff.mp
        (hXT.trans (congrArg Subtype.val hDT).symm)).1
    exact False.elim (hnCX (finiteOneTrans hCD
      (hMax.2 (y := D) hDT (finiteOneTrans hXC hCD))))
  · exact Or.inr hFin
